3.110.29: kathaṁrūpā ca sā śāntā rājaputrī yatavratā,
lobhayāmāsa yā ceto mr̥gabhūtasya tasya vai ॥29॥
3.110.30: kathaṁ vai viṣaye tasya nāvarṣat pākaśāsanaḥ ॥30॥
3.110.33: śr̥ṇu putro yathā jāta r̥ṣyaśr̥ṅga pratāpavān,
3.110.36: saha toyena tr̥ṣitā garbhiṇī cābhavat tataḥ,
3.110.37: devakanyā mr̥gī bhūtvā muniṁ sūya vimokṣyase,
3.110.38: tasyāṁ mr̥gyāṁ samabhavat tasya putro mahānr̥ṣiḥ,
3.110.41: etasminneva kāle tu sakhā daśarathasya vai,
3.110.42: tena kāmāt kr̥taṁ mithyā brāhmaṇasyeti naḥ śrutiḥ,
sa brāhmaṇaiḥ parityaktastato vai jagataḥ patiḥ ॥42॥
3.110.48: sa cedavatared rājan viṣayaṁ te mahātapāḥ,
sadyaḥ pravarṣet parjanya iti me nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥48॥
3.110.53: veśyāḥ sarvatra niṣṇātāstā uvāca sa pārthivaḥ,
3.110.58: dhanaṁ ca pradadau bhūri ratnāni vividhāni ca,
tato rūpeṇa sampannā vayasā ca mahīpate,
striya ādāya kāścit sā jagāma vanamañjasā ॥58॥
3.110.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāmr̥ṣyaśr̥ṅgopākhyāne daśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥110॥
3.111.6: sā tatra gatvā kuśalā taponityasya saṁnidhau,
āśramaṁ taṁ samāsādya dadarśa tamr̥ṣeḥ sutam ॥6॥
3.111.22: na kalpyante samidhaḥ kiṁ nu tāta
3.111.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāmr̥ṣyaśr̥ṅgopākhyāne ekādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyayaḥ ॥111॥
3.112.18: kā nāma sā brahmacaryā ca tasya,
3.112.19: dunoti cittaṁ yadi taṁ na paśye ॥19॥
3.112.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāmr̥ṣyaśr̥ṅgopākhyāne dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥112॥
3.113.13: kiṁ te priyaṁ vai kriyatāṁ maharṣe
dāsāḥ sma sarve tava vāci baddhāḥ ॥13॥
3.113.20: śāntāṁ ca śānto’sya paraḥ sa kopaḥ,
3.113.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāmr̥ṣyaśr̥ṅgopākhyāne trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥113॥
3.114.2: sa sāgaraṁ samāsādya gaṅgāyāḥ saṅgame nr̥pa,
3.114.3: bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahito vīraḥ kaliṅgān prati bhārata ॥3॥
3.114.4: ete kaliṅgāḥ kaunteya yatra vaitaraṇī nadī,
3.114.8: mā parasvamabhidrogdhā mā dharmān sakalān vaśīḥ ॥8॥
3.114.12: imāṁ gāthāmatra gāyannapaḥ smr̥śati yo naraḥ,
3.114.13: tato vaitaraṇīṁ sarve pāṇḍavā draupadī tathā,
3.114.17: etat svayambhuvo rājan vanaṁ divyaṁ prakāśate,
3.114.18: yasmin yajñe hi bhūrdattā kaśyapāya mahātmane,
3.114.20: na māṁ martyāya bhagavan kasmaicid dātumarhasi,
3.114.21: viṣīdantīṁ tu tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kaśyapo bhagavānr̥ṣiḥ,
3.114.22: tataḥ prasannā pr̥thivī tapasā tasya pāṇḍava,
3.114.26: oṁ namo viśvaguptāya namo viśvaparāya te,
3.114.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ mahendrācalagamane caturdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥114॥
3.115.1: tāpasānāṁ paraṁ cakre satkāraṁ bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha ॥1॥
3.115.5: prītistvayi ca rāmasya kṣipraṁ tvāṁ darśayiṣyati ॥5॥
3.115.8: sa bhavān kathayatvadya yathā rāmeṇa nirjitāḥ,
āhave kṣatriyāḥ sarve kathaṁ kena ca hetunā ॥8॥
3.115.13: rathena tena tu sadā varadānena vīryavān ॥13॥
3.115.18: yat tad bhūtahitaṁ kāryaṁ surendreṇa niveditam,
3.115.20: gādhīti viśruto loke vanavāsaṁ jagāma ha ॥20॥
3.115.21: vane tu tasya vasataḥ kanyā jajñe’psaraḥsamā,
3.115.22: ucitaṁ naḥ kule kiñcit pūrvairyat sampravartitam ॥22॥
3.115.24: na cāpi bhagavān vācyo dīyatāmiti bhārgava,
deyā me duhitā caiva tvadvidhāya mahātmane ॥24॥
3.115.25: dāsyāmyaśvasahasraṁ te mama bhāryā sutāstu te ॥25॥
3.115.27: tasmai prādāt sahasraṁ vai vājināṁ varuṇastadā ॥27॥
3.115.28: gaṅgāyāṁ kānyakubje vai dadau satyavatīṁ tadā ॥28॥
3.115.29: tato gādhiḥ sutāṁ cāsmai janyāścāsan surāstadā,
labdhvā hayasahasraṁ tu tāṁśca daṣṭvā divaukasaḥ ॥29॥
3.115.31: ājagāma bhr̥guḥ śreṣṭhaṁ putraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nananda ha ॥31॥
3.115.33: tataḥ snuṣāṁ sa bhagavān prahr̥ṣṭo bhr̥gurabravīt,
varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva subhage dātā hyasmi tavepsitam ॥33॥
3.115.34: sā vai prasādayāmāsa taṁ guruṁ putrakāraṇāt,
ātmanaścaiva mātuśca prasādaṁ ca cakāra saḥ ॥34॥
3.115.35: r̥tau tvaṁ caiva mātā ca snāte puṁsavanāya vai,
3.115.38: tataḥ punaḥ sa bhagavān kāle bahutithe gate,
3.115.42: tataḥ prasādayāmāsa śvaśuraṁ sā punaḥ punaḥ,
na me putro bhavedīdr̥k kāmaṁ pautro bhavediti ॥42॥
3.115.43: jamadagniṁ tataḥ putraṁ jajñe sā kāla āgate ॥43॥
3.115.45: taṁ tu kr̥tsno dhanurvedaḥ pratyabhād bharatarṣabha,
3.115.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ kārtavīryopākhyāne pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥115॥
3.116.2: reṇukāṁ varayāmāsa sa ca tasmai dadau nr̥paḥ ॥2॥
3.116.6: sā tu citrarathaṁ nāma mārtikāvatakaṁ nr̥pam,
3.116.9: sa tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā cyutāṁ dhairyād brāhmyā lakṣmyā vivarjitām,
3.116.10: tato jyeṣṭho jāmadagnyo rumaṇvān nāma nāmataḥ,
3.116.12: tataḥ śaśāpa tān krodhāt te śaptāścetanāṁ jahuḥ,
3.116.14: jahīmāṁ mātaraṁ pāpāṁ mā ca putra vyathāṁ kr̥thāḥ,
tata ādāya paraśuṁ rāmo mātuḥ śiro’harat ॥14॥
3.116.16: mamedaṁ vacanāt tāta kr̥taṁ te karma duṣkaram,
vr̥ṇīṣva kāmān dharmajña yāvato vāñchase hr̥dā ॥16॥
3.116.17: sa vavre māturutthānamasmr̥tiṁ ca vadhasya vai,
pāpena tena cāsparśaṁ bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ prakr̥tiṁ tathā ॥17॥
3.116.19: kadācit tu tathaivāsya viniṣkrāntāḥ sutāḥ prabho,
3.116.21: jahāra vatsaṁ krośantyā babhañja ca mahādrumān ॥21॥
3.116.22: āgatāya ca rāmāya tadācaṣṭa pitā svayam,
gāṁ ca rorudatīṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kopo rāmaṁ samāviśat ॥22॥
3.116.28: apakrānteṣu vai teṣu jamadagnau tathā gate ॥28॥
3.116.29: sa dr̥ṣṭrā pitaraṁ vīrastathā mr̥tyuvaśaṁ gatam,
3.116.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ kārtavīryopākhyāne jamadagnivadhe ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥116॥
3.117.3: kiṁ nu tairna kr̥taṁ pāpaṁ yairbhavāṁstapasi sthitaḥ,
ayudhyamāno vr̥ddhaḥ san hataḥ śaraśataiḥ śitaiḥ ॥3॥
3.117.4: kiṁ nu te tatra vakṣyanti saciveṣu suhr̥tsu ca,
3.117.8: teṣāṁ cānugatā ye ca kṣatriyāḥ kṣatriyarṣabha,
3.117.10: sākṣād dadarśa carcīkaṁ sa ca rāmaṁ nyavārayat ॥10॥
3.117.14: sa pradāya mahīṁ tasmai kaśyapāya mahātmane,
3.117.16: darśayāmāsa tān viprān dharmarājaṁ ca sānujam ॥16॥
3.117.17: sa tamānarca rājendra bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahitaḥ prabhuḥ,
dvijānāṁ ca parāṁ pūjāṁ cakre nr̥patisattamaḥ ॥17॥
3.117.18: mahendra uṣya tāṁ rātriṁ prayayau dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ॥18॥
3.117.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ kārtavīryopākhyāne saptadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥117॥
3.118.20: tataḥ sa rāmaṁ ca janārdanaṁ ca
kārṣṇiṁ ca sāmbaṁ ca śineśca pautram,
3.118.23: śrutvā tu te tasya vacaḥ pratītā-
3.118.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ prabhāse yādavapāṇḍavasamāgame aṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥118॥
3.119.13: nemān sma pr̥cchan sa śr̥ṇoti nūnam,
3.119.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ balarāmavākye ekonaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥119॥
3.120.7: bhrātā ca me yaḥ sa sakhā guruśca
3.120.16: droṇaṁ ca bhīṣmaṁ ca mahārathau tau
3.120.26: stadaiva sarve ripavo hi na syuḥ ॥26॥
3.120.27: satyaṁ tu me rakṣyatamaṁ na rājyam,
3.120.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ yādavagamane viṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥120॥
3.121.1: tarpitaḥ śrūyate rājan sa tr̥pto mudamabhyagāt ॥1॥
3.121.4: vānaspatyaṁ ca bhaumaṁ ca yad dravyaṁ niyataṁ makhe ॥4॥
3.121.5: teṣveva cāsya yajñeṣu prayogāḥ sapta viśrutāḥ ॥5॥
3.121.6: tasya sma yūpān yajñeṣu bhrājamānān hiraṇmayān ॥6॥
3.121.9: sikatā vā yathā loke yathā vā divi tārakāḥ,
yathā vā varṣato dhārā asaṅkhyeyāḥ sma kenacit ॥9॥
3.121.10: tathaiva tadasaṅkhyeyaṁ dhanaṁ yat pradadau gayaḥ,
3.121.11: na tasya śakyāḥ saṅkhyātuṁ dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇāvataḥ ॥11॥
3.121.14: sa lokān prāptavānaindrān karmaṇā tena bhārata,
salokatāṁ tasya gacchet payoṣṇyāṁ ya upaspr̥śet ॥14॥
3.121.16: sa payoṣṇyāṁ naraśreṣṭhaḥ snātvā vai bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha,
3.121.22: saṁstambhayāmāsa ca taṁ vāsavaṁ cyavanaḥ prabhuḥ,
3.121.24: nāsatyau ca kathaṁ brahman kr̥tavān somapīthinau,
3.121.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ saukanye ekaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥121॥
3.122.4: tathā sa saṁvr̥to dhīmān mr̥tpiṇḍa iva sarvaśaḥ,
tapyate sma tapo ghoraṁ valmīkena samāvr̥taḥ ॥4॥
3.122.6: ekaiva ca sutā subhrūḥ sukanyā nāma bhārata ॥6॥
3.122.8: sā vai vasumatīṁ tatra paśyantī sumanoramām,
3.122.9: rūpeṇa vayasā caiva madanena madena ca,
3.122.11: tāṁ paśyamāno vijane sa reme paramadyutiḥ,
3.122.12: tāmābabhāṣe kalyāṇīṁ sā cāsya na śr̥ṇoti vai,
3.122.14: akrudhyat sa tayā viddhe netre paramamanyumān,
3.122.17: jñātaṁ vā yadi vājñātaṁ tad drutaṁ brūta mā ciram,
tamūcuḥ sainikāḥ sarve na vidmo’pakr̥taṁ vayam ॥17॥
3.122.18: tataḥ sa pr̥thivīpālaḥ sāmnā cogreṇa ca svayam ॥18॥
3.122.23: ajñānād bālayā yat te kr̥taṁ tat kṣantumarhasi,
3.122.27: pratigr̥hya ca tāṁ kanyāṁ bhagavān prasasāda ha,
3.122.28: nityaṁ paryacarat prītyā tapasā niyamena ca ॥28॥
3.122.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ saukanye dvāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥122॥
3.123.3: kasya tvamasi vāmoru vane’smin kiṁ karoṣi ca,
icchāva bhadre jñātuṁ tvāṁ tattvamākhyāhi śobhane ॥3॥
3.123.4: śaryātitanayāṁ vittaṁ bhāryāṁ māṁ cyavanasya ca ॥4॥
3.123.4d1: sāhaṁ sarvātmanā nityaṁ patiṁ prati suniṣṭhitā.
3.123.5: kathaṁ tvamasi kalyāṇi pitrā dattā gatādhvane ॥5॥
3.123.6: na deveṣvapi tulyāṁ hi tvayā paśyāva bhāvini ॥6॥
3.123.11: patyarthaṁ devagarbhābhe mā vr̥thā yauvanaṁ kr̥thāḥ,
3.123.12: ratāhaṁ cyavane patyau maivaṁ māṁ paryaśaṅkatam,
3.123.15: uvāca vākyaṁ yat tābhyāmuktaṁ bhr̥gusutaṁ prati,
3.123.17: aśvināvapi tad rājan saraḥ prāviśatāṁ tadā,
3.123.20: sā samīkṣya tu tān sarvāṁstulyarūpadharān sthitān ॥20॥
3.123.21: niścitya manasā buddhyā devī vavre svakaṁ patim,
labdhvā tu cyavano bhāryāṁ vayo rūpaṁ ca vāñchitam ॥21॥
3.123.23: kr̥to bhavadbhyāṁ vr̥ddhaḥ san bhāryāṁ ca prāptavānimām,
3.123.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ saukanye trayoviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥123॥
3.124.2: cyavanaṁ ca sukanyāṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvā devasutāviva,
reme sabhāryaḥ śaryātiḥ kr̥tsnāṁ prāpya mahīmiva ॥2॥
3.124.7: adbhutāni ca tatrāsan yāni tāni nibodha me ॥7॥
3.124.9: ubhāvetau na somārhau nāsatyāviti me matiḥ,
bhiṣajau divi devānāṁ karmaṇā tena nārhataḥ ॥9॥
3.124.11: r̥te tvāṁ vibudhāṁścānyān kathaṁ vai nārhataḥ savam,
3.124.13: anādr̥tya tataḥ śakraṁ grahaṁ jagrāha bhārgavaḥ ॥13॥
3.124.15: ābhyāmarthāya somaṁ tvaṁ grahīṣyasi yadi svayam,
3.124.21: hanurekā sthitā tvasya bhūmāvekā divaṁ gatā,
3.124.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ saukanye caturviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥124॥
3.125.1: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā ghoravadanaṁ madaṁ devaḥ śatakratuḥ,
3.125.3: bhaviṣyataḥ satyametad vaco vipraḥ prasīda me ॥3॥
3.125.4: na te mithyā samārambho bhavatveṣa paro vidhiḥ,
jānāmi cāhaṁ viprarṣe na mithyā tvaṁ kariṣyasi ॥4॥
3.125.5: bhūya eva tu te vīryaṁ prakāśediti bhārgava ॥5॥
3.125.7: tasmāt prasādaṁ kuru me bhavatvevaṁ yathecchasi,
3.125.8: madaṁ ca vyabhajad rājan pāne strīṣu ca vīryavān ॥8॥
3.125.9: akṣeṣu mr̥gayāyāṁ ca pūrvasr̥ṣṭaṁ punaḥ punaḥ,
tadā madaṁ vinikṣipya śakraṁ santarpya cendunā ॥9॥
3.125.10: aśvibhyāṁ sahitān devān yājayitvā ca taṁ nr̥pam,
vikhyāpya vīryaṁ lokeṣu sarveṣu vadatāṁ varaḥ ॥10॥
3.125.12: atra tvaṁ saha sodaryaiḥ pitr̥̄n devāṁśca tarpaya,
etad dr̥ṣṭvā mahīpāla sikatākṣaṁ ca bhārata ॥12॥
3.125.13: puṣkareṣu mahārāja sarveṣu ca jalaṁ spr̥śa ॥13॥
3.125.14: sthāṇormantrāṇi ca japan siddhiṁ prāpsyasi bhārata,
3.125.18: śr̥ṅgāṇi trīṇi puṇyāni trīṇi prasravaṇāni ca,
3.125.21: iha te vai carūn prāśnannr̥ṣayaśca viśāmpate,
3.125.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ saukanye pañcaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥125॥
3.126.7: mantriṣvādhāya tad rājyaṁ vananityo babhūva ha ॥7॥
3.126.11: yat prāśya prasavet tasya patnī śakrasamaṁ sutam ॥11॥
3.126.12: taṁ nyasya vedyāṁ kalaśaṁ suṣupuste maharṣayaḥ,
3.126.15: tatastaṁ kalaśaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā jalapūrṇaṁ sa pārthivaḥ,
3.126.16: sa pītvā śītalaṁ toyaṁ pipāsārto mahīpatiḥ,
3.126.17: nistoyaṁ taṁ ca kalaśaṁ dadr̥śuḥ sarva eva te ॥17॥
3.126.19: na yuktamiti taṁ prāha bhagavān bhārgavastadā,
3.126.20: mayā hyatrāhitaṁ brahma tapa āsthāya dāruṇam,
3.126.22: abbhakṣaṇaṁ tvayā rājan na yuktaṁ kr̥tamadya vai ॥22॥
3.126.27: tato varṣaśate pūrṇe tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ,
vāmaṁ pārśvaṁ vinirbhidya sutaḥ sūrya iva sthitaḥ ॥27॥
3.126.28: niścakrāma mahātejā na ca taṁ mr̥tyurāviśat,
3.126.29: tato devā mahendraṁ tamapr̥cchan dhāsyatīti kim ॥29॥
3.126.31: māndhāteti ca nāmāsya cakruḥ sendrā divaukasaḥ ॥31॥
3.126.34: ājagavaṁ nāma dhanuḥ śataḥ śr̥ṅgodbhavāśca ye,
3.126.38: citacaityo mahātejā dharmān prāpya ca puṣkalān,
3.126.46: janma cāgryaṁ mahīpāla yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥46॥
3.126.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ māndhātopākhyāne ṣaḍviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥126॥
3.127.1: kathaṁ vīryaḥ sa rājābhūt somako vadatāṁ vara,
3.127.3: sa vai yatnena mahatā tāsu putraṁ mahīpatiḥ,
3.127.5: taṁ jātaṁ mātaraḥ sarvāḥ parivārya samāsata,
3.127.6: sa daṣṭo vyanadannādaṁ tena duḥkhena bālakaḥ ॥6॥
3.127.10: tvaramāṇaḥ sa cotthāya somakaḥ saha mantribhiḥ,
3.127.13: idaṁ bhāryāśataṁ brahman parīkṣya sadr̥śaṁ prabho,
putrārthinā mayā voḍhaṁ na tāsāṁ vidyate prajā ॥13॥
3.127.14: yatamānāsu sarvāsu kiṁ nu duḥkhamataḥ param ॥14॥
3.127.16: syāttu karma tathā yuktaṁ yena putraśataṁ bhavet,
mahatā laghunā vāpi karmaṇā duṣkareṇa vā ॥16॥
3.127.17: asti caitādr̥śaṁ karma yena putraśataṁ bhavet,
yadi śaknoṣi tat kartumatha vakṣyāmi somaka ॥17॥
3.127.18: kāryaṁ vā yadi vākāryaṁ yena putraśataṁ bhavet,
kr̥tameveti tad viddhi bhagavān prabravītu me ॥18॥
3.127.19: yajasva jantunā rājaṁstvaṁ mayā vitate kratau,
3.127.21: uttare cāsya sauvarṇaṁ lakṣma pārśve bhaviṣyati ॥21॥
3.127.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ jantūpākhyāne saptaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥127॥
3.128.1: brahman yad yad yathā kāryaṁ tat kuruṣva tathā tathā,
3.128.2: tataḥ sa yājayāmāsa somakaṁ tena jantunā,
3.128.3: rudantyaḥ karuṇaṁ vāpi gr̥hītvā dakṣiṇe kare ॥3॥
3.128.4: savye pāṇau gr̥hītvā tu yājako’pi sma karṣati,
3.128.5: viśasya cainaṁ vidhivad vapāmasya juhāva saḥ,
3.128.7: jajñe putraśataṁ pūrṇaṁ tāsu sarvāsu bhārata ॥7॥
3.128.8: sa tāsāmiṣṭa evāsīnna tathā te nijāḥ sutāḥ ॥8॥
3.128.9: tasmin putraśate cāgryaḥ sa babhūva guṇairapi ॥9॥
3.128.10: tataḥ sa lokamagamat somakasya guruḥ param,
atha kāle vyatīte tu somako’pyagamat param ॥10॥
3.128.11: atha taṁ narake ghore pacyamānaṁ dadarśa saḥ,
tamapr̥cchat kimarthaṁ tvaṁ narake pacyase dvija ॥11॥
3.128.12: tvaṁ mayā yājito rājaṁstasyedaṁ karmaṇaḥ phalam ॥12॥
3.128.14: imāni tava dr̥śyante phalāni vadatāṁ vara ॥14॥
3.128.16: narake vā dharmarāja karmaṇāsya samo hyaham,
3.128.18: sa cakāra tathā sarvaṁ rājā rājīvalocanaḥ,
kṣīṇapāpaśca tasmāt sa vimukto guruṇā saha ॥18॥
3.128.19: lebhe kāmāñśubhān rājan karmaṇā nirjitān svayam,
saha tenaiva vipreṇa guruṇā sa gurupriyaḥ ॥19॥
3.128.20: eṣa tasyāśramaḥ puṇyo ya eṣo’gre virājate,
kṣānta uṣyātra ṣaḍrātraṁ prāpnoti sugatiṁ naraḥ ॥20॥
3.128.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ jantūpākhyāne aṣṭāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥128॥
3.129.1: asmin kila svayaṁ rājanniṣṭavān vai prajāpatiḥ,
3.129.3: yajñaiśca tapasā caiva parāṁ siddhimavāpa saḥ,
3.129.10: etad vai te divāvr̥ttaṁ rātrau vr̥ttamato’nyathā ॥10॥
3.129.15: atra vai bharato rājā rājan kratubhiriṣṭavān,
3.130.2: evamāśīḥ prayuktā hi dakṣeṇa yajatā purā,
iha ye vai mariṣyanti te vai svargajito narāḥ ॥2॥
3.130.3: eṣā sarasvatī ramyā divyā caughavatī nadī,
3.130.4: praviṣṭā pr̥thivīṁ vīra mā niṣādā hi māṁ viduḥ ॥4॥
3.130.5: eṣa vai camasodbhedo yatra dr̥śyā sarasvatī,
3.130.8: eṣā ramyā vipāśā ca nadī paramapāvanī ॥8॥
3.130.14: kṣīṇe yuge tu kaunteya śarvasya saha pārṣadaiḥ ॥14॥
3.130.15: asmin sarasi satrairvai caitre māsi pinākinam ॥15॥
3.130.24: ūrū rājñaḥ samāsādya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt,
3.130.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ śyenakapotīye triṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥130॥
3.131.2: vihitaṁ bhakṣaṇaṁ rājan pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā,
3.131.4: apradāne paraṁ dharmaṁ kathaṁ śyena na paśyasi ॥4॥
3.131.6: yo hi kaścid dvijān hanyād gāṁ vā lokasya mātaram,
śaraṇāgataṁ ca tyajate tulyaṁ teṣāṁ hi pātakam ॥6॥
3.131.8: na tu bhojanamutsr̥jya śakyaṁ vartayituṁ ciram ॥8॥
3.131.10: rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotaṁ tvaṁ bahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi ॥10॥
3.131.11: dharmaṁ yo bādhate dharmo na sa dharmaḥ kudharma tat,
avirodhāt tu yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ satyavikrama ॥11॥
3.131.12: na bādhā vidyate yatra taṁ dharmaṁ samupācaret ॥12॥
3.131.15: tathā hi dharmasaṁyuktaṁ bahu citraṁ ca bhāṣase,
3.131.17: govr̥ṣo vā varāho vā mr̥go vā mahiṣo’pi vā,
3.131.18: na varāhaṁ na cokṣāṇaṁ na mr̥gān vividhāṁstathā,
3.131.21: rāṣṭraṁ śibīnāmr̥ddhaṁ vai dadāni tava khecara,
yaṁ vā kāmayase kāmaṁ śyena sarvaṁ dadāni te ॥21॥
3.131.22: tadācakṣva kariṣyāmi na hi dāsye kapotakam ॥22॥
3.131.23: uśīnara kapote te yadi sneho narādhipa,
3.131.24: yadā samaṁ kapotena tava māṁsaṁ nr̥pottama,
tadā deyaṁ tu tanmahyaṁ sā me tuṣṭirbhaviṣyati ॥24॥
3.131.25: tasmāt te’dya pradāsyāmi svamāṁsaṁ tulayā dhr̥tam ॥25॥
3.131.26: utkr̥tya sa svayaṁ māṁsaṁ rājā paramadharmavit,
3.131.28: na vidyate yadā māṁsaṁ kapotena samaṁ dhr̥tam,
3.131.30: yat te māṁsāni gātrebhya utkr̥ttāni viśāmpate,
3.131.31: tāvat kīrtiśca lokāśca sthāsyanti tava śāśvatāḥ ॥31॥
3.131.34: tatra vai satataṁ devā munayaśca sanātanāḥ,
3.131.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ śyenakapotīye ekatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥131॥
3.132.7: tat sarvaṁ me lomaśa śaṁsa tattvam ॥7॥
3.132.9: stāṁ ca jñātvā paricaryāṁ guruḥ saḥ,
tasmai prādāt sadya eva śrutaṁ ca
bhāryāṁ ca vai duhitaraṁ svāṁ sujātām ॥9॥
3.132.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāmaṣṭāvakrīye dvātriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥132॥
3.133.11: na tena sthaviro bhavati yenāsya palitaṁ śiraḥ,
bālo’pi yaḥ prajānāti taṁ devāḥ sthaviraṁ viduḥ ॥11॥
3.133.12: na hāyanairna palitairna vittena na bandhubhiḥ,
r̥ṣayaścakrire dharmaṁ yo’nūcānaḥ sa no mahān ॥12॥
3.133.14: saha vāde vivr̥ddhe tu bandinaṁ cāpi nirjitam ॥14॥
3.133.17: tvaṁ vai samrāṭ tvayi sarvaṁ samr̥ddham,
3.133.25: tat triṣaṣṭiśatāraṁ vai cakraṁ pātu sadāgati ॥25॥
3.133.27: mā sma te te gr̥he rājañchātravāṇāmapi dhruvam,
3.133.28: kiṁsvit suptaṁ na nimiṣati kiṁsvijjātaṁ na copati,
kasya sviddhr̥dayaṁ nāsti kiṁ svid vegena vardhate ॥28॥
3.133.29: matsyaḥ supto na nimiṣatyaṇḍaṁ jātaṁ na copati,
aśmano hr̥dayaṁ nāsti nadī vegena vardhate ॥29॥
3.133.30: na tvaṁ bālaḥ sthaviraḥ sammato me,
3.133.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāmaṣṭāvakrīye trayastriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥133॥
3.134.4: na caiva śailasya hi dr̥śyate vraṇaḥ ॥4॥
3.134.30: nānena jīvatā kaścidartho me bandinā nr̥pa,
3.134.33: yadahaṁ nāśakaṁ kartuṁ tat putraḥ kr̥tavān mama ॥33॥
3.134.34: uta vāviduṣo vidvān putro janaka jāyate ॥34॥
3.134.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāmaṣṭāvakrīye catustriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥134॥
3.135.2: alakṣmyā kila saṁyukto vr̥traṁ hatvā śacīpatiḥ,
3.135.7: apāṁ hradaṁ ca puṇyākhyaṁ bhr̥gutuṅgaṁ ca parvatam,
3.135.8: atra mānaṁ ca kaunteya krodhaṁ caiva vivarjaya ॥8॥
3.135.10: kimarthaṁ ca yavakrītaḥ putro’naśyata vai muneḥ ॥10॥
3.135.15: dr̥ṣṭvā ca satkr̥taṁ viprai raibhyaṁ putraiḥ sahānagha ॥15॥
3.135.21: kālena mahatā vedāḥ śakyā gurumukhād vibho,
prāptuṁ tasmādayaṁ yatnaḥ paramo me samāsthitaḥ ॥21॥
3.135.22: amārga eṣa viprarṣe yena tvaṁ yātumicchasi,
kiṁ vighātena te vipra gacchādhīhi gurormukhāt ॥22॥
3.135.25: taṁ tathā tapyamānaṁ tu tapastīvraṁ mahāmunim,
upetya balabhid devo vārayāmāsa vai punaḥ ॥25॥
3.135.26: pratibhāsyanti vai vedāstava caiva pituśca te ॥26॥
3.135.32: yadāsya vadato vākyaṁ na sa cakre dvijottamaḥ,
3.135.35: kimidaṁ vartate brahman kiṁ ca te ha cikīrṣitam,
atīva hi mahān yatnaḥ kriyate’yaṁ nirarthakaḥ ॥35॥
3.135.36: bandhiṣye setunā gaṅgāṁ sukhaḥ panthā bhaviṣyati,
kliśyate hi janastāta taramāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥36॥
3.135.41: tasmai prādād varānindra uktavān yān mahātapāḥ,
pratibhāsyanti te vedāḥ pitrā saha yathepsitāḥ ॥41॥
3.135.43: pratibhāsyanti vai vedā mama tātasya cobhayoḥ,
ati cānyān bhaviṣyāvo varā labdhāstadā mayā ॥43॥
3.135.46: bhavenmama suto’martya iti taṁ labdhavāṁśca saḥ ॥46॥
3.135.47: tasya prasādo vai devaiḥ kr̥to na tvamaraiḥ samaḥ,
3.135.50: vikurvāṇo munīnāṁ ca vyacarat sa mahīmimām,
3.135.51: tasyāpacakre medhāvī taṁ śaśāpa sa vīryavān,
bhava bhasmeti coktaḥ sa na bhasma samapadyata ॥51॥
3.135.53: sa nimitte vinaṣṭe tu mamāra sahasā śiśuḥ,
taṁ mr̥taṁ putramādāya vilalāpa tataḥ pitā ॥53॥
3.135.54: ūcurvedavidaḥ sarve gāthāṁ yāṁ tāṁ nibodha me ॥54॥
3.135.56: kṣiprameva vinaśyanti yathā na syāt tathā bhavān ॥56॥
3.135.57: eṣa raibhyo mahāvīryaḥ putrau cāsya tathāvidhau,
taṁ yathā putra nābhyeṣi tathā kuryāstvatandritaḥ ॥57॥
3.135.58: sa hi kruddhaḥ samarthastvāṁ putra pīḍayituṁ ruṣā,
3.135.59: evaṁ kariṣye mā tāpaṁ tāta kārṣīḥ kathañcana,
yathā hi me bhavān mānyastathā raibhyaḥ pitā mama ॥59॥
3.135.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ yavakrītopākhyāne pañcatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥135॥
3.136.6: rudatīṁ ca snuṣāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhāryāmārtāṁ parāvasoḥ,
3.136.11: abrūtāṁ tau tadā raibhyaṁ kiṁ kāryaṁ karavāvahai ॥11॥
3.136.15: yavakrīḥ sahasotthāya prādravad yena vai saraḥ ॥15॥
3.136.19: nigr̥hītaṁ tu śūdreṇa yavakrītaṁ sa rākṣasaḥ,
3.136.20: yavakrītaṁ sa hatvā tu rākṣaso raibhyamāgamat,
3.136.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ yavakrītopākhyāne ṣaṭtriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥136॥
3.137.2: taṁ sma dr̥ṣṭvā purā sarve pratyuttiṣṭhanti pāvakāḥ,
3.137.4: kiṁ nu me nāgnayaḥ śūdra pratinandanti darśanam,
tvaṁ cāpi na yathāpūrvaṁ kaccit kṣemamihāśrame ॥4॥
3.137.5: etadācakṣva me śīghraṁ na hi śuddhyati me manaḥ ॥5॥
3.137.6: tathā hi nihataḥ śete rākṣasena balīyasā ॥6॥
3.137.7: agnyāgāraṁ prati dvāri mayā dorbhyāṁ nivāritaḥ ॥7॥
3.137.13: yaḥ sa jānan mahātejā vr̥ddhasyaikaṁ mamātmajam,
3.137.16: sukhino vai narā yeṣāṁ jātyā putro na vidyate,
3.137.18: parāsuśca suto dr̥ṣṭaḥ śaptaśceṣṭaḥ sakhā mayā,
3.137.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ yavakrītopākhyāne saptatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥137॥
3.138.3: tatra tau samanujñātau pitrā kaunteya jagmatuḥ,
āśrame tvabhavad raibhyo bhāryā caiva parāvasoḥ ॥3॥
3.138.5: carantaṁ gahane’raṇye mene sa pitaraṁ mr̥gam ॥5॥
3.138.6: mr̥gaṁ tu manyamānena pitā vai tena hiṁsitaḥ,
3.138.7: tasya sa pretakāryāṇi kr̥tvā sarvāṇi bhārata,
3.138.8: idaṁ karma na śaktastvaṁ voḍhumekaḥ kathañcana,
mayā tu hiṁsitastāto manyamānena taṁ mr̥gam ॥8॥
3.138.9: so’smadarthe vrataṁ tāta cara tvaṁ brahmahiṁsanam,
3.138.10: karotu vai bhavān satraṁ br̥haddyumnasya dhīmataḥ,
3.138.11: sa tasya brahmavadhyāyāḥ pāraṁ gatvā yudhiṣṭhira,
3.138.13: eṣa te brahmahā yajñaṁ mā draṣṭuṁ praviśediti,
3.138.14: tacchrutvaiva tadā rājā preṣyānāha sa viṭpate,
3.138.15: na mayā brahmahatyeyaṁ kr̥tetyāha punaḥ punaḥ,
3.138.16: mama bhrātrā kr̥tamidaṁ mayā sa parimokṣitaḥ ॥16॥
3.138.17: sa tathā pravadan krodhāt taiśca preṣyaiḥ prabhāṣitaḥ,
3.138.22: evamastviti taṁ devāḥ procuścāpi varān daduḥ ॥22॥
3.138.24: samadhītaṁ mayā brahma vratāni caritāni ca,
kathaṁ ca raibhyaḥ śakto māmadhīyānaṁ tapasvinam ॥24॥
3.138.25: maivaṁ kr̥thā yavakrīta yathā vadasi vai mune,
r̥te gurumadhītā hi sukhaṁ vedāstvayā purā ॥25॥
3.138.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ yavakrītopākhyāne aṣṭātriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥138॥
3.139.1: uśīrabījaṁ mainākaṁ giriṁ śvetaṁ ca bhārata,
3.139.3: etad vai mānuṣeṇādya na śakyaṁ draṣṭumadbhutam,
3.139.5: śvetaṁ giriṁ pravekṣyāmo mandaraṁ caiva parvatam,
3.139.9: durgamāḥ parvatāḥ pārtha samādhiṁ paramaṁ kuru ॥9॥
3.139.10: taiḥ sameṣyāma kaunteya saṁyato vikrameṇa ca ॥10॥
3.139.11: yatra devā samāyānti viśālā yatra bhārata ॥11॥
3.139.13: tān vigāhasva pārthādya tapasā ca damena ca,
3.139.14: svasti te varuṇo rājā yamaśca samitiñjayaḥ,
gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva parvataśca dadhātu te ॥14॥
3.139.18: kr̥ṣṇāṁ ca sarve rakṣata mā pramādam,
3.139.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ kailāsādigiripraveśe ekonacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥139॥
3.140.1: agninā tapasā caiva śakyaṁ gantuṁ vr̥kodara ॥1॥
3.140.2: tato balaṁ ca dākṣyaṁ ca saṁśrayasva vr̥kodara ॥2॥
3.140.3: r̥ṣestvayā śrutaṁ vākyaṁ kailāsaṁ parvataṁ prati,
buddhyā prapaśya kaunteya kathaṁ kr̥ṣṇā gamiṣyati ॥3॥
3.140.4: athavā sahadevena dhaumyena ca samaṁ vibho,
3.140.5: rathairaśvaiśca ye cānye viprāḥ kleśāsahāḥ pathi,
3.140.10: kiṁ punaḥ sahadevaṁ ca māṁ ca kr̥ṣṇāṁ ca bhārata,
dvijāḥ kāmaṁ nivartantāṁ sarve ca paricārakāḥ ॥10॥
3.140.11: sūtāḥ paurogavāścaiva yaṁ ca manyeta no bhavān,
3.140.14: na jātu vinivarteta manojño hyahamasya vai,
3.140.15: sarve lālasabhūtāḥ sma tasmād yāsyāmahe saha,
3.140.16: padbhireva gamiṣyāmo mā rājan vimanā bhava,
ahaṁ vahiṣye pāñcālīṁ yatra yatra na śakṣyati ॥16॥
3.140.17: iti me vartate buddhirmā rājan vimanā bhava,
3.140.18: yat tvamutsahase voḍhuṁ pāñcālīṁ ca yaśasvinīm ॥18॥
3.140.19: yamajau cāpi bhadraṁ te naitadanyatra vidyate,
balaṁ tava yaśaścaiva dharmaḥ kīrtiśca vardhatām ॥19॥
3.140.20: yat tvamutsahase netuṁ bhrātarau saha kr̥ṣṇayā,
mā te glānirmahābāho mā ca te’stu parābhavaḥ ॥20॥
3.140.21: gamiṣyāmi na santāpaḥ kāryo māṁ prati bhārata ॥21॥
3.140.22: tapasā caiva kaunteya sarve yokṣyāmahe vayam ॥22॥
3.140.23: ahaṁ ca tvaṁ ca kaunteya drakṣyāmaḥ śvetavāhanam ॥23॥
3.140.29: te śanaiḥ prādravan sarve kr̥ṣṇayā saha pāṇḍavāḥ,
3.140.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ gandhamādanapraveśe catvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥140॥
3.141.1: bhīmasena yamau cobhau pāñcāli ca nibodhata,
nāsti bhūtasya nāśo vai paśyatāsmān vanecarān ॥1॥
3.141.4: yājñasenyāḥ parāmarśaḥ sa ca vīra dahatyuta ॥4॥
3.141.6: tīrthāni caiva ramyāṇi vanāni ca sarāṁsi ca,
3.141.7: yanna paśyāmi bībhatsuṁ tena tapye vr̥kodara ॥7॥
3.141.8: na paśyāmi mahābāhuṁ tena tapye vr̥kodara ॥8॥
3.141.9: na paśyāmi kuruśreṣṭha tena tapye vr̥kodara ॥9॥
3.141.11: yaḥ sa śakrādanavaro vīryeṇa draviṇena ca,
3.141.17: ratnāni yasya vīryeṇa divyānyāsan purā mama,
3.141.18: yasya bāhubalād vīra sabhā cāsīt purā mama,
3.141.19: ajeyamamitaṁ yuddhe taṁ na paśyāmi phālgunam ॥19॥
3.141.21: yasya bāhubale tulyaḥ prabhāve ca purandaraḥ,
jave vāyurmukhe somaḥ krodhe mr̥tyuḥ sanātanaḥ ॥21॥
3.141.22: te vayaṁ taṁ naravyāghraṁ sarve vīra didr̥kṣavaḥ,
3.141.25: na ca yānavatā śakyo gantuṁ deśo vr̥kodara,
3.141.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ gandhamādanapraveśe ekacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥141॥
3.142.1: tīrthāni caiva śrīmanti spr̥ṣṭaṁ ca salilaṁ karaiḥ ॥1॥
3.142.3: ayaṁ devanivāso vai gantavyo vo bhaviṣyati,
3.142.4: eṣā śivajalā puṇyā yāti saumya mahānadī,
3.142.6: atra sāma sma gāyanti sāmagāḥ puṇyaniḥsvanāḥ,
3.142.8: candramāḥ saha sūryeṇa jyotīṁṣi ca grahaiḥ saha,
3.142.10: etāṁ bhagavatīṁ devīṁ bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi,
3.142.11: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā lomaśasya mahātmanaḥ,
3.142.12: abhivādya ca te sarve pāṇḍavā dharmacāriṇaḥ,
3.142.14: tān praṣṭukāmān vijñāya pāṇḍavān sa tu lomaśaḥ,
3.142.19: nityameva durādharṣo dharṣayan sa diteḥ sutaḥ ॥19॥
3.142.20: sa tu tasya balaṁ jñātvā dharme ca caritavratam,
3.142.23: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā varadaṁ devaṁ viṣṇuṁ devagaṇeśvaram ॥23॥
3.142.24: prāñjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā namaskr̥tya ca vajrabhr̥t,
prāha vākyaṁ tatastattvaṁ yatastasya bhayaṁ bhavet ॥24॥
3.142.25: jānāmi te bhayaṁ śakra daityendrānnarakāt tataḥ,
3.142.27: sa papāta tato bhūmau girirāja ivāhataḥ ॥27॥
3.142.29: naṣṭā vasumatī kr̥tsnā pātāle caiva majjitā,
3.142.30: kathaṁ tena sureśena naṣṭā vasumatī tadā ॥30॥
3.142.31: kena caiva prakāreṇa jagato dharaṇī dhruvā ॥31॥
3.142.32: kasya caiva prabhāvāddhi yojanānāṁ śataṁ gatā ॥32॥
3.142.33: śrotuṁ vistaraśaḥ sarvaṁ tvaṁ hi tasya pratiśrayaḥ ॥33॥
3.142.36: na tatra mriyate kaścijjāyate vā tathāpyuta ॥36॥
3.142.37: gavāśvaṁ ca mr̥gāścaiva sarve te piśitāśanāḥ ॥37॥
3.142.40: nārāyaṇaṁ varaṁ devaṁ prapannā śaraṇaṁ gatā ॥40॥
3.142.41: bhāreṇāsmi samākrāntā na śaknomi sma vartitum ॥41॥
3.142.42: śaraṇāgatāsmi te deva prasādaṁ kuru me vibho ॥42॥
3.142.44: na te mahi bhayaṁ kāryaṁ bhārārte vasudhāriṇi,
ahamevaṁ tathā kurmi yathā laghvī bhaviṣyasi ॥44॥
3.142.45: sa tāṁ visarjayitvā tu vasudhāṁ śailakuṇḍalām,
3.142.46: dhūmaṁ ca jvalayam̐llakṣmyā tatra deśe vyavardhata ॥46॥
3.142.49: na paryavasthitaḥ kaścid devo vā mānuṣo’pi vā ॥49॥
3.142.52: lokāḥ saṅkṣubhitāḥ sarve vyākulaṁ ca carācaram,
3.142.53: saiṣā vasumatī kr̥tsnā yojanānāṁ śataṁ gatā,
kimetad kiṁ prabhāveṇa yenedaṁ vyākulaṁ jagat,
akhyātu no bhavān śīghraṁ visañjñāḥ smeha sarvaśaḥ ॥53॥
3.142.54: asurebhyo bhayaṁ nāsti yuṣmākaṁ kutracit kvacit,
3.142.56: yaiṣā vasumatī kr̥tsnā yojanānāṁ śataṁ gatā,
3.142.57: evaṁ bhavanto jānantu chidyatāṁ saṁśayaśca vaḥ ॥57॥
3.142.58: kva tad bhūtaṁ vasumatīṁ samuddharati hr̥ṣṭavat,
taṁ deśaṁ bhagavan brūhi tatra yāsyāmahe vayam ॥58॥
3.142.59: hanta gacchata bhadraṁ vo nandane paśyata sthitam,
3.142.62: tato dr̥ṣṭvā mahātmānaṁ śrutvā cāmantrya cāmarāḥ,
3.142.63: śrutvā tu tāṁ kathāṁ sarve pāṇḍavā janamejaya,
3.142.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ gandhamādanapraveśe dvicatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥142॥
3.143.8: pr̥thivīṁ cāntarikṣaṁ ca dyāṁ caiva sahasā’’vr̥ṇot ॥8॥
3.143.9: na sma prajñāyate kiñcidāvr̥te vyomni reṇunā,
3.143.12: dyauḥ svit patati kiṁ bhūmirdīryate parvato nu kim,
iti te menire sarve pavanenāpi mohitāḥ ॥12॥
3.143.13: te pathānantarān vr̥kṣān valmīkān viṣamāṇi ca,
3.143.17: mandībhūte tu pavane tasmin rajasi śāmyati,
3.143.22: tasminnuparate śabde vāte ca samatāṁ gate,
3.143.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ gandhamādanapraveśe tricatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥143॥
3.144.2: śrāntā duḥkhaparītā ca vātavarṣeṇa tena ca,
3.144.4: papāta sahasā bhūmau vepantī kadalī yathā ॥4॥
3.144.8: rājā tu vacanāt tasya bhr̥śaṁ duḥkhasamanvitaḥ,
3.144.11: sukumārau kathaṁ pādau mukhaṁ ca kamalaprabham,
3.144.13: sukhaṁ prāpsyasi kalyāṇi pāṇḍavān prāpya vai patīn,
3.144.14: śete nipatitā bhūmau pāpasya mama karmabhiḥ ॥14॥
3.144.18: pāñcālī sukhamāsādya lebhe cetaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ॥18॥
3.144.22: teṣu kr̥ṣṇā mahābāho kathaṁ nu vicariṣyati ॥22॥
3.144.23: tvāṁ rājan rājaputrīṁ ca yamau ca puruṣarṣabha,
svayaṁ neṣyāmi rājendra mā viṣāde manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥23॥
3.144.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ gandhamādanapraveśe catuścatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥144॥
3.145.1: bhakto’smānaurasaḥ putro bhīma gr̥hṇātu mā ciram ॥1॥
3.145.4: tvaṁ ca kāmagamastāta balavān vaha tāṁ khaga ॥4॥
3.145.5: gaccha nīcikayā gatyā yathā caināṁ na pīḍayeḥ ॥5॥
3.145.6: dharmarājaṁ ca dhaumyaṁ ca kr̥ṣṇāṁ ca yamajau tathā,
3.145.7: anye ca śataśaḥ śūrā vihaṅgāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ,
sarvān vo brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṁ vakṣyanti sahitānagha ॥7॥
3.145.9: svenaiva sa prabhāveṇa dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ ॥9॥
3.145.39: prītaḥ svargopamaṁ puṇyaṁ pāṇḍavaḥ saha kr̥ṣṇayā ॥39॥
3.145.43: mudā yuktā mahātmāno remire tatra te tadā ॥43॥
3.145.49: hlādayan pāṇḍavān sarvān draupadyā sahitān prabho ॥49॥
3.145.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ gandhamādanapraveśe pañcacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥145॥
3.146.9: priyāyāḥ priyakāmaḥ sa prāyād bhīmo mahābalaḥ ॥9॥
3.146.12: na glānirna ca vaiklavyaṁ na bhayaṁ na ca sambhramaḥ ॥12॥
3.146.34: nakulaṁ sahadevaṁ ca na mokṣyati yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
3.146.36: kampayan medinīṁ padbhyāṁ nirghāta iva parvasu ॥36॥
3.146.44: śukāḥ puṁskokilāḥ krauñcā visañjñā bhejire diśaḥ ॥44॥
3.146.47: gajenānyān gajāñchrīmān siṁhaṁ siṁhena vā vibhuḥ ॥47॥
3.146.53: cikṣepa tarasā bhīmaḥ samantād balināṁ varaḥ,
3.146.61: dadhmau ca śaṅkhaṁ svanavat sarvaprāṇena pāṇḍavaḥ,
3.146.64: mukto virāvaḥ sumahān parvato yena pūritaḥ ॥64॥
3.146.65: taṁ tu nādaṁ tataḥ śrutvā muktaṁ vāraṇapuṅgavaiḥ,
bhrātaraṁ bhīmasenaṁ tu vijñāya hanumān kapiḥ ॥65॥
3.146.66: anena hi pathā mā vai gacchediti vicārya saḥ ॥66॥
3.146.68: mātra prāpsyati śāpaṁ vā dharṣaṇāṁ veti pāṇḍavaḥ,
3.146.87: nanu nāma tvayā kāryā dayā bhūteṣu jānatā ॥87॥
3.146.90: na tvaṁ dharmaṁ vijānāsi budhā nopāsitāstvayā,
3.146.91: brūhi kastvaṁ kimarthaṁ vā kimidaṁ vanamāgataḥ,
3.146.92: kva ca tvayādya gantavyaṁ prabrūhi puruṣarṣabha,
3.146.93: vinā siddhagatiṁ vīra gatiratra na vidyate,
3.146.94: kāruṇyāt tvāmahaṁ vīra vārayāmi nibodha me,
nātaḥ paraṁ tvayā śakyaṁ gantumāśvasihi prabho ॥94॥
3.146.96: bhakṣayitvā nivartasva mā vr̥thā prāpsyase vadham,
grāhyaṁ yadi vaco mahyaṁ hitaṁ manujapuṅgava ॥96॥
3.146.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ bhīmakadalīṣaṇḍapraveśe ṣaṭcatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥146॥
3.147.2: ko bhavān kiṁ nimittaṁ vā vānaraṁ vapurāsthitaḥ,
3.147.4: sa vākyaṁ kuruvīrasya smitena pratigr̥hya tat,
3.147.5: vānaro’haṁ na te mārgaṁ pradāsyāmi yathepsitam,
sādhu gaccha nivartasva mā tvaṁ prāpsyasi vaiśasam ॥5॥
3.147.6: vaiśasaṁ vāstu yadvānyanna tvāṁ pr̥cchāmi vānara,
prayaccha mārgamuttiṣṭha mā mattaḥ prāpsyase vyathām ॥6॥
3.147.9: krameyaṁ tvāṁ giriṁ caiva hanūmāniva sāgaram ॥9॥
3.147.10: ka eṣa hanumān nāma sāgaro yena laṅghitaḥ,
pr̥cchāmi tvāṁ naraśreṣṭha kathyatāṁ yadi śakyate ॥10॥
3.147.13: sa me bhrātā mahāvīryastulyo’haṁ tasya tejasā,
bale parākrame yuddhe śakto’haṁ tava nigrahe ॥13॥
3.147.14: uttiṣṭha dehi me mārgaṁ paśya me cādya pauruṣam,
3.147.21: svinnagātro’bhavad bhīmo na coddhartuṁ śaśāka tam ॥21॥
3.147.24: siddho vā yadi vā devo gandharvo vātha guhyakaḥ,
pr̥ṣṭaḥ san kāmyayā brūhi kastvaṁ vānararūpadhr̥k ॥24॥
3.147.25: na ced guhyaṁ mahābāho śrotavyaṁ ced bhavenmama,
śiṣyavat tvāṁ tu pr̥cchāmi upapanno’smi te’nagha ॥25॥
3.147.28: sūryaputraṁ ca sugrīvaṁ śakraputraṁ ca vālinam,
3.147.30: nikr̥taḥ sa tato bhrātrā kasmiṁścit kāraṇāntare,
3.147.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ hanumadbhīmasaṁvāde saptacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥147॥
3.148.1: hr̥tadāraḥ saha bhrātrā patnīṁ mārgan sa rāghavaḥ,
3.148.3: sa rājyaṁ prāpya sugrīvaḥ sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇe,
3.148.4: sītāṁ mārgan mahābāho prayāto dakṣiṇāṁ diśam ॥4॥
3.148.10: sa buddhipūrvaṁ sainyasya baddhvā setuṁ mahodadhau ॥10॥
3.148.11: tato rāmeṇa vīreṇa hatvā tān sarvarākṣasān ॥11॥
3.148.14: tayaiva sahitaḥ sādhvyā patnyā rāmo mahāyaśāḥ ॥14॥
3.148.17: yāvad rāma katheyaṁ te bhavellokeṣu śatruhan,
3.148.18: upatiṣṭhanti divyā hi bhogā bhīma yathepsitāḥ ॥18॥
3.148.20: tasya vīrasya caritaṁ gāyanto ramayanti mām ॥20॥
3.148.22: dharṣayed vā śaped vāpi mā kaściditi bhārata,
divyo devapatho hyeṣa nātra gacchanti mānuṣāḥ,
3.148.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ hanumadbhīmasaṁvāde aṣṭacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥148॥
3.149.4: yat te tadā’’sīt plavataḥ sāgaraṁ makarālayam,
3.149.5: evaṁ tuṣṭo bhaviṣyāmi śraddhāsyāmi ca te vacaḥ,
3.149.6: na tacchakyaṁ tvayā draṣṭuṁ rūpaṁ nānyena kenacit,
kālāvasthā tadā hyanyā vartate sā na sāmpratam ॥6॥
3.149.7: ayaṁ pradhvaṁsanaḥ kālo nādya tad rūpamasti me ॥7॥
3.149.8: bhūmirnadyo nagāḥ śailāḥ siddhā devā maharṣayaḥ,
kālaṁ samanuvartante yathā bhāvā yuge yuge ॥8॥
3.149.9: tadalaṁ bata tad rūpaṁ draṣṭuṁ kurukulodvaha,
3.149.10: yugasaṅkhyāṁ samācakṣva ācāraṁ ca yuge yuge,
3.149.11: kr̥taṁ nāma yugaṁ tāta yatra dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ,
kr̥tameva na kartavyaṁ tasmin kāle yugottame ॥11॥
3.149.12: na tatra dharmāḥ sīdanti kṣīyante na ca vai prajāḥ,
tataḥ kr̥tayugaṁ nāma kālena guṇatāṁ gatam ॥12॥
3.149.13: nāsan kr̥tayuge tāta tadā na krayavikrayaḥ ॥13॥
3.149.14: abhidhyāya phalaṁ tatra dharmaḥ saṁnyāsa eva ca ॥14॥
3.149.15: nāsūyā nāpi ruditaṁ na darpo nāpi vaikr̥tam ॥15॥
3.149.16: na vigrahaḥ kutastandrī na dveṣo na ca paiśunam,
na bhayaṁ nāpi santāpo na cerṣyā na ca matsaraḥ ॥16॥
3.149.17: tataḥ paramakaṁ brahma sā gatiryogināṁ parā,
3.149.23: tretāmapi nibodha tvaṁ yasmin satraṁ pravartate ॥23॥
3.149.24: pādena hrasate dharmo raktatāṁ yāti cācyutaḥ,
3.149.25: tato yajñāḥ pravartante dharmāśca vividhāḥ kriyāḥ,
3.149.27: dvāpare ca yuge dharmo dvibhāgonaḥ pravartate,
viṣṇurvai pītatāṁ yāti caturdhā veda eva ca ॥27॥
3.149.29: evaṁ śāstreṣu bhinneṣu bahudhā nīyate kriyā,
3.149.36: dharme vyāvartamāne tu loko vyāvartate punaḥ ॥36॥
3.149.37: loke kṣīṇe kṣayaṁ yānti bhāvā lokapravartakāḥ,
3.149.38: etat kaliyugaṁ nāma acirād yat pravartate,
3.149.40: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi,
3.149.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ kadalīṣaṇḍe hanumadbhīmasaṁvāde ekonapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥149॥
3.150.2: tad rūpaṁ darśayāmāsa yad vai sāgaralaṅghane ॥2॥
3.150.3: bhrātuḥ priyamabhīpsan vai cakāra sumahad vapuḥ,
3.150.7: visiṣmiye tadā bhīmo jahr̥ṣe ca punaḥ punaḥ,
3.150.9: vardhe’haṁ cāpyato bhūyo yāvanme manasi sthitam,
3.150.12: dr̥ṣṭaṁ pramāṇaṁ vipulaṁ śarīrasyāsya te vibho,
3.150.13: na hi śaknomi tvāṁ draṣṭuṁ divākaramivoditam,
3.150.14: vismayaścaiva me vīra sumahān manaso’dya vai,
3.150.16: na hi te kiñcidaprāpyaṁ mārutātmaja vidyate,
tava naikasya paryāpto rāvaṇaḥ sagaṇo yudhi ॥16॥
3.150.19: mayā tu nihate tasmin rāvaṇe lokakaṇṭake,
3.150.20: tena vīreṇa taṁ hatvā sagaṇaṁ rākṣasādhamam,
3.150.21: tad gaccha vipulaprajña bhrātuḥ priyahite rataḥ,
3.150.23: na ca te tarasā kāryaḥ kusumāvacayaḥ svayam,
3.150.24: daivatāni prasādaṁ hi bhaktyā kurvanti bhārata ॥24॥
3.150.25: mā tāta sāhasaṁ kārṣīḥ svadharmaṁ paripālaya,
svadharmasthaḥ paraṁ dharmaṁ budhyasva gamayasva ca ॥25॥
3.150.32: sā ced dharmakr̥tā na syāt trayīdharmamr̥te bhuvi,
3.150.36: śuśrūṣā ca dvijātīnāṁ śūdrāṇāṁ dharma ucyate,
3.150.40: tasmād deśe ca durge ca śatrumitrabaleṣu ca,
nityaṁ cāreṇa boddhavyaṁ sthānaṁ vr̥ddhiḥ kṣayastathā ॥40॥
3.150.43: sumantritena yā siddhistāṁ dvijaiḥ saha mantrayet ॥43॥
3.150.44: striyā mūḍhena bālena lubdhena laghunāpi vā,
3.150.45: mantrayet saha vidvadbhiḥ śaktaiḥ karmāṇi kārayet,
3.150.46: strīṣu klībān niyuñjīta krūrān krūreṣu karmasu ॥46॥
3.150.47: buddhiḥ karmasu vijñeyā ripūṇāṁ ca balābalam ॥47॥
3.150.49: nigrahe pragrahe samyag yadā rājā pravartate,
3.150.50: eṣa te’bhihitaḥ pārtha ghoro dharmo duranvayaḥ,
3.150.52: kṣatraṁ yāti tathā svargaṁ bhuvi nigrahapālanaiḥ,
3.150.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ hanumadbhīmasenasaṁvāde pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥150॥
3.151.1: tataḥ saṁhr̥tya vipulaṁ tad vapuḥ kāmataḥ kr̥tam,
3.151.3: balaṁ cātibalo mene na me’sti sadr̥śo mahān,
3.151.8: mānuṣaṁ gātrasaṁsparśaṁ gatvā bhīma tvayā saha,
3.151.9: bhrātr̥tvaṁ tvaṁ puraskr̥tya varaṁ varaya bhārata,
3.151.10: śilayā nagaraṁ vāpi marditavyaṁ mayā yadi ॥10॥
3.151.12: bhīmasenastu tad vākyaṁ śrutvā tasya mahātmanaḥ,
3.151.13: svasti te’stu mahābāho kāmaye tvāṁ prasīda me ॥13॥
3.151.14: sanāthāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve tvayā nāthena vīryavan,
tavaiva tejasā sarvān vijeṣyāmo vayaṁ parān ॥14॥
3.151.18: śatrūṇāṁ ye prāṇaharāḥ sukhaṁ yena haniṣyatha,
3.151.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ gandhamādanapraveśe hanumadbhīmasaṁvāde ekapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥151॥
3.152.1: gate tasmin harivare bhīmo’pi balināṁ varaḥ,
3.152.6: saśaṣpakavalaiḥ śrīmān pathi dr̥ṣṭvā drutaṁ yayau ॥6॥
3.152.14: tad dr̥ṣṭvā labdhakāmaḥ sa manasā pāṇḍunandanaḥ,
3.152.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ saugandhikāharaṇe dvipañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥152॥
3.153.5: dadarśa vimalaṁ toyaṁ pibaṁśca bahu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥5॥
3.153.10: tāṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvaiva kaunteyo bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ,
babhūva paramaprīto divyaṁ samprekṣya tat saraḥ ॥10॥
3.153.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ saugandhikāharaṇe tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥153॥
3.154.1: viśālāṁ badarīṁ prāpto bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha rākṣasāḥ ॥1॥
3.154.8: āmantrya yakṣarājaṁ vai tataḥ piba harasva ca,
3.154.10: na hi yācanti rājāna eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ,
3.154.11: iyaṁ ca nalinī ramyā jātā parvatanirjhare,
3.154.12: evaṁ gateṣu dravyeṣu kaḥ kaṁ yācitumarhati ॥12॥
3.154.15: kadarthīkr̥tya tu sa tān rākṣasān bhīmavikramaḥ,
3.154.19: satye ca dharme ca rataḥ sadaiva
3.154.21: te tasya vīryaṁ ca balaṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvā
3.154.25: bhīmasya vīryaṁ ca balaṁ ca saṅkhye
3.154.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ saugandhikāharaṇe catuṣpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥154॥
3.155.4: cacāla pr̥thivī cāpi pāṁsuvarṣaṁ papāta ca ॥4॥
3.155.6: anye ca bahavo bhīmā utpātāstatra jajñire,
3.155.10: kaccit kva bhīmaḥ pāñcāli kiñcit kr̥tyaṁ cikīrṣati ॥10॥
3.155.14: api cokto mayā vīro yadi paśyerbahūnyapi,
3.155.15: sa tu nūnaṁ mahābāhuḥ priyārthaṁ mama pāṇḍavaḥ,
3.155.18: vyaktaṁ dūramito bhīmaḥ praviṣṭa iti me matiḥ,
ciraṁ ca tasya kālo’yaṁ sa ca vāyusamo jave ॥18॥
3.155.23: te sarve tvaritā gatvā dadr̥śuḥ śubhakānanām,
3.155.24: taṁ ca bhīmaṁ mahātmānaṁ tasyāstīre manasvinam,
3.155.25: taṁ ca bhīmaṁ mahātmānaṁ tasyāstīre vyavasthitam ॥25॥
3.155.27: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā dharmarājastu pariṣvajya punaḥ punaḥ ॥27॥
3.155.28: uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā kaunteya kimidaṁ kr̥tam,
sāhasaṁ bata bhadraṁ te devānāmatha cāpriyam ॥28॥
3.155.29: punarevaṁ na kartavyaṁ mama cedicchasi priyam,
anuśiṣya tu kaunteyaṁ padmāni parigr̥hya ca ॥29॥
3.155.31: te dr̥ṣṭvā dharmarājānaṁ maharṣiṁ cāpi lomaśam ॥31॥
3.155.32: vinayena natāḥ sarve praṇipatya ca bhārata ॥32॥
3.155.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ saugandhikāharaṇe pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥155॥
3.156.2: dr̥ṣṭāni tīrthānyasmābhiḥ puṇyāni ca śivāni ca,
manaso hlādanīyāni vanāni ca pr̥thak pr̥thak ॥2॥
3.156.4: rājarṣīṇāṁ ca caritaṁ kathāśca vividhāḥ śubhāḥ ॥4॥
3.156.5: śr̥ṇvānāstatra tatra sma āśrameṣu śiveṣu ca,
3.156.6: arcitāḥ satataṁ devāḥ puṣpairadbhiḥ sadā ca vaḥ,
3.156.7: parvateṣu ca ramyeṣu sarveṣu ca sarassu ca,
3.156.16: atikramya ca taṁ pārtha tvārṣṭiṣeṇāśrame vaseḥ,
tato drakṣyasi kaunteya niveśaṁ dhanadasya ca ॥16॥
3.156.18: śrutvā tu divyāmākāśād vācaṁ sarve visismiyuḥ,
3.156.20: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā pratijagrāha tad vacaḥ,
3.156.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi tīrthayātrāparvaṇi lomaśatīrthayātrāyāṁ punarnaranārāyaṇāśramāgamane ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥156॥
3.157.3: jahāra dharmarājānaṁ yamau kr̥ṣṇāṁ ca rākṣasaḥ,
3.157.4: iti bruvan pāṇḍaveyān paryupāste sma nityadā,
3.157.5: duṣṭātmā pāpabuddhiḥ sa nāmnā khyāto jaṭāsuraḥ ॥5॥
3.157.6: bubudhe na ca taṁ pāpaṁ bhasmacchannamivānalam ॥6॥
3.157.8: snātuṁ vinirgatān dr̥ṣṭvā puṣpārthaṁ ca tapodhanān ॥8॥
3.157.10: prātiṣṭhata sa duṣṭātmā trīn gr̥hītvā ca pāṇḍavān,
3.157.11: vikramya kauśikaṁ khaḍgaṁ mokṣayitvā grahaṁ ripoḥ,
ākrandad bhīmasenaṁ vai yena yāto mahābalaḥ ॥11॥
3.157.12: dharmaste hīyate mūḍha na tattvaṁ samavekṣase ॥12॥
3.157.13: dharmaṁ te samavekṣante rakṣāṁsi ca viśeṣataḥ ॥13॥
3.157.14: dharmasya rākṣasā mūlaṁ dharmaṁ te viduruttamam,
etat parīkṣya sarvaṁ tvaṁ samīpe sthātumarhasi ॥14॥
3.157.21: drogdhavyaṁ na ca mitreṣu na viśvasteṣu karhicit ॥21॥
3.157.22: yeṣāṁ cānnāni bhuñjīta yatra ca syāt pratiśrayaḥ,
3.157.26: adharmaṁ cāpyakīrtiṁ ca loke prāpsyasi kevalam,
3.157.28: sa tu bhārābhibhūtātmā na tathā śīghrago’bhavat,
athābravīd draupadīṁ ca nakulaṁ ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥28॥
3.157.29: mā bhaiṣṭa rākṣasānmūḍhād gatirasya mayā hr̥tā,
3.157.30: asmin muhurte samprāpte na bhaviṣyati rākṣasaḥ,
3.157.32: eṣa cāsmān vayaṁ cainaṁ yuddhyamānāḥ parantapa ॥32॥
3.157.35: bho bho rākṣasa tiṣṭhasva sahadevo’smi pāṇḍavaḥ ॥35॥
3.157.36: hatvā vā māṁ nayasvaināṁ hato vādyeha svapsyasi,
3.157.37: so’paśyad bhrātarau tatra draupadīṁ ca yaśasvinīm ॥37॥
3.157.38: kṣitisthaṁ sahadevaṁ ca kṣipantaṁ rākṣasaṁ tadā,
3.157.39: bhrātr̥̄ṁstān hriyato dr̥ṣṭvā draupadīṁ ca mahābalaḥ ॥39॥
3.157.41: āsthā tu tvayi me nāsti yato’si na hatastadā,
3.157.43: apakvasya ca kālena vadhastava na vidyate ॥43॥
3.157.46: yaṁ cāsi prasthito deśaṁ manaḥ pūrvaṁ gataṁ ca te,
na taṁ gantāsi gantāsi mārgaṁ bakahiḍimbayoḥ ॥46॥
3.157.47: bhīta utsr̥jya tān sarvān yuddhāya samupasthitaḥ ॥47॥
3.157.48: na me mūḍhā diśaḥ pāpa tvadarthaṁ me vilambitam ॥48॥
3.157.49: śrutā me rākṣasā ye ye tvayā vinihatā raṇe,
3.157.55: iṣṭena ca śape rājan sūdayiṣyāmi rākṣasam ॥55॥
3.157.62: tasmin deśe yadā vr̥kṣāḥ sarva eva nipātitāḥ,
3.157.68: tataḥ śrāntaṁ tu tad rakṣo bhīmasenabhujāhatam,
3.158.2: sa samānīya tān sarvān bhrātr̥̄nityabravīd vacaḥ,
draupadyā sahitān kāle saṁsmaran bhrātaraṁ jayam ॥2॥
3.158.13: tat tu rājā vacasteṣāṁ pratigr̥hya tapasvinām ॥13॥
3.158.15: tatra tatra mahātejā bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha suvrataḥ ॥15॥
3.158.16: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā bahūn kleśān vicintayan,
3.158.25: pāribarhaṁ ca taṁ śeṣaṁ paridāya mahātmane,
3.158.35: dhaumyaḥ kr̥ṣṇā ca pārthāśca lomaśaśca mahānr̥ṣiḥ,
3.158.64: vivareṣu tarūṇāṁ ca rucirān dadr̥śuśca te ॥64॥
3.158.71: mālā iva samāsaktāḥ śailānāṁ śikhareṣu ca ॥71॥
3.158.74: evaṁ krameṇa te vīrā vīkṣamāṇāḥ samantataḥ,
3.158.78: vane hyasmin manoramye divyāḥ kānanajā drumāḥ,
3.158.83: paśya bhīma śubhān deśān devākrīḍān samantataḥ ॥83॥
3.158.97: gītānāṁ samatālānāṁ tathā sāmnāṁ ca niḥsvanaḥ ॥97॥
3.158.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate āraṇyake parvaṇi yakṣayuddhaparvaṇi gandhamādanapraveśe aṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥158॥
3.159.2: tataḥ kr̥ṣṇā ca bhīmaśca yamau ca sutapasvinau,
3.159.6: nānr̥te kuruṣe bhāvaṁ kaccid dharme pravartase,
mātāpitrośca te vr̥ttiḥ kaccit pārtha na sīdati ॥6॥
3.159.7: kaccit te guravaḥ sarve vr̥ddhā vaidyāśca pūjitāḥ,
kaccinna kuruṣe bhāvaṁ pārtha pāpeṣu karmasu ॥7॥
3.159.8: sukr̥taṁ pratikartuṁ ca kacciddhātuṁ ca duṣkr̥tam,
3.159.9: yathārhaṁ mānitāḥ kaccit tvayā nandanti sādhavaḥ,
3.159.12: sve sve kila kule jāte putre naptari vā punaḥ,
pitaraḥ pitr̥lokasthāḥ śocanti ca hasanti ca ॥12॥
3.159.14: yasyaite pūjitāḥ pārtha tasyā lokāvubhau jitau ॥14॥
3.159.18: arajāṁsi ca vāsāṁsi vasānāḥ kauśikāni ca,
3.159.21: na kāryā vaḥ kathañcit syāt tatrābhigamane matiḥ ॥21॥
3.159.22: na cāpyataḥ paraṁ śakyaṁ gantuṁ bharatasattamāḥ,
3.159.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi yakṣayuddhaparvaṇi ārṣṭiṣeṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṁvāde ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāya ॥159॥
3.160.7: na hi me śr̥ṇvatastr̥ptirasti teṣāṁ viceṣṭitam,
3.160.11: rākṣasaiḥ saha sarvaiśca pūrvameva gataḥ prabho ॥11॥
3.160.14: te taiḥ saha kathāṁ cakrurdivyāṁ bharatasattamāḥ ॥14॥
3.160.18: tatra puṣpāṇi divyāni suhr̥dbhiḥ saha pāṇḍavāḥ,
3.160.22: hatā māyāvinaścogrā dhanuḥ prāptaṁ ca gāṇḍivam ॥22॥
3.160.23: tavāpi sumahat tejo mahad bāhubalaṁ ca te,
3.160.24: hitvā śailaṁ prapadyantāṁ bhīmasena diśo daśa ॥24॥
3.160.26: evaṁ praṇihitaṁ bhīma cirāt prabhr̥ti me manaḥ,
3.160.28: manasvī balavān dr̥pto mānī śūraśca pāṇḍavaḥ ॥28॥
3.160.31: sa kesarīva cotsiktaḥ prabhinna iva vāraṇaḥ,
3.160.34: na glānirna ca kātaryaṁ na vaiklavyaṁ na matsaraḥ,
3.160.49: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ teṣāṁ tasya ca bhārata,
3.160.60: sa tān dr̥ṣṭvā parāvr̥ttān smayamāna ivābravīt ॥60॥
3.160.69: sā bhujaṁ bhīmanirhrādā bhitvā bhīmasya dakṣiṇam,
3.160.71: pragr̥hyātha nadan bhīmaḥ śaikyāṁ sarvāyasīṁ gadām ॥71॥
3.160.76: hatvā rakṣaḥ kṣitiṁ prāpya kr̥tyeva nipapāta ha,
3.160.77: taṁ prekṣya nihataṁ bhūmau hataśeṣā niśācarāḥ,
bhīmamārtasvaraṁ kr̥tvā jagmuḥ prācīṁ diśaṁ prati ॥77॥
3.160.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi yakṣayuddhaparvaṇi maṇimadvadhe ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥160॥
3.161.2: dhaumyaḥ kr̥ṣṇā ca viprāśca sarve ca suhr̥dastathā,
3.161.10: sāhasād yadi vā mohād bhīma pāpamidaṁ kr̥tam,
naitat te sadr̥śaṁ vīra muneriva mr̥ṣā vadhaḥ ॥10॥
3.161.12: karmaṇāṁ pārtha pāpānāṁ sa phalaṁ vindate dhruvam,
punarevaṁ na kartavyaṁ mama cedicchasi priyam ॥12॥
3.161.18: rākṣasā nihatāḥ sarve tava deva puraḥsarāḥ,
3.161.19: ekena sahitāḥ saṅkhye raṇe krodhavaśā gaṇāḥ,
3.161.20: labdhaśeṣā vayaṁ muktā maṇimāṁste sakhā hataḥ ॥20॥
3.161.27: taṁ prayāntaṁ mahātmānaṁ sarve yakṣā dhanādhipam ॥27॥
3.161.32: devakāryaṁ cikīrṣan sa hr̥dayena tutoṣa ha ॥32॥
3.161.40: kāñcanīṁ śirasā bibhrad bhīmasenaḥ srajaṁ śubhām,
3.161.43: nirbhayaścāpi śailāgre vasa tvaṁ bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha ॥43॥
3.161.44: na ca manyustvayā kāryo bhīmasenasya pāṇḍava,
3.161.45: vrīḍā cātra na kartavyā sāhasaṁ yadidaṁ kr̥tam,
3.161.46: na bhīmasene kopo me prīto’smi bharatarṣabha,
3.161.51: dr̥ṣṭo hi mama saṅkleśaḥ purā pāṇḍavanandana,
3.161.53: idaṁ cāścaryabhūtaṁ me yat krodhāt tasya dhīmataḥ,
tadaiva tvaṁ na nirdagdhaḥ sabalaḥ sapadānugaḥ ॥53॥
3.161.61: tasmāt sahaibhiḥ sainyaiste vadhaṁ prāpsyati mānuṣāt,
tvaṁ cāpyebhirhataiḥ sainyaiḥ kleśaṁ prāpyeha durmatiḥ,
3.161.62: na śāpaṁ prāpyate ghoraṁ tat tavājñāṁ kariṣyati ॥62॥
3.161.63: eṣa śāpo mayā prāptaḥ prāk tasmādr̥ṣisattamāt,
sa bhīmena mahārāja bhrātrā tava vimokṣitaḥ ॥63॥
3.161.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi yakṣayuddhaparvaṇi kuberadarśane ekaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥161॥
3.162.2: dhr̥timantaśca dakṣāśca sve sve karmaṇi bhārata,
3.162.4: ya evaṁ vartate pārtha puruṣaḥ sarvakarmasu,
sa loke labhate vīra yaśaḥ pretya ca sadgatim ॥4॥
3.162.14: ataḥ paraṁ ca vo rājan drakṣyanti vanagocarāḥ,
upasthāsyanti vo rājan rakṣiṣyante ca vaḥ sadā ॥14॥
3.162.15: tathaiva cānnapānāni svādūni ca bahūni ca,
3.162.16: dharmasya tvaṁ yathā tāta yogotpanno nijaḥ sutaḥ ॥16॥
3.162.19: yāḥ kāścana matā loke svargyāḥ paramasampadaḥ,
3.162.21: na mohāt kurute jiṣṇuḥ karma pāṇḍava garhitam,
na pārthasya mr̥ṣoktāni kathayanti narā nr̥ṣu ॥21॥
3.162.28: tataḥ śaktiṁ gadāṁ khaḍgaṁ dhanuśca bharatarṣabhaḥ,
3.162.37: teṣāṁ hi śāpakālaḥ sa kr̥to’gastyena dhīmatā,
3.162.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi yakṣayuddhaparvaṇi kuberavākye dviṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥162॥
3.163.3: tato yudhiṣṭhiraṁ dhaumyo gr̥hītvā dakṣiṇe kare,
3.163.10: yaṁ prāpya savitā rājan satyena pratitiṣṭhati,
3.163.18: brahmaṇaḥ sadanāt tasya paraṁ sthānaṁ prakāśate,
devā api na paśyanti sarvatejomayaṁ śubham ॥18॥
3.163.22: na taṁ jyotīṁṣi sarvāṇi prāpya bhāsanti pāṇḍava ॥22॥
3.163.24: pareṇa tapasā yuktā bhāvitāḥ karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ,
3.163.32: sa māsān vibhajan kāle bahudhā parvasandhiṣu,
tathaiva bhagavān somo nakṣatraiḥ saha gacchati ॥32॥
3.163.36: sthāvarāṇāṁ ca bhūtānāṁ jaṅgamānāṁ ca tejasā,
3.163.37: tataḥ svedaklamau tandrī glāniśca bhajate narān,
prāṇibhiḥ satataṁ svapno hyabhīkṣṇaṁ ca niṣevyate ॥37॥
3.163.38: punaḥ sr̥jati varṣāṇi bhagavān bhāvayan prajāḥ ॥38॥
3.163.41: ādāyaiva tu bhūtānāṁ tejo visr̥jate punaḥ ॥41॥
3.163.42: ahorātraṁ kalāḥ kāṣṭhāḥ sr̥jatyeṣa sadā vibhuḥ ॥42॥
3.163.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi yakṣayuddhaparvaṇi merudarśane triṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥163॥
3.166.17: sa jīveddhi nirābādhaḥ sa sukhī śaradāṁ śatam ॥17॥
3.166.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi nivātakacavayuddhaparvaṇi indrāgamane ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥166॥
3.167.1: yathāgataṁ gate śakre bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha saṅgataḥ,
3.167.4: samyag vā te gr̥hītāni kaccidastrāṇi pāṇḍava,
kaccit surādhipaḥ prīto rudro vāstrāṇyadāt tava ॥4॥
3.167.5: yathā dr̥ṣṭaśca te śakro bhagavān vā pinākadhr̥k,
3.167.6: kr̥tapriyastvayāsmīti tasya te kiṁ priyaṁ kr̥tam ॥6॥
3.167.9: śr̥ṇu hanta mahārāja vidhinā yena dr̥ṣṭavān,
3.167.12: sa māmapr̥cchat kaunteya kvāsi gantā bravīhi me,
3.167.13: sa tathyaṁ mama tacchrutvā brāhmaṇo rājasattama,
3.167.16: dvitīyaścāpi me māso jalaṁ bhakṣayato gataḥ,
3.167.18: pañcame tvatha samprāpte prathame divase gate,
3.167.22: yugapat taṁ kirātastu vikr̥ṣya balavad dhanuḥ,
3.167.23: sa tu māmabravīd rājan mama pūrvaparigrahaḥ,
3.167.24: eṣa te niśitairbāṇairdarpaṁ hanmi sthiro bhava,
3.167.30: yadābhibhavituṁ bāṇairna ca śaknomi taṁ raṇe,
3.167.31: tasmin pratihate cāstre vismayo me mahānabhūt ॥31॥
3.167.34: jagrāsa prasabhaṁ tāni sarvāṇyastrāṇi me nr̥pa,
3.167.36: kṣaṇena hi diśaḥ khaṁ ca sarvato hi vidīpitam ॥36॥
3.167.37: brahmāstre tu hate rājan bhayaṁ māṁ mahadāviśat ॥37॥
3.167.47: tuṣṭo’smi tava kaunteya brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te,
yat te manogataṁ vīra tad brūhi vitarāmyaham ॥47॥
3.167.51: pradadau ca mama prītaḥ so’straṁ pāśupataṁ mahat ॥51॥
3.167.52: uvāca ca mahādevo dattvā me’straṁ sanātanam,
3.167.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi nivātakavacayuddhaparvaṇi gandhamādanavāse yudhiṣṭhirārjunasaṁvāde saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥167॥
3.168.2: vyuṣito rajanīṁ cāhaṁ kr̥tvā paurvāhṇikīḥ kriyāḥ,
apaśyaṁ taṁ dvijaśreṣṭhaṁ dr̥ṣṭavānasmi yaṁ purā ॥2॥
3.168.5: draṣṭāsyanagha devendraṁ sa ca te’strāṇi dāsyati ॥5॥
3.168.6: evamuktvā sa māṁ rājannāśliṣya ca punaḥ punaḥ,
3.168.8: divyāni caiva mālyāni sugandhīni navāni ca,
3.168.11: mahendrānucarā ye ca ye ca sadmanivāsinaḥ ॥11॥
3.168.19: uvāca bhagavān svargaṁ gantavyaṁ phālguna tvayā ॥19॥
3.168.20: ataḥ paraṁ tvahaṁ vai tvāṁ darśaye bharatarṣabha ॥20॥
3.168.21: tvayā hi tīrtheṣu purā samāplāvaḥ kr̥to’sakr̥t,
tapaścedaṁ mahat taptaṁ svargaṁ gantāsi pāṇḍava ॥21॥
3.168.23: viditastvaṁ hi devānāṁ munīnāṁ ca mahātmanām ॥23॥
3.168.29: śikṣa me bhavanaṁ gatvā sarvāṇyastrāṇi bhārata,
3.168.30: vaiṣṇavāni ca sarvāṇi nairr̥tāni tathaiva ca ॥30॥
3.168.32: divyaṁ māyāmayaṁ puṇyaṁ yattaṁ mātalinā nr̥pa ॥32॥
3.168.37: avaikṣata ca me vaktraṁ sthitasyātha sa sārathiḥ ॥37॥
3.168.39: yadāsthito rathaṁ divyaṁ padānna calitaḥ padam,
3.168.40: tvaṁ punaḥ sthita evātra rathe bhrānte kurūdvaha ॥40॥
3.168.42: darśayāmāsa me rājan vimānāni ca bhārata,
3.168.46: na tatra sūryastapati na śītoṣṇe na ca klamaḥ ॥46॥
3.168.47: na bādhate tatra rajastatrāsti na jarā nr̥pa,
na tatra śoko dainyaṁ vā daurbalyaṁ copalakṣyate ॥47॥
3.168.50: śītastatra vavau vāyuḥ sugandhī jīvanaḥ śuciḥ ॥50॥
3.168.53: te māṁ vīryeṇa yaśasā tejasā ca balena ca ॥53॥
3.168.55: dadāvardhāsanaṁ prītaḥ śakro me dadatāṁ varaḥ ॥55॥
3.168.58: sa ca gāndharvamakhilaṁ grāhayāmāsa māṁ nr̥pa,
3.168.59: śr̥ṇvan vai gītaśabdaṁ ca tūryaśabdaṁ ca puṣkalam,
3.168.61: evaṁ me vasato rājanneṣa kālotyagād divi ॥61॥
3.168.63: na tvamadya yudhā jetuṁ śakyaḥ suragaṇairapi,
3.168.65: astrayuddhe samo vīra na te kaścid bhaviṣyati,
3.168.66: astrāṇi samavāptāni tvayā daśa ca pañta ca ॥66॥
3.168.67: pañcabhirvidhibhiḥ pārtha vidyate na tvayā samaḥ,
3.168.68: prāyaścittaṁ ca vettha tvaṁ pratīghātaṁ ca sarvaśaḥ,
3.168.69: pratijānīṣva taṁ kartuṁ tato vetsyāmyahaṁ param,
3.168.70: viṣahyaṁ yanmayā kartuṁ kr̥tameva nibodha tat,
3.168.77: tato devāḥ sarva eva tena ghoṣeṇa bodhitāḥ ॥77॥
3.168.78: dr̥ṣṭvā ca māmapr̥cchanta kiṁ kariṣyasi phālguna ॥78॥
3.168.83: vijetā yudhi vikramya pureva maghavā vaśī ॥83॥
3.168.84: ayaṁ ca śaṅkhapravaro yena jetāsi dānavān,
3.169.8: rathaṁ taṁ tu samāśliṣya prādravad rathayogavit,
3.169.11: saṁvidhāya pure rakṣāṁ na sma kaścana dr̥śyate ॥11॥
3.169.13: sa tu śabdo divaṁ stabdhvā pratiśabdamajījanat,
3.169.17: tato vicārya bahuśo rathamārgeṣu tān hayān,
3.169.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi nivātakavacayuddhaparvaṇi yuddhārambhe ekonasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥169॥
3.170.7: te kr̥tā vimukhāḥ sarve matprayuktaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ,
3.170.12: te diśo vidiśaḥ sarve pratirudhya prahāriṇaḥ,
abhyaghnan vividhaiḥ śastraistato me vyathitaṁ manaḥ ॥12॥
3.170.24: avākiran māṁ balavat tānahaṁ vyadhamaṁ śaraiḥ ॥24॥
3.170.27: teṣāṁ chinnāni gātrāṇi visr̥janti sma śoṇitam,
3.171.6: garjitena ca daityānāṁ na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥6॥
3.171.7: dhārā divi ca sambaddhā vasudhāyāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ,
3.171.9: hate’śmavarṣe ca mayā jalavarṣe ca śoṣite,
3.171.13: sā tu māyāmayī vr̥ṣṭiḥ pīḍayāmāsa māṁ yudhi,
3.171.14: tamasā saṁvr̥te loke ghoreṇa paruṣeṇa ca,
3.171.16: māṁ ca bhīrāviśat tīvrā tasmin vigatacetasi,
3.171.17: amr̥tārthaṁ purā pārtha sa ca dr̥ṣṭo mayānagha ॥17॥
3.171.19: tathaiva vr̥trasya vadhe saṅgr̥hītā hayā mayā,
3.171.21: na hi yuddhamidaṁ yuktamanyatra jagataḥ kṣayāt ॥21॥
3.171.23: abruvaṁ mātaliṁ bhītaṁ paśya me bhujayorbalam,
astrāṇāṁ ca prabhāvaṁ vai dhanuṣo gāṇḍivasya ca ॥23॥
3.171.24: vinihanmi tamaścograṁ mā bhaiḥ sūta sthiro bhava ॥24॥
3.171.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi nivātakavacayuddhaparvaṇi māyāyuddhe ekasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥171॥
3.172.5: śataśaḥ sma pradr̥śyante gātrāṇi kavacāni ca ॥5॥
3.172.6: hayānāṁ nāntaraṁ hyāsīt padād vicalituṁ padam,
3.172.8: vyagr̥hṇan dānavā ghorā rathacakre ca bhārata ॥8॥
3.172.9: vinigr̥hya harīnaśvān rathaṁ ca mama yudhyataḥ,
3.172.10: sa deśo yatra vartāma guheva samapadyata ॥10॥
3.172.13: tato’haṁ tasya tad vākyaṁ śrutvā vajramudīrayam,
3.172.15: tato māyāśca tāḥ sarvā nivātakavacāṁśca tān,
3.172.19: na hayānāṁ kṣatiḥ kācinna rathasya na mātaleḥ,
3.172.20: tato māṁ prahasan rājan mātaliḥ pratyabhāṣata,
3.172.21: prākrośan nagare tasmin yathā śaradi sārasāḥ ॥21॥
3.172.23: rathaṁ ca ravisaṅkāśaṁ prādravan gaṇaśaḥ striyaḥ ॥23॥
3.172.28: āsīdidaṁ purā pārtha devarājasya naḥ puram
3.172.29: tapastaptvā mahat tīvraṁ prasādya ca pitāmaham
3.172.32: tata eṣāṁ vadhārthāya śakro’strāṇi dadau tava
na hi śakyāḥ surairhantuṁ ya ete nihatāstvayā ॥32॥
3.172.33: eṣāmantakaraḥ prāptastat tvayā ca kr̥taṁ tathā ॥33॥
3.172.35: tataḥ praśāmya nagaraṁ dānavāṁśca nihatya tān
3.172.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi nivātakavacayuddhaparvaṇi nivātakavacayuddhe dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥172॥
3.173.7: pulomā nāma daiteyī kālakā ca mahāsurī
divyaṁ varṣasahasraṁ te ceratuḥ paramaṁ tapaḥ ॥7॥
3.173.17: na kathañciddhi me pāpā na vadhyā ye suradviṣaḥ ॥17॥
3.173.22: vyāmohayaṁ ca tān sarvān rathamārgaiścaran raṇe
3.173.24: te vadhyamānā daiteyāḥ puramāsthāya tat punaḥ
3.173.26: tat puraṁ khacaraṁ divyaṁ kāmagaṁ sūryasaprabham
3.173.34: neme śakyā mānuṣeṇa yuddheneti pracintya tat ॥34॥
3.173.39: nāśaknuvaṁ pīḍayituṁ te tu māṁ pratyapīḍayan
3.173.46: r̥kṣāṇāṁ mahiṣāṇāṁ ca pannagānāṁ tathā gavām ॥46॥
3.173.47: śarabhāṇāṁ gajānāṁ ca vānarāṇāṁ ca saṅghaśaḥ
3.173.48: gr̥dhrāṇāṁ garuḍānāṁ ca camarāṇāṁ tathaiva ca ॥48॥
3.173.49: devānāṁ ca r̥ṣīṇāṁ ca gandharvāṇāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ
3.173.50: guhyakānāṁ ca saṅgrāme nairr̥tānaṁ tathaiva ca
3.173.59: surāsurairasahyaṁ hi karma yat sādhitaṁ tvayā ॥59॥
3.173.60: na hyetat saṁyuge kartumapi śaktaḥ sureśvaraḥ
3.173.61: vidhvaste khapure tasmin dānaveṣu hateṣu ca ॥61॥
3.173.63: petuḥ putrān pitr̥̄n bhrātr̥̄n śocamānā mahītale
3.173.68: mama karma ca devendraṁ mātalirvistareṇa tat ॥68॥
3.173.71: tato māṁ devarājo vai samāśvāsya punaḥ punaḥ ॥71॥
3.173.71d1: pariṣvajya ca māṁ premṇā mūrdhni cāghrāya sasmitam,
3.173.72: abravīd vibudhaiḥ sārdhamidaṁ sa madhuraṁ vacaḥ
3.173.73: gurvarthaśca kr̥taḥ pārtha mahāśatrūn ghnatā mama
3.173.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi nivātakavacayuddhaparvaṇi hiraṇyapuradaityavadhe trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥173॥
3.174.2: na tvābhibhavituṁ śakto mānuṣo bhuvi kaścana ॥2॥
3.174.3: bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kr̥paḥ karṇaḥ śakuniḥ saha rājabhiḥ
saṅgrāmasthasya te putra kalāṁ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ॥3॥
3.174.4: idaṁ ca me tanutrāṇaṁ prāyacchanmaghavān prabhuḥ
abhedyaṁ kavacaṁ divyaṁ srajaṁ caiva hiraṇmayīm ॥4॥
3.174.5: devadattaṁ ca me śaṅkhaṁ punaḥ prādānmahāravam
divyaṁ cedaṁ kirīṭaṁ me svayamindro yuyoja ha ॥5॥
3.174.8: samayo’rjuna gantuṁ te bhrātaro hi smaranti te ॥8॥
3.174.9: uṣitāni mayā rājan smaratā dyūtajaṁ kalim ॥9॥
3.174.12: diṣṭyā ca bhagavān sthāṇurdevyā saha parantapa
3.174.14: adya kr̥tsnāṁ mahīṁ devīṁ vijitāṁ puramālinīm
3.174.15: icchāmi tāni cāstrāṇi draṣṭruṁ divyāni bhārata
3.174.16: śvaḥ prabhāte bhavān draṣṭā divyānyastrāṇi sarvaśaḥ
3.174.17: bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahitaḥ sarvai rajanīṁ tāmuvāsa ha ॥17॥
3.174.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi nivātakavacayuddhaparvaṇi astradarśanasaṅkete catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥174॥
3.175.9: śailāścāpi vyadīryanta na vavau ca samīraṇaḥ
na babhāse sahasrāṁśurna jajvāla ca pāvakaḥ ॥9॥
3.175.10: na vedāḥ pratibhānti sma dvijātīnāṁ kathañcana
3.175.12: tato brahmarṣayaścaiva siddhā ye ca maharṣayaḥ ॥12॥
3.175.22: bhavanti sma vināśāya maivaṁ bhūyaḥ kr̥thāḥ kvacit ॥22॥
3.175.23: ajātaśatro tvaṁ caiva drakṣyase tāni saṁyuge
3.175.24: nivāryātha tataḥ pārthaṁ sarve devā yathāgatam
3.175.25: tasminneva vane hr̥kāsta ūṣuḥ saha kr̥ṣṇayā ॥25॥
3.175.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi nivātakavacayuddhaparvaṇi astradarśane pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥175॥
3.176.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ājagaraparvaṇi gandhamādanaprasthāne ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥176॥
3.177.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ājagaraparvaṇi punardvaitavanapraveśe saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥177॥
3.178.2: paulastyaṁ dhanadaṁ yuddhe ya āhvayati darpitaḥ
3.178.3: etadicchāmyahaṁ śrītuṁ paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥3॥
3.178.11: vidhyan mr̥gān śaraiḥ śuddhaiścacāra sa mahābalaḥ ॥11॥
3.178.15: pr̥thivyāśca pradeśān vai nādayaṁstu vanāni ca ॥15॥
3.178.17: vegena nyapatad bhīmo nirbhayaśca punaḥ punaḥ
3.178.21: sa praviṣṭo mahāraṇye nādān nadati cādbhutān ॥21॥
3.178.22: tato bhīmasya śabdena bhītāḥ sarpā guhāśayāḥ ॥22॥
3.178.28: sa bhīmaṁ sahasābhyetya pr̥dākuḥ kupito bhr̥śam
3.178.29: sañjñā mumoha sahasā varadānena tasya hi ॥29॥
3.178.31: sa tejasvī tathā tena bhujagena vaśīkr̥taḥ
3.178.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ājagaraparvaṇi ajagaragrahaṇe aṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥178॥
3.179.2: uvāca ca mahāsarpaṁ kāmayā brūhi pannaga
kastvaṁ bho bhujagaśreṣṭha kiṁ mayā ca kariṣyasi ॥2॥
3.179.6: kiṁ nu vidyābalaṁ kiṁ nu varadānamatho tava
3.179.7: asatyo vikramo nr̥̄ṇāmiti me dhīyate matiḥ
yathedaṁ me tvayā nāga balaṁ pratihataṁ mahat ॥7॥
3.179.10: diṣṭyā kālasya mahataḥ priyāḥ prāṇā hi dehinām ॥10॥
3.179.11: tathāvaśyaṁ mayā khyāpyaṁ tavādya śr̥ṇu sattama ॥11॥
3.179.12: śāpasyāntaṁ pariprepsuḥ sarvaṁ tat kathayāmi te ॥12॥
3.179.16: na hi me mucyate kaścit kathañcit pragrahaṁ gataḥ
gajo vā mahiṣo vāpi ṣaṣṭhe kāle narottama ॥16॥
3.179.20: tato’smi patito bhūmau na ca māmajahāt smr̥tiḥ
3.179.21: yastu te vyāhr̥tān praśnān pratibrūyād vibhāgavit,
3.179.25: na ca kupye mahāsarpa na cātmānaṁ vigarhaye ॥25॥
3.179.26: āgame yadi vāpāye na tatra glapayenmanaḥ ॥26॥
3.179.29: yathā tu vipine nyastān bhrātr̥̄n rājyaparicyutān ॥29॥
3.179.31: dharmaśīlā mayā te hi bādhyante rājyagr̥ddhinā ॥31॥
3.179.41: dāruṇaṁ hyaśivaṁ nādaṁ śivā dakṣiṇataḥ sthitā,
dīptāyāṁ diśi vitrastā rauti tasyāśramasya ha ॥41॥
3.179.44: pr̥ṣṭhato vāyasaḥ kr̥ṣṇo yāhi yāhīti śaṁsati,
3.179.46: draupadīṁ paripapraccha kva bhīma iti bhārata ॥46॥
3.179.48: nakulaṁ sahadevaṁ ca vyādideśa dvijān prati ॥48॥
3.179.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ājagaraparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirabhīmadarśane ekonāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥179॥
3.180.6: gamyatāṁ neha sthātavyaṁ śvo bhavānapi me bhavet ॥6॥
3.180.7: sa me bhakṣo bhavet tāta tvaṁ cāpi viṣaye mama ॥7॥
3.180.9: devo vā yadi vā daitya urago vā bhavān yadi,
satyaṁ sarpa vaco brūhi pr̥cchati tvāṁ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
kimarthaṁ ca tvayā grasto bhīmaseno bhujaṅgama ॥9॥
3.180.10: kimāhr̥tya viditvā vā prītiste syād bhujaṅgam,
3.180.15: na tu māmajahāt prajñā yāvadadyeti pāṇḍava,
3.180.17: atha paścād vimokṣyāmi bhrātaraṁ te vr̥kodaram ॥17॥
3.180.18: brūhi sarpa yathākāmaṁ prativakṣyāmi te vacaḥ,
3.180.19: vedyaṁ ca brāhmaṇeneha tad bhavān vetti kevalam,
sarparāja tataḥ śrutvā prativakṣyāmi te vacaḥ ॥19॥
3.180.20: brāhmaṇaḥ ko bhaved rājan vedyaṁ kiṁ ca yudhiṣṭhira,
3.180.21: satyaṁ dānaṁ kṣamā śīlamānr̥śaṁsyaṁ tapo ghr̥ṇā,
dr̥śyante yatra nāgendra sa brāhmaṇa iti smr̥taḥ ॥21॥
3.180.22: vedyaṁ sarpa paraṁ brahma nirduḥkhamasukhaṁ ca yat,
yatra gatvā na śocanti bhavataḥ kiṁ vivakṣitam ॥22॥
3.180.23: cāturvarṇyaṁ pramāṇaṁ ca satyaṁ ca brahma caiva hi,
śūdreṣvapi ca satyaṁ ca dānamakrodha eva ca,
3.180.24: tābhyāṁ hīnaṁ padaṁ cānyanna tadastīti lakṣaye ॥24॥
3.180.25: śūdre tu yad bhavellakṣma dvije tacca na vidyate,
na vai śūdro bhavecchūdro brāhmaṇo na ca brāhmaṇaḥ ॥25॥
3.180.26: yatraitallakṣyate sarpa vr̥ttaṁ sa brāhmaṇaḥ smr̥taḥ,
yatraitanna bhavet sarpa taṁ śūdramiti nirdiśet ॥26॥
3.180.27: yat punarbhavatā proktaṁ na vedyaṁ vidyatīti ca,
3.180.28: evametanmataṁ sarpa tābhyāṁ hīnaṁ na vidyate,
3.180.29: evaṁ vai sukhaduḥkhābhyāṁ hīnamasti padaṁ kvacit,
eṣā mama matiḥ sarpa yathā vā manyate bhavān ॥29॥
3.180.30: yadi te vr̥ttato rājan brāhmaṇaḥ prasamīkṣitaḥ,
3.180.32: vāṅmaithunamatho janma maraṇaṁ ca samaṁ nr̥ṇām ॥32॥
3.180.33: idamārṣaṁ pramāṇaṁ ca ye yajāmaha ityapi,
3.180.34: tatrāsya mātā sāvitrī pitā tvācārya ucyate ॥34॥
3.180.35: tāvacchūdrasamo hyeṣa yāvad vede na jāyate,
3.180.36: kr̥takr̥tyāḥ punarvarṇā yadi vr̥ttaṁ na vidyate,
3.180.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ājagaraparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirasarpasaṁvāde aśītyadhikaśatatamo’yāyaḥ ॥180॥
3.181.1: brūhi kiṁ kurvataḥ karma bhaved gatiranuttamā ॥1॥
3.181.2: pātre dattvā priyāṇyuktvā satyamuktvā ca bhārata,
3.181.3: dānād vā sarpa satyād vā kimato guru dr̥śyate,
3.181.4: dānaṁ ca satyaṁ tattvaṁ vā ahiṁsā priyameva ca,
3.181.8: kathaṁ svarge gatiḥ sarpa karmaṇāṁ ca phalaṁ dhruvam,
3.181.9: tisro vai gatayo rājan paridr̥ṣṭāḥ svakarmabhiḥ,
3.181.15: jāto jātaśca balavad bhuṅkte cātmā sa dehavān,
3.181.16: śabde sparśe ca rūpe ca tathaiva rasagandhayoḥ,
3.181.17: kiṁ na gr̥hṇāti viṣayān yugapacca mahāmate,
3.181.24: manasaścāpi buddheśca brūhi me lakṣaṇaṁ param,
3.181.28: aho buddhimatāṁ śreṣṭha śubhā buddhiriyaṁ tava,
3.181.29: sarvajñaṁ tvāṁ kathaṁ moha āviśat svargavāsinam,
3.181.32: kr̥taṁ kāryaṁ mahārāja tvayā mama parantapa,
kṣīṇaḥśāpaḥ sukr̥cchro me tvayā sambhāṣya sādhunā ॥32॥
3.181.33: ahaṁ hi divi divyena vimānena caran purā,
3.181.36: brahmarṣīṇāṁ sahasraṁ hi uvāha śibikāṁ mama,
sa māmapanayo rājan bhraṁśayāmāsa vai śriyaḥ ॥36॥
3.181.37: tatra hyagastyaḥ pādena vahan spr̥ṣṭo mayā muniḥ,
agastyena tato’smyuktaḥ sarpastvaṁ ca bhaveti ha ॥37॥
3.181.41: tato me vismayo jātastad dr̥ṣṭvā tapaso balam ॥41॥
3.181.42: brahma ca brāhmaṇatvaṁ ca yena tvāhamacūcudam,
3.181.43: sādhakāni sadā puṁsāṁ na jātirna kulaṁ nr̥pa,
ariṣṭa eṣa te bhrātā bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ,
svasti te’stu mahārāja gamiṣyāmi divaṁ punaḥ ॥43॥
3.181.43d1: sa cāyaṁ puruṣavyāghra kālaḥ puṇya upāgataḥ,
tadasmāt kāraṇāt pārtha kāryaṁ mama mahat kr̥tam.
3.181.43d2: tatastasmin muhūrte tu vimānaṁ kāmagāmi vai,
3.181.44: ityuktvā’’jagaraṁ dehaṁ muktvā sa nahuṣo nr̥paḥ,
3.181.47: tacchrutvā te dvijāḥ sarve bhrātaraścāsya te trayaḥ,
āsan suvrīḍitā rājan draupadī ca yaśasvinī ॥47॥
3.181.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ājagaraparvaṇi bhīmamocane ekāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥181॥
3.182.5: samaṁ vā viṣamaṁ vāpi nadyo vā sthāvarāṇi ca ॥5॥
3.182.15: te vai mumudire vīrāḥ prasannasalilāṁ śivām,
3.182.16: teṣāṁ puṇyatamā rātriḥ parvasandhau sma śāradī,
3.182.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi kāmyakavanapraveśe dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥182॥
3.183.4: sadā hi darśanākāṅkṣī śreyo’nveṣī ca vo hariḥ ॥4॥
3.183.8: vavande mudito dhīmān bhīmaṁ ca balināṁ varam ॥8॥
3.183.10: sa dr̥ṣṭvā phālgunaṁ vīraṁ cirasya priyamāgatam,
3.183.11: pāṇḍavānāṁ priyāṁ bhāryāṁ kr̥ṣṇasya mahiṣī priyā ॥11॥
3.183.15: pārthaṁ ca kr̥ṣṇāṁ ca purohitaṁ ca,
3.183.19: dānaṁ ca satyaṁ ca tapaśca rājan
3.183.22: dhaumyaṁ ca bhīmaṁ ca yudhiṣṭhiraṁ ca
3.183.41: tathā vadati vārṣṇeye dharmarāje ca bhārata,
3.183.43: vyadr̥śyata tathā yukto yathā syāt pañcaviṁśakaḥ,
3.183.45: draupadī satyabhāmā ca tathāhaṁ paramaṁ vacaḥ ॥45॥
3.183.46: rājñāṁ strīṇāmr̥ṣīṇāṁ ca mārkaṇḍeya vicakṣva naḥ ॥46॥
3.183.50: brahmarṣe kathyatāṁ yat te pāṇḍaveṣu vivakṣitam ॥50॥
3.183.52: evamuktāḥ kṣaṇaṁ cakruḥ pāṇḍavāḥ saha tairdvijaiḥ,
3.183.57: sa phalaṁ tadupāśnāti kathaṁ kartā svidīśvaraḥ ॥57॥
3.183.58: kuto vā sukhaduḥkheṣu nr̥ṇāṁ brahmavidāṁ vara,
iha vā kr̥tamanveti paradehe’tha vā punaḥ ॥58॥
3.183.59: dehī ca dehaṁ santyajya mr̥gyamāṇaḥ śubhāśubhaiḥ,
kathaṁ saṁyujyate pretya iha vā dvijasattama ॥59॥
3.183.60: kva ca karmāṇi tiṣṭhanti jantoḥ pretasya bhārgava ॥60॥
3.183.61: viditaṁ veditavyaṁ te sthityarthaṁ tvaṁ tu pr̥cchasi ॥61॥
3.183.74: jantoḥ pretasya kaunteya gatiḥ svairiha karmabhiḥ,
3.183.75: iti te darśanaṁ yacca tatrāpyanunayaṁ śr̥ṇu ॥75॥
3.183.78: phalatyatha sukhārho vā duḥkhārho vātha jāyate ॥78॥
3.183.84: cyavantaṁ jāyamānaṁ ca garbhasthaṁ caiva sarvaśaḥ,
3.183.86: prāpnuvanti narā rājan mā te’stvanyā vicāraṇā ॥86॥
3.183.88: iha vaikasya nāmutra amutraikasya no iha,
iha vāmutra caikasya nāmutraikasya no iha ॥88॥
3.183.92: ye naiva vidyāṁ na tapo na dānaṁ
3.184.5: sa tena nihato’raṇye manyamānena vai mr̥gam,
3.184.6: teṣāṁ ca tad yathāvr̥ttaṁ kathayāmāsa vai tadā ॥6॥
3.184.7: taṁ cāpi hiṁsitaṁ tāta muniṁ mūlaphalāśinam,
śrutvā dr̥ṣṭvā ca te tatra babhūvurdīnamānasāḥ ॥7॥
3.184.9: tasthuḥ sarve sa tu munisteṣāṁ pūjāmathāharat ॥9॥
3.184.10: te tamūcurmahātmānaṁ na vayaṁ satkriyāṁ mune,
tvatto’rhāḥ karmadoṣeṇa brāhmaṇo hiṁsito hi naḥ ॥10॥
3.184.11: tānabravīt sa viprarṣiḥ kathaṁ vo brāhmaṇo hataḥ,
kva cāsau brūta sahitāḥ paśyadhvaṁ me tapobalam ॥11॥
3.184.15: te ca dr̥ṣṭvaiva tamr̥ṣiṁ vismayaṁ paramaṁ gatāḥ,
3.184.16: kimetat tapaso vīryaṁ yenāyaṁ jīvitaḥ punaḥ ॥16॥
3.184.17: sa tānuvāca nāsmākaṁ mr̥tyuḥ prabhavate nr̥pāḥ ॥17॥
3.184.22: etad vai leśamātraṁ vaḥ samākhyātaṁ vimatsarāḥ,
gacchadhvaṁ sahitāḥ sarve na pāpād bhayamasti vaḥ ॥22॥
3.184.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi brāhmaṇamāhātmyakathane caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥184॥
3.185.1: bhūya eva mahābhāgyaṁ brāhmaṇānāṁ nibodha me,
3.185.6: tata ādāya viprarṣe pratigr̥hya dhanaṁ bahu ॥6॥
3.185.7: bhr̥tyān sutān saṁvibhajya tato vraja yathepsitam,
3.185.9: dveṣṭāraḥ kintu naḥ santi vasantastatra vai dvijāḥ,
yathā me gautamaḥ prāha tato na vyavasāmyaham ॥9॥
3.185.11: gāśca me dāsyate vainyaḥ prabhūtaṁ cārthasañcayam ॥11॥
3.185.13: rājan dhanyastvamīśaśca bhuvi tvaṁ prathamo nr̥paḥ ॥13॥
3.185.15: maivamatre punarbrūyā na te prajñā samāhitā,
atra naḥ prathamaṁ sthātā mahendro vai prajāpatiḥ ॥15॥
3.185.16: tvameva muhyase mohānna prajñānaṁ tavāsti ha ॥16॥
3.185.18: na vettha paramaṁ dharmaṁ na cāvaiṣi prayojanam,
3.185.19: vivadantau tathā tau tu munīnāṁ darśane sthitau,
ye tasya yajñe saṁvr̥ttāste’pr̥cchanta kathaṁ tvimau ॥19॥
3.185.24: sa ca teṣāṁ vacaḥ śrutvā yathātattvaṁ mahātapāḥ,
3.185.25: brahma kṣatreṇa sahitaṁ kṣatraṁ ca brahmaṇā saha,
3.185.26: rājā vai prathito dharmaḥ prajānāṁ patireva ca,
sa eva śakraḥ śukraśca sa dhātā ca br̥haspatiḥ ॥26॥
3.185.27: ya ebhiḥ stūyate śabdaiḥ kastaṁ nārcitumarhati ॥27॥
3.185.30: ādityo divi deveṣu tamo nudati tejasā,
3.185.31: uttaraḥ siddhyate pakṣo yena rājeti bhāṣitam ॥31॥
3.185.32: tataḥ sa rājā saṁhr̥ṣṭaḥ siddhe pakṣe mahāmanāḥ,
3.185.34: tasmāt te’haṁ pradāsyāmi vividhaṁ vasu bhūri ca,
3.185.35: etad dadāmi viprarṣe sarvajñastvaṁ mato hi me ॥35॥
3.185.37: pradāya ca dhanaṁ prītaḥ putrebhyaḥ prayatātmavān,
3.185.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi brāhmaṇamāhātmye pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥185॥
3.186.1: pr̥ṣṭayā muninā vīra śr̥ṇu tārkṣyeṇa dhīmatā ॥1॥
3.186.3: kasmin kāle kena dharmo na naśyet,
3.186.30: ījire kratubhiḥ śreṣṭhaistat padaṁ paramaṁ mama ॥30॥
3.186.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi sarasvatītārkṣyasaṁvāde ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥186॥
3.187.1: tataḥ sa pāṇḍavo vipraṁ mārkaṇḍeyamuvāca ha,
3.187.3: ojasā tejasā lakṣmyā tapasā ca viśeṣataḥ,
aticakrāma pitaraṁ manuḥ svaṁ ca pitāmaham ॥3॥
3.187.7: matsyebhyo hi tato māṁ tvaṁ trātumarhasi suvrata ॥7॥
3.187.8: durbalaṁ balavanto hi matsyā matsyaṁ viśeṣataḥ,
3.187.12: sa tatra vavr̥dhe rājan matsyaḥ paramasatkr̥taḥ,
3.187.13: atha kālena mahatā sa matsyaḥ sumahānabhūt,
aliñjare yathā caiva nāsau samabhavat kila ॥13॥
3.187.15: uddhr̥tyāliñjarāt tasmāt tataḥ sa bhagavān manuḥ,
taṁ matsyamanayad vāpīṁ mahatīṁ sa manustadā ॥15॥
3.187.18: viceṣṭituṁ ca kaunteya matsyo vāpyāṁ viśāmpate,
3.187.19: naya māṁ bhagavan sādho samudramahiṣīṁ priyām,
gaṅgāṁ tatra nivatsyāmi yathā vā tāta manyase ॥19॥
3.187.20: vr̥ddhirhi paramā prāptā tvatkr̥te hi mayānagha ॥20॥
3.187.21: nadīṁ gaṅgāṁ tatra cainaṁ svayaṁ prākṣipadacyutaḥ ॥21॥
3.187.23: gaṅgāyāṁ hi na śaknomi br̥hattvācceṣṭituṁ prabho,
3.187.24: uddhr̥tya gaṅgāsalilāt tato matsyaṁ manuḥ svayam,
3.187.26: yadā samudre prakṣiptaḥ sa matsyo manunā tadā,
3.187.27: bhagavan hi kr̥tā rakṣā tvayā sarvā viśeṣataḥ,
prāptakālaṁ tu yat kāryaṁ tvayā tacchrūyatāṁ mama ॥27॥
3.187.29: tasmāt tvāṁ bodhayāmyadya yat te hitamanuttamam ॥29॥
3.187.30: trasānāṁ sthāvarāṇāṁ ca yacceṅgaṁ yacca neṅgati,
3.187.32: bījāni caiva sarvāṇi yathoktāni dvijaiḥ purā,
3.187.34: tā na śakyā mahatyo vai āpastartuṁ mayā vinā ॥34॥
3.187.35: nābhiśaṅkyamidaṁ cāpi vacanaṁ me tvayā vibho,
evaṁ kariṣya iti taṁ sa matsyaṁ pratyabhāṣata ॥35॥
3.187.38: sa ca taccintitaṁ jñātvā matsyaḥ parapurañjaya ॥38॥
3.187.42: sa ca tāṁstārayan nāvā samudraṁ manujeśvara ॥42॥
3.187.44: naiva bhūmirna ca diśaḥ pradiśo vā cakāśire ॥44॥
3.187.46: evaṁ bahūn varṣagaṇāṁstāṁ nāvaṁ so’tha matsyakaḥ ॥46॥
3.187.47: tato himavataḥ śr̥ṅgaṁ yat paraṁ bharatarṣabha ॥47॥
3.187.48: tatrākarṣat tato nāvaṁ sa matsyaḥ kurunandana,
3.187.49: asmin himavataḥ śr̥ṅge nāvaṁ badhnīta mā ciram,
3.187.50: tacca naubandhanaṁ nāma śr̥ṅgaṁ himavataḥ param ॥50॥
3.187.54: matprasādāt prajāsarge na ca mohaṁ gamiṣyati ॥54॥
3.187.56: tapasā mahatā yuktaḥ so’tha sraṣṭuṁ pracakrame ॥56॥
3.187.57: sarvāḥ prajā manuḥ sākṣād yathāvad bharatarṣabha,
3.187.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi matsyopākhyāne saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥187॥
3.188.2: na cāpīha samaḥ kaścidāyuṣmān dr̥śyate tava ॥2॥
3.188.5: pralaye cāpi nirvr̥tte prabuddhe ca pitāmahe,
3.188.11: na tvāṁ viśati viprarṣe prasādāt parameṣṭhinaḥ ॥11॥
3.188.12: yadā naivaṁ ravirnāgnirna vāyurna ca candramāḥ,
3.188.15: etat pratyakṣataḥ sarvaṁ pūrvaṁ vr̥ttaṁ dvijottama,
3.188.19: eṣa kartā vikartā ca bhūtātmā bhūtakr̥t prabhuḥ,
3.188.20: eṣa kartā na kriyate kāraṇaṁ cāpi pauruṣe ॥20॥
3.188.21: yadyeṣa puruṣo veda vedā api na taṁ viduḥ,
3.188.22: catvāryāhuḥ sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṁ tat kr̥taṁ yugam ॥22॥
3.188.24: tasya tāvacchatī sandhyā sandhyāṁśaśca tataḥ param,
3.188.26: tasya varṣaśataṁ sandhiḥ sandhyāṁśaśca tataḥ param,
3.188.27: kṣīṇe kaliyuge caiva pravarteta kr̥taṁ yugam,
3.188.34: viparīte tadā loke pūrvarūpaṁ kṣayasya tat,
3.188.41: mukhe bhagāḥ striyo rājan bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye ॥41॥
3.188.47: mithyā ca nakharomāṇi dhārayanti tadā dvijāḥ,
3.188.50: na cāpi sarvabījāni samyag rohanti bhārata ॥50॥
3.188.52: tadā ca pr̥thivīpāla yo bhaved dharmasaṁyutaḥ,
alpāyuḥ sa hi mantavyo na hi dharmo’sti kaścana ॥52॥
3.188.57: dhanaṁ viśvāsato nyastaṁ mitho bhūyiṣṭhaśo narāḥ ॥57॥
3.188.62: taruṇānāṁ ca yacchīlaṁ tad vr̥ddheṣu prajāyate ॥62॥
3.188.67: pīyate salilaṁ sarvaṁ samudreṣu saritsu ca ॥67॥
3.188.68: yacca kāṣṭhaṁ tr̥ṇaṁ cāpi śuṣkaṁ cārdraṁ ca bhārata,
sarvaṁ tad bhasmasād bhūtaṁ dr̥śyate bharatarṣabha ॥68॥
3.188.70: tataḥ sa pr̥thivīṁ bhittvā praviśya ca rasātalam,
3.188.71: nirdahan nāgalokaṁ ca yacca kiñcit kṣitāviha,
3.188.73: tato dahati dīptaḥ sa sarvameva jagad vibhuḥ ॥73॥
3.188.85: ādiḥ padmālayo devaḥ pītvā svapiti bhārata ॥85॥
3.188.93: kathaṁ tvayaṁ śiśuḥ śete loke nāśamupāgate ॥93॥
3.188.94: bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca jānannapi narādhipa ॥94॥
3.188.95: sākṣāllakṣmyā ivāvāsaḥ sa tadā pratibhāti me ॥95॥
3.188.98: āssva bho vihito vāsaḥ prasādaste kr̥to mayā ॥98॥
3.188.99: nirvedo jīvite dīrghe manuṣyatve ca bhārata ॥99॥
3.188.100: tato bālena tenāsyaṁ sahasā vivr̥taṁ kr̥tam,
3.188.102: gaṅgāṁ śatadruṁ sītāṁ ca yamunāmatha kauśikīm,
3.188.103: sindhuṁ caiva vipāśāṁ ca nadīṁ godāvarīmapi,
3.188.104: nadīṁ tāmrāṁ ca veṇāṁ ca puṇyatoyāṁ śubhāvahām,
suveṇāṁ kr̥ṣṇaveṇāṁ ca irāmāṁ ca mahānadīm ॥104॥
3.188.105: vitastāṁ ca mahārāja kāverīṁ ca mahānadīm,
3.188.109: yajante hi tadā rājan brāhmaṇā bahubhirmakhaiḥ ॥109॥
3.188.112: himavantaṁ ca paśyāmi hemakūṭaṁ ca parvatam,
niṣadhaṁ cāpi paśyāmi śvetaṁ ca rajatānvitam ॥112॥
3.188.114: mahendraṁ caiva paśyāmi vindhyaṁ ca girimuttamam ॥114॥
3.188.115: malayaṁ cāpi paśyāmi pāriyātraṁ ca parvatam,
ete cānye ca bahavo yāvantaḥ pr̥thivīdharāḥ ॥115॥
3.188.117: tāni sarvāṇyahaṁ tatra paśyan paryacaraṁ tadā ॥117॥
3.188.118: kukṣau tasya naravyāghra praviṣṭaḥ sañcaran diśaḥ,
3.188.123: na ca paśyāmi tasyāhaṁ dehasyāntaṁ kadācana ॥123॥
3.188.125: vareṇyaṁ varadaṁ devaṁ manasā karmaṇaiva ca ॥125॥
3.188.129: tato māmabravīd bālaḥ sa prītaḥ prahasanniva,
3.188.134: dr̥ṣṭo mayā sa bhūtātmā devaḥ kamalalocanaḥ ॥134॥
3.188.135: jñātumicchāmi deva tvāṁ māyāṁ caitāṁ tavottamām ॥135॥
3.188.136: dr̥ṣṭavānakhilān sarvān samastān jaṭhare hi te ॥136॥
3.188.140: iha bhūtvā śiśuḥ sākṣāt kiṁ bhavānavatiṣṭhate,
3.188.141: kimarthaṁ ca jagat sarvaṁ śarīrasthaṁ tavānagha,
3.188.143: ityuktaḥ sa mayā śrīmān devadevo mahādyutiḥ,
3.189.1: kāmaṁ devā api na māṁ vipra jānanti tattvataḥ,
3.189.2: pitr̥bhakto’si viprarṣe māṁ caiva śaraṇaṁ gataḥ,
tato dr̥ṣṭo’smi te sākṣād brahmacaryaṁ ca te mahat ॥2॥
3.189.3: apāṁ nārā iti purā sañjñākarma kr̥taṁ mayā,
tena nārāyaṇo’pyukto mama tat tvayanaṁ sadā ॥3॥
3.189.6: ahaṁ dhātā vidhātā ca yajñaścāhaṁ dvijottama ॥6॥
3.189.7: agnirāsyaṁ kṣitiḥ pādau candrādityau ca locane,
dyaurmūrdhā khaṁ diśaḥ śrotre tathā’paḥ svedasambhavāḥ ॥7॥
3.189.8: sadiśaṁ ca nabhaḥ kāyo vāyurmanasi me sthitaḥ,
3.189.13: brahma vaktraṁ bhujau kṣatramūrū me saṁsthitā viśaḥ ॥13॥
3.189.14: pādau śūdrā bhavantīme vikrameṇa krameṇa ca,
3.189.19: mama vai romakūpāṇi viddhi tvaṁ dvijasattama,
3.189.20: vasanaṁ śayanaṁ caiva vilayaṁ caiva viddhi me,
3.189.21: kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca harṣaṁ ca bhayaṁ mohaṁ tathaiva ca,
3.189.22: prāpnuvanti narā vipra yat kr̥tvā karma śobhanam,
3.189.25: prāptuṁ na śakyo yo vidvan narairduṣkr̥takarmabhiḥ,
3.189.26: taṁ māṁ mahāphalaṁ viddhi narāṇāṁ bhāvitātmanām,
3.189.27: yadā yadā ca dharmasya glānirbhavati sattama,
3.189.33: trayo bhāgā hyadharmasya tasmin kāle bhavanti ca,
3.189.36: sarvabhūteṣu viprendra na ca māṁ vetti kaścana ॥36॥
3.189.37: sarvaloke ca māṁ bhaktāḥ pūjayanti ca sarvaśaḥ,
yacca kiñcit tvayā prāptaṁ mayi kleśātmakaṁ dvija ॥37॥
3.189.38: sukhodayāya tat sarvaṁ śreyase ca tavānagha,
yacca kiñcit tvayā loke dr̥ṣṭaṁ sthāvarajaṅgamam ॥38॥
3.189.42: mayā ca datto viprāgrya varaste brahmarūpiṇā ॥42॥
3.189.45: dr̥ṣṭvā lokaṁ samastaṁ ca vismito nāvabudhyase,
tato’si vaktrād viprarṣe drutaṁ niḥsārito mayā ॥45॥
3.189.46: ākhyātaste mayā cātmā durjñeyo hi surāsuraiḥ ॥46॥
3.189.47: yāvat sa bhagavān brahmā na budhyeta mahātapāḥ,
tāvat tvamiha viprarṣe viśrabdhaścara vai sukham ॥47॥
3.189.51: evaṁ dr̥ṣṭaṁ mayā rājaṁstasmin prāpte yugakṣaye,
3.189.52: yaḥ sa devo mayā dr̥ṣṭaḥ purā padmāyatekṣaṇaḥ,
sa eṣa puruṣavyāghra sambandhī te janārdanaḥ ॥52॥
3.189.54: sa eṣa kr̥ṣṇo vārṣṇeyaḥ purāṇapuruṣo vibhuḥ,
3.189.55: eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca saṁhartā caiva śāśvataḥ,
3.189.57: sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṁ pitā mātā ca mādhavaḥ,
3.189.58: evamuktāśca te pārthā yamau ca puruṣarṣabhau,
3.189.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi bhaviṣyakathane ekonanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥189॥
3.190.1: punaḥ papraccha sāmrājye bhaviṣyāṁ jagato gatim ॥1॥
3.190.2: āścaryabhūtaṁ bhavataḥ śrutaṁ no vadatāṁ vara,
mune bhārgava yad vr̥ttaṁ yugādau prabhavātyayam ॥2॥
3.190.3: asmin kaliyuge tvasti punaḥ kautūhalaṁ mama,
samākuleṣu dharmeṣu kiṁ nu śeṣaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥3॥
3.190.5: kāṁ ca kāṣṭhāṁ samāsādya punaḥ sampatsyate kr̥tam,
3.190.7: śr̥ṇu rājan mayā dr̥ṣṭaṁ yat purā śrutameva ca,
3.190.18: antyā madhyā bhaviṣyanti madhyāścāntyā na saṁśayaḥ ॥18॥
3.190.21: goṣu naṣṭāsu puruṣā ye’pi nityaṁ dhr̥tavratāḥ,
3.190.24: śrāddhe daive ca puruṣā ye’pi nityaṁ dhr̥tavratāḥ,
3.190.25: pitā putrasya bhoktā ca pituḥ putrastathaiva ca,
3.190.27: nimne kr̥ṣiṁ kariṣyanti yokṣyanti dhuri dhenukāḥ,
3.190.36: na kanyāṁ yācate kaścinnāpi kanyā pradīyate,
3.190.38: mlecchībhūtaṁ jagat sarvaṁ bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ,
3.190.41: adharmo varddhate tatra na tu dharmaḥ pravartate ॥41॥
3.190.42: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā na śiṣyanti janādhipa,
3.190.43: na kṣaṁsyati pitā putraṁ putraśca pitaraṁ tathā,
3.190.47: na kaścit kasyacicchrotā na kaścit kasyacid guruḥ,
3.190.49: pañcame vātha ṣaṣṭhe vā varṣe kanyā prasūyate,
3.190.50: patyau strī tu tadā rājan puruṣo vā striyaṁ prati,
3.190.51: na kaścit kasyacid dātā bhaviṣyati yugakṣaye ॥51॥
3.190.53: bhāvinaḥ paścime kāle manuṣyā nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥53॥
3.190.56: bhavitāro janāḥ sarve samprāpte tu yugakṣaye ॥56॥
3.190.57: bhavitā saṁśayo loke jīvitasya hi dehinām ॥57॥
3.190.61: āśrayiṣyanti ca nadīḥ parvatān viṣamāṇi ca,
3.190.62: dasyubhiḥ pīḍitā rājan kākā iva dvijottamāḥ,
3.190.68: bhaviṣyati yuge kṣīṇe tad yugāntasya lakṣaṇam,
3.190.69: bhaviṣyanti narā nityaṁ tadā saṅkṣepsyate yugam,
puṣpaṁ puṣpe yadā rājan phale vā phalamāśritam ॥69॥
3.190.74: evaṁ paryākule loke maryādā na bhaviṣyati,
3.190.80: sasyāni ca na rokṣyanti yugānte paryupasthite,
3.190.81: bhartr̥̄ṇāṁ vacane caiva na sthāsyanti tataḥ striyaḥ,
3.190.84: na lapsyante nivāsaṁ ca nirastāḥ pathi śerate,
3.190.86: atha deśān diśaścāpi pattanāni purāṇi ca ॥86॥
3.190.87: hā tāta hā sutetyevaṁ tadā vācaḥ sudāruṇāḥ ॥87॥
3.190.91: kālavarṣī ca parjanyo nakṣatrāṇi śubhāni ca ॥91॥
3.190.97: sa sarvatra gatān kṣudrān brāhmaṇaiḥ parivāritaḥ,
3.190.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi bhaviṣyakathane navatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥190॥
3.191.5: kalkī cariṣyati mahīṁ sadā dasyuvadhe rataḥ ॥5॥
3.191.6: hā mātastāta putreti tāstā vācaḥ sudāruṇāḥ,
3.191.10: janiṣyante ca bījāni ropyamāṇāni caiva ha ॥10॥
3.191.11: narā dāneṣu niratā vrateṣu niyameṣu ca ॥11॥
