3.191.14: eṣa dharmaḥ kr̥tayuge tretāyāṁ dvāpare tathā ॥14॥
3.191.15: paścime yugakāle ca yaḥ sa te samprakīrtitaḥ,
3.191.19: dharme tvayā’’tmā saṁyojyo nityaṁ dharmabhr̥tāṁ vara,
dharmātmā hi sukhaṁ rājan pretya ceha ca nandati ॥19॥
3.191.20: nibodha ca śubhāṁ vāṇīṁ yāṁ pravakṣyāmi te’nagha,
3.191.22: kasmin dharme mayā stheyaṁ prajāḥ saṁrakṣatā mune ॥22॥
3.191.23: kathaṁ ca vartamāno vai na cyaveyaṁ svadharmataḥ,
3.191.24: cara dharmaṁ tyajādharmaṁ pitr̥̄n devāṁśca pūjaya ॥24॥
3.191.25: pramādād yat kr̥taṁ te’bhūt samyag dānena tajjaya,
alaṁ te mānamāśritya satataṁ paravān bhava ॥25॥
3.191.26: vijitya pr̥thivīṁ sarvāṁ modamānaḥ sukhī bhava,
3.191.27: tasmādimaṁ parikleśaṁ tvaṁ tāta hr̥di mā kr̥thāḥ ॥27॥
3.191.29: mā ca tatra viśaṅkābhūd yanmayoktaṁ tavānagha ॥29॥
3.191.30: āśaṅkya madvaco hyetad dharmalopo bhavet tava,
3.191.32: tathā kariṣye yatnena bhavataḥ śāsanaṁ vibho,
na me lobho’sti viprendra na bhayaṁ na ca matsaraḥ ॥32॥
3.191.33: kariṣyāmi hi tat sarvamuktaṁ yat te mayi prabho,
śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tasya mārkaṇḍeyasya dhīmataḥ ॥33॥
3.191.34: viprarṣabhāśca te sarve ye tatrāsan samāgatāḥ ॥34॥
3.191.35: tathā kathāṁ śubhāṁ śrutvā mārkaṇḍeyasya dhīmataḥ,
3.191.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirānuśāsane ekanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥191॥
3.192.1: bhūya eva brāhmaṇamahābhāgyaṁ vatkumarhasītyabravīt pāṇḍaveyo mārkaṇḍeyam ॥1॥
3.192.5: adhvani jātaśramaḥ kṣuttr̥ṣṇābhibhūtaścaikasmin deśe nīlaṁ gahanaṁ vanakhaṇḍamapaśyat ॥5॥
3.192.6: tacca viveśa tatastasya vanakhaṇḍasya madhye’tīva ramaṇīyaṁ saro dr̥ṣṭvā sāśva eva vyagāhata ॥6॥
3.192.7: athāśvastaḥ sa bisamr̥ṇālamaśvāyāgrato nikṣipya puṣkariṇītīre saṁviveśa, tataḥ śayāno madhuraṁ gītamaśr̥ṇot ॥7॥
3.192.8: sa śrutvācintayanneha manuṣyagatiṁ paśyāmi kasya khalvayaṁ gītaśabda iti ॥8॥
3.192.9: athāpaśyat kanyāṁ paramarūpadarśanīyāṁ puṣpāṇyavacinvantīṁ gāyantīṁ ca, atha sā rājñaḥ samīpe paryakrāmat ॥9॥
3.192.10: tāmabravīd rājā kasyāsi bhadre kā vā tvamiti, sā pratyuvāca kanyā’smīti tāṁ rājovācārthī tvayāhamiti ॥10॥
3.192.11: athovāca kanyā samayenāhaṁ śakyā tvayā labdhuṁ nānyatheti rājā tāṁ samayamapr̥cchat, kanyovāca nodakaṁ me darśayitavyamiti ॥11॥
3.192.12: sa rājā tāṁ bāḍhamityuktvā tāmupayeme kr̥todvāhaśca rājā parīkṣit krīḍamāno mudā paramayā yuktastūṣṇīṁ saṅgamya tayā sahāste ॥12॥
3.192.14: sā senopaviṣṭaṁ rājānaṁ parivāryātiṣṭhat, paryāśvastaśca rājā tayaiva saha śibikayā prāyādava-ghoṭitayā sa svaṁ nagaramanuprāpya rahasi tayā sahāste ॥14॥
3.192.17: apūrvamiva paśyāma udakaṁ nātra nīyata ityathāmātyo’nudakaṁ vanaṁ kārayitvodāravr̥kṣaṁ bahupuṣya-phalamūlaṁ tasya madhye muktājālamayīṁ pārśve vāpīṁ gūḍhāṁ sudhāsalilaliptāṁ sa rahasyupagamya rājāna-mabravīt ॥17॥
3.192.19: sa tasya vacanāt tayaiva saha devyā tad vanaṁ prāviśat, sa kadācit tasmin kānane ramye tayaiva saha vyavāharadatha kṣuttr̥ṣṇārditaḥ śrānto’timukta-kāgāramapaśyat ॥19॥
3.192.20: tat praviśya rājā saha priyayā sudhākr̥tāṁ vimalāṁ salilapūrṇāṁ vāpīmapaśyat ॥20॥
3.192.21: dr̥ṣṭvaiva ca tāṁ tasyāśca tīre sahaiva tayā devyā’vātiṣṭhat ॥21॥
3.192.22: atha tāṁ devīṁ sa rājābravīt sādhvavatara vāpīsalilamiti, sā tadvacaḥ śrutvāvatīrya vāpīṁ nyamajjanna punarudamajjat ॥22॥
3.192.23: tāṁ sa mr̥gayamāṇo rājā nāpaśyad vāpīmatha niḥsrāvya maṇḍūkaṁ śvabhramukhe dr̥ṣṭvā kruddha ājñāpayāmāsa sa rājā ॥23॥
3.192.24: sarvatra maṇḍūkavadhaḥ kriyatāmiti yo mayārthī sa māṁ mr̥tamaṇḍūkopāyanamādāyopatiṣṭhediti ॥24॥
3.192.25: atha maṇḍūkavadhe ghore kriyamāṇe dikṣu sarvāsu maṇḍūkān bhayamāviveśa, te bhītā maṇḍūkarājñe yathāvr̥ttaṁ nyavedayan ॥25॥
3.192.27: mā rājan krodhavaśaṁ gamaḥ prasādaṁ kuru nārhasi maṇḍūkānāmanaparādhināṁ vadhaṁ kartumiti, ślokau cātra bhavataḥ— ॥27॥
3.192.31: na hi kṣamyate tanmayā haniṣyāmyetānetairdurātmabhiḥ priyā me bhakṣitā sarvathaiva me vadhyā maṇḍūkā nārhasi vidvan māmuparoddhumiti ॥31॥
3.192.32: sa tad vākyamupalabhya vyathitendriyamanāḥ provāca prasīda rājannahamāyurnāma maṇḍūkarājo mama sā duhitā suśobhanā nāma, tasyā hi dauḥśīlyametad bahavastayā rājāno vipralabdhāḥ pūrvā iti ॥32॥
3.192.33: tamabravīd rājā tayā samarthī sā me dīyatāmiti ॥33॥
3.192.35: sa evamuktvā duhitaraṁ kruddhaḥ śaśāpa yasmāt tvayā rājāno vipralabdhā bahavastasmādabrahmaṇyāni tavāpatyāni bhaviṣyantyānr̥tikatvāt taveti ॥35॥
3.192.36: sa ca rājā tāmupalabhya tasyāṁ surataguṇa-nibaddhahr̥dayo lokatrayaiśvaryamivopalabhya harṣeṇa bāṣpa-kalayā vācā praṇipatyābhipūjya maṇḍūkarājamabravīda-nugr̥hīto’smīti ॥36॥
3.192.38: atha kasyacit kālasya tasyāṁ kumārāstraya-stasya rājñaḥ sambabhūvuḥ śalo dalo balaśceti, tata-steṣāṁ jyeṣṭhaṁ śalaṁ samaye pitā rājye’bhiṣicya tapasi dhr̥tātmā vanaṁ jagāma ॥38॥
3.192.40: sūtaṁ covāca śīghraṁ māṁ vahasveti sa tathoktaḥ sūto rājānamabravīt ॥40॥
3.192.41: na kriyatāmanubandho naiṣa śakyastvayā mr̥go’yaṁ grahītuṁ yadyapi te rathe yuktau vāmyau syātāmiti, tato’bravīd rājā sūtamācakṣva me vāmyau hanmi ca tvāmiti, sa evamukto rājabhayabhītaḥ sūto vāmadeva-śāpabhītaśca san nācakhyau rājñe, tataḥ punaḥ sa rājā khaḍgamudyamya śīghraṁ kathayasveti tamāha haniṣye tvāmiti, sa tadā’’ha rājabhayabhītaḥ sūto vāmadevasyāśvau vāmyau manojavāviti ॥41॥
3.192.42: athainamevaṁ bruvāṇamabravīd rājā vāmadevāśramaṁ prayāhīti sa gatvā vāmadevāśramaṁ tamr̥ṣimabravīt ॥42॥
3.192.43: bhagavan mr̥go me viddhaḥ palāyate sambhāvayitumarhasi vāmyau dātumiti, tamabravīdr̥ṣirdadāni te vāmyau kr̥takāryeṇa bhavatā mamaiva vāmyau niryātyau kṣipramiti, sa ca tāvaśvau pratigr̥hyānujñāpya r̥ṣiṁ prāyād vāmīprayuktena rathena mr̥gaṁ pratigacchaṁścābravīt sūtamaśvaratnāvimāvayogyau brāhmaṇānāṁ naitau pratideyau vāmadevāyetyuktvā mr̥gamavāpya svanagarametyāśvāvantaḥpure’sthāpayat ॥43॥
3.192.44: atharṣiścintayāmāsa taruṇo rājaputraḥ kalyāṇaṁ patramāsādya ramate na pratiniryātayatyaho kaṣṭamiti ॥44॥
3.192.45: sa manasā vicintya māsi pūrṇe śiṣyamabravīt ॥45॥
3.192.46: gacchātreya rājānaṁ brūhi yadi paryāptaṁ niryātayo-pādhyāyavāmyāviti, sa gatvaivaṁ taṁ rājānamabravīt taṁ rājā pratyuvāca rājñāmetadvāhanamanarhā brāhmaṇā ratnānāmevaṁvidhānāṁ kiṁ brāhmaṇānāmaśvaiḥ kāryaṁ sādhu gamyatām ॥46॥
3.192.47: sa gatvaitadupādhyāyāyācaṣṭa tacchrutvā vacanamapriyaṁ vāmadevaḥ krodhaparītātmā svayameva rājānabhigamyā-śvārthamacodayanna cādadad rājā ॥47॥
3.192.49: tābhyāṁ yāhi tvaṁ tatra kāmo maharṣe
3.192.51: mamaiva vāmyau na tavaitau hi viddhi ॥51॥
3.192.60: rājye tadā tatra gatvā sa vipraḥ
3.192.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi maṇḍūkopākhyāne dvinavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥192॥
3.193.1: mārkaṇḍeyamr̥ṣayo brāhmaṇā yudhiṣṭhiraśca paryapr̥ccha-nnr̥ṣiḥ kena dīrghāyurāsīd bako mārkaṇḍeyastu tān sarvānuvāca ॥1॥
3.193.2: mahātapā dīrghāyuśca bako rājan nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ॥2॥
3.193.3: etacchrutvā tu kaunteyo bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha bhārata,
3.193.4: śrūyate hi mahābhāga bako dālbhyo mahātapāḥ,
priyaḥ sakhā ca śakrasya cirajīvī ca sattama ॥4॥
3.193.8: tāḥ prajā muditāḥ sarvā dr̥ṣṭvā balaniṣūdanaḥ ॥8॥
3.193.9: airāvataṁ samāsthāya tāḥ paścan muditāḥ prajāḥ ॥9॥
3.193.11: udapānaṁ prapā vāpī taḍāgāni saraṁsi ca ॥11॥
3.193.16: tataḥ praśnaṁ bakaṁ deva uvāca tridaśeśvaraḥ ॥16॥
3.193.17: samākhyāhi mama brahman kiṁ duḥkhaṁ cirajīvinām ॥17॥
3.193.23: prāpnuvanti viparyāsaṁ kiṁ nu duḥkhataraṁ tataḥ ॥23॥
3.193.27: samākhyāhi mama brahman kiṁ sukhaṁ cirajīvinām,
aṣṭame dvādaśe vāpi śākaṁ yaḥ pacate gr̥he ॥27॥
3.193.29: api śākaṁ pacānasya sukhaṁ vai maghavan gr̥he,
3.193.30: parasya tu gr̥he bhoktuḥ paribhūtasya nityaśaḥ ॥30॥
3.193.32: dhigastu tasya tad bhuktaṁ kr̥paṇasya durātmanaḥ,
3.193.33: śiṣṭānyannāni yo bhuṅkte kiṁ vai sukhataraṁ tataḥ,
3.193.34: dattvā yastvatithibhyo vai bhuṅkte tenaiva nityaśaḥ,
3.193.35: yadeno yauvanakr̥taṁ tat sarvaṁ naśyate dhruvam ॥35॥
3.193.36: sadakṣiṇasya bhuktasya dvijasya tu kare gatam,
yad vāri vāriṇā siñcet taddhyenastarate kṣaṇāt ॥36॥
3.193.37: etāścānyāśca vai bahvīḥ kathayitvā kathāḥ śubhāḥ,
bakena saha devendra āpr̥cchya tridivaṁ gataḥ ॥37॥
3.193.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi brāhmaṇamahābhāgye bakaśakrasaṁvāde trinavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥193॥
3.194.2: kathitaṁ brāhmaṇamahābhāgyaṁ rājanyamahābhāgyamidānīṁ śuśrūṣāmaha iti tānuvāca mārkaṇḍeyo maharṣiḥ śrūyatā-miti idānīṁ rājanyānāṁ mahābhāgyamiti, kurūṇāmanya-tamaḥ suhotro nāma rājā maharṣīnabhigamya nivr̥tya rathasthameva rājānamauśīnaraṁ śibiṁ dadarśābhimukhaṁ tau sametya paraspareṇa yathāvayaḥ pūjāṁ prayujya guṇasāmyena paraspareṇa tulyātmānau viditvānyonyasya panthānaṁ na dadatustatra nāradaḥ prādurāsīt kimidaṁ bhavantau parasparasya panthānamāvr̥tya tiṣṭhata iti ॥2॥
3.194.3: tāvūcaturnāradaṁ naitad bhagavan pūrvakarmakartrādibhi-rviśiṣṭasya panthā upadiśyate samarthāya vā āvāṁ ca sakhyaṁ paraspareṇopagatau taccāvadhānato’tyutkr̥ṣṭamadharo-ttaraṁ paribhraṣṭaṁ nāradastvevamuktaḥ ślokatrayamapaṭhat— ॥3॥
3.194.7: tadubhāveva bhavantāvudārau va idānīṁ bhavadbhyāmanya-tamaḥ so’pasarpatu etad vai nidarśanamityuktvā tūṣṇīṁ nārado babhūva, etacchrutvā tu kauravyaḥ śibiṁ pradakṣiṇaṁ kr̥tvā panthānaṁ dattvā bahukarmabhiḥ praśasya prayayau ॥7॥
3.194.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi śibicarite caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥194॥
3.195.1: idamanyacchrūyatāṁ yayātirnāhuṣo rājā rājyasthaḥ paurajanāvr̥ta āsāñcakre gurvarthī brāhmaṇa upetyābravīd bho rājan gurvarthaṁ bhikṣeyaṁ samayāditi ॥1॥
3.195.3: taṁ tvāṁ pr̥cchāmi kathaṁ tu rājan
3.195.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi nāhuṣacarite pañcanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥195॥
3.196.2: athācaṣṭa mārkaṇḍeyo mahārāja vr̥ṣadarbhasedukanāmānau rājānau nītimārgaratāvastropāstrakr̥tinau ॥2॥
3.196.3: seduko vr̥ṣadarbhasya bālasyaiva upāṁśuvratamabhyajānāt kupyamadeyaṁ brāhmaṇasya ॥3॥
3.196.4: atha taṁ sedikaṁ brāhmaṇaḥ kaścid vedādhyayanasampanna āśiṣaṁ dattvā gurvarthī bhikṣitavān ॥4॥
3.196.5: aśvasahasraṁ me bhavān dadātviti taṁ seduko brāhmaṇamabravīt ॥5॥
3.196.7: sa tvaṁ gaccha vr̥ṣadarbhasakāśam, rājā parama-dharmajño brāhmaṇa taṁ bhikṣasva, sa te dāsyati tasyaitadupāṁśuvratamiti ॥7॥
3.196.8: atha brāhmaṇo vr̥ṣadarbhasakāśaṁ gatvā aśvasahasramayācat, sa rājā taṁ kaśenātāḍayat ॥8॥
3.196.10: evamuktvā taṁ śapantaṁ rājā’’ha, vipra kiṁ yo na dadāti tubhyamutāhosvid brāhmaṇyametat ॥10॥
3.196.11: rājādhirāja tava samīpaṁ sedukena preṣito bhikṣitu-māgataḥ, tenānuśiṣṭena mayā tvaṁ bhikṣito’si ॥11॥
3.196.12: pūrvāhṇe te dāsyāmi yo me’dya balirāgamiṣyati, yo hanyate kaśayā kathaṁ moghaṁ kṣepaṇaṁ tasya syāt ॥12॥
3.196.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi sedukavr̥ṣadarbhacarite ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥196॥
3.197.1: devānāṁ kathā sañjātā mahītalaṁ gatvā mahīpatiṁ śibimauśīnaraṁ sādhvenaṁ śibiṁ jijñāsyāma iti, evaṁ bho ityuktvā agnīndrāvupatiṣṭhetām ॥1॥
3.197.4: atha purohito rājānamabravīt, prāṇarakṣārthaṁ śyenād bhīto bhavantaṁ prāṇārthī prapadyate ॥4॥
3.197.5: vasu dadātu antavān pārthivo’sya niṣkr̥tiṁ kuryād ghoraṁ kapotasya nipātamāhuḥ ॥5॥
3.197.6: atha kapoto rājānamabravīt, prāṇarakṣārthaṁ śyenād bhīto bhavantaṁ prāṇārthī prapadye aṅgairaṅgāni prāpyārthī munirbhūtvā prāṇāṁstvāṁ prapadye ॥6॥
3.197.7: svādhyāyena karśitaṁ brahmacāriṇaṁ māṁ viddhi, tapasā damena yuktamācāryasyāpratikūlabhāṣiṇam, evaṁ yuktamapāpaṁ māṁ viddhi ॥7॥
3.197.11: yāṁ vai kapoto vadate yāṁ ca śyena
3.197.12: bhītaṁ prapannaṁ yo hi dadāti śatrave
na trāṇaṁ labhet trāṇamicchan sa kāle ॥12॥
3.197.13: bhītaṁ prapannaṁ yo hi dadāti śatrave
3.197.14: bhītaṁ prapannaṁ yo hi dadāti śatrave
3.197.17: pratyāmnāyaṁ tu tvaṁ hyenaṁ mā hiṁsīḥ ॥17॥
3.197.18: saumyo hyayaṁ kiṁ na jānāsi śyena,
3.197.20: ūrordakṣiṇādutkr̥tya svapiśitaṁ tāvad rājan yāvanmāṁsaṁ kapotena samam, tathā tasmāt sādhu trātaḥ kapotaḥ praśaṁseyuśca śibayaḥ kr̥taṁ ca priyaṁ syānmameti ॥20॥
3.197.21: atha sa dakṣiṇādūrorutkr̥tya svamāṁsapeśīṁ tulayā’’dhārayat, gurutara eva kapota āsīt ॥21॥
3.197.22: punaranyamuñcakarta gurutara eva kapotaḥ, evaṁ sarvaṁ samadhikr̥tya śarīraṁ tulāyāmāropayāmāsa, tat tathāpi gurutara eva kapota āsīt ॥22॥
3.197.23: atha rājā svayameva tulāmāruroha, na ca vyalīkamāsīd rājña etad vr̥ttāntaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā trāta ityuktvā prālīyata śyeno’tha rājā abravīt ॥23॥
3.197.24: pr̥cchāmi te śakune ko nu śyenaḥ,
3.197.28: kapotaromāṇaṁ śibinaudbhidaṁ putraṁ prāpsyasi nr̥pa vr̥ṣasaṁhananaṁ yaśodīpyamānaṁ draṣṭāsi śūramr̥ṣabhaṁ saurathānām ॥28॥
3.197.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi śibicarite saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥197॥
3.198.1: bhūya eva mahābhāgyaṁ kathyatāmityabravīt pāṇḍavo mārkaṇḍeyam, athācaṣṭa mārkaṇḍeyaḥ, aṣṭakasya vaiśvāmitreraśvamedhe sarve rājānaḥ prāgacchan ॥1॥
3.198.2: bhrātaraścāsya pratardano vasumanāḥ śibirauśīnara iti, sa ca samāptayajño bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha rathena prāyāt, te ca nāradamāgacchantamabhivādyārohatu bhavān rathamityabruvan ॥2॥
3.198.3: tāṁstathetyuktvā rathamāruroha, atha teṣāmekaḥ surarṣiṁ nāradamabravīt, prasādya bhagavantaṁ kiñcidiccheyaṁ praṣṭumiti ॥3॥
3.198.4: pr̥cchetyabravīdr̥ṣiḥ, so’bravīdāyuṣmantaḥ sarvaguṇapramuditāḥ, athāyuṣmantaṁ svargasthānaṁ caturbhi-ryātavyaṁ syāt ko’vataret, ayamaṣṭako’vatare-dityabravīdr̥ṣiḥ ॥4॥
3.198.5: kiṁ kāraṇamityapr̥cchat, athācaṣṭāṣṭakasya gr̥he mayā uṣitaṁ sa māṁ rathenānuprāvahadathāpaśyamanekāni gosahasrāṇi varṇaśo viviktāni tamahamapr̥cchaṁ kasyemā gāva iti so’bravīt, mayā nisr̥ṣṭā ityetāstenaiva svayaṁ ślāghati kathitena, eṣo’vataredatha tribhiryātavyaṁ sāmprataṁ ko’vataret ॥5॥
3.198.6: pratardana ityabravīdr̥ṣiḥ, tatra kiṁ kāraṇaṁ pratardanasyāpi gr̥he mayoṣitaṁ sa māṁ rathenānuprāvahat ॥6॥
3.198.7: athainaṁ brāhmaṇo’bhikṣetāśvaṁ me dadātu bhavān nivr̥tto dāsyāmītyabravīd brāhmaṇaṁ tvaritameva dīyatā-mityabravīd brāhmaṇastvaritameva sa brāhmaṇasyaivamuktvā dakṣiṇaṁ pārśvamadadat ॥7॥
3.198.8: athānyo’pyaśvārthī brāhmaṇa āgacchat, tathaiva cainamuktvā vāmapārṣṇimabhyadādatha prāyāt punarapi cānyo’pyaśvārthī brāhmaṇa āgacchat tvarito’tha tasmai apanahya vāmaṁ dhuryamadadat ॥8॥
3.198.9: atha prāyāt punaranya āgacchadaśvārthī brāhmaṇastamabravīdatiyāto dāsyāmi tvaritameva me dīyatāmityabravīd brāhmaṇastasmai dattvāśvaṁ rathadhuraṁ gr̥hṇatā vyāhr̥taṁ brāhmaṇānāṁ sāmprataṁ nāsti kiñciditi ॥9॥
3.198.10: ya eṣa dadāti cāsūyati ca tena vyāhr̥tena tathāvataret, atha dvābhyāṁ yātavyamiti ko’vataret ॥10॥
3.198.12: kiṁ kāraṇamityapr̥cchadathācaṣṭa nāradaḥ, ahaṁ paribhraman vasumanaso gr̥hamupasthitaḥ ॥12॥
3.198.13: svastivacanamāsīt puṣparathasya prayojanena tamahamanvagacchaṁ svastivāciteṣu brāhmaṇeṣu ratho brāhmaṇānāṁ darśitaḥ ॥13॥
3.198.14: tamahaṁ rathaṁ prāśaṁsamatha rājābravīd bhagavatā rathaḥ praśastaḥ, eṣa bhagavato ratha iti ॥14॥
3.198.15: atha kadācit punarapyahamupasthitaḥ punareva ca rathaprayojanamāsīt, samyagayameṣa bhagavata ityevaṁ rājābravīditi punareva tr̥tīyaṁ svastivācanaṁ samabhāvayamatha rājā brāhmaṇānāṁ darśayan māmabhiprekṣyābravīt, atho bhagavatā puṣparathasya svastivācanāni suṣṭhu sambhāvitāni etena drohavacane nāvataret ॥15॥
3.198.16: athaikena yātavyaṁ syāt ko’vataret punarnārada āha śibiryāyādahamavatareyamatra kiṁ kāraṇamityabravīt, asāvahaṁ śibinā samo nāsmi yato brāhmaṇaḥ kaścidenamabravīt ॥16॥
3.198.17: śibe annārthyasmīti tamabravīcchibiḥ kiṁ kriyatāmājñāpayatu bhavāniti ॥17॥
3.198.18: athainaṁ brāhmaṇo’bravīd ya eṣa te putro br̥hadgarbho nāma eṣa pramātavya iti tamenaṁ saṁskuru annaṁ copapādaya tato’haṁ pratīkṣya iti, tataḥ putraṁ pramāthya saṁskr̥tya vidhinā sādhayitvā pātryāmarpayitvā śirasā pratigr̥hya brāhmaṇamamr̥gayat ॥18॥
3.198.19: athāsya mr̥gayamāṇasya kaścidācaṣṭa eṣa te brāhmaṇo nagaraṁ praviśya dahati te gr̥haṁ kośāgāramāyudhāgāraṁ stryagāramaśvaśālāṁ hastiśālāṁ ca kruddha iti ॥19॥
3.198.20: atha śibistathaivāvikr̥tamukhavarṇo nagaraṁ praviśya brāhmaṇaṁ tamabravīt siddhaṁ bhagavannannamiti brāhmaṇo na kiñcid vyājahāra vismayādadhomukhaścāsīt ॥20॥
3.198.21: tataḥ prāsādayad brāhmaṇaṁ bhagavan bhujyatāmiti, muhūrtādudvīkṣya śibimabravīt ॥21॥
3.198.22: tvamevaitadaśāneti tatrāha tatheti śibistathaivāvimanā mahitvā kapālamabhyuddhārya bhoktumaicchat ॥22॥
3.198.23: athāsya brāhmaṇo hastamagr̥hṇāt, abravīccainaṁ jitakrodho’si na te kiñcidaparityājyaṁ brāhmaṇārthe brāhmaṇo’pi taṁ mahābhāgaṁ sabhājayat ॥23॥
3.198.24: sa hyudvīkṣamāṇaḥ putramapaśyadagre tiṣṭhantaṁ devakumāramiva puṇyagandhānvitamalaṅkr̥taṁ sarvaṁ ca tamarthaṁ vidhāya brāhmaṇo’ntaradhīyata ॥24॥
3.198.25: tasya rājarṣervidhātā tenaiva veṣeṇa parīkṣārthamāgata iti tasminnantarhite amātyā rājānamūcuḥ, kiṁ prepsunā bhavatā idamevaṁ jānatā kr̥tamiti ॥25॥
3.198.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi rājanyamahābhāgye śibicarite aṣṭanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥198॥
3.199.1: mārkaṇḍeyamr̥ṣayaḥ pāṇḍavāḥ paryapr̥cchannasti kaścid bhavataścirajātatara iti ॥1॥
3.199.2: sa tānuvācāsti khalu rājarṣirindradyumno nāma kṣīṇapuṇyastridivāt pracyutaḥ kīrtiste vyucchinneti sa māmupātiṣṭhadatha pratyabhijānāti māṁ bhavāniti ॥2॥
3.199.3: tamahamabruvaṁ kāryaceṣṭākulatvānna vayaṁ vāsāyanikā grāmaikarātravāsino na pratyabhijānīmo’-pyātmano’rthānāmanuṣṭhānaṁ na śarīropatāpenātmanaḥ samārabhāmo’rthānāmanuṣṭhānam ॥3॥
3.199.3d1: evamukto rājarṣirindradyumnaḥ punarmāmabravīd athāsti kaścit tvattaściraṁ jātatara iti.
3.199.4: asti khalu himavati prāvārakarṇo nāmolūkaḥ prativasati, sa mattaścirajāto bhavantaṁ yadi jānīyāditaḥ prakr̥ṣṭe cādhvani himavāṁstatrāsau prativasatīti ॥4॥
3.199.5: tataḥ sa māmaśvo bhūtvā tatrāvahad yatra babhūvolūkaḥ, athainaṁ sa rājā papraccha pratijānāti māṁ bhavāniti ॥5॥
3.199.6: sa muhūrtamiva dhyātvābravīdenaṁ nābhijānāmi bhavantamiti sa evamukta indradyumnaḥ punastamulūka-mabravīd rājarṣiḥ ॥6॥
3.199.7: athāsti kaścid bhavataḥ sakāśāccirajāta iti sa evamukto’bravīdasti khalvindradyumnaṁ nāma sarastasmin nāḍījaṅgho nāma bakaḥ prativasati so’smattaścirajātatarastaṁ pr̥ccheti tata indradyumno māṁ colūkamādāya tat saro’gacchad yatrāsau nāḍījaṅgho nāma bako babhūva ॥7॥
3.199.8: so’smābhiḥ pr̥ṣṭo bhavānimamindradyumnaṁ rājāna-mabhijānātīti sa evaṁ muhurtaṁ dhyātvābravīnnā-bhijānāmyahamidradyumnaṁ rājānamiti, tataḥ so’smābhiḥ pr̥ṣṭaḥ kaścid bhavato’nyaścirajātataro’stīti, sa no’bravīdasti khalvasminneva sarasyakūpāro nāma kacchapaḥ prativasati, sa mattaścirajātataraḥ, sa yadi kathañcidabhijānīyādimaṁ rājānaṁ tamakūpāraṁ pr̥cchadhvamiti ॥8॥
3.199.9: tataḥ sa bakastamakūpāraṁ kacchapaṁ vijñāpayāmāsa, asmākamabhipretaṁ bhavantaṁ kiñcidarthamabhipraṣṭuṁ sādhvāgamyatāṁ tāvaditi tacchrutvā kacchapastasmāt sarasa utthāyābhyagacchad yatra tiṣṭhāmo vayaṁ tasya sarasastīre āgataṁ cainaṁ vayamapr̥cchāma bhavānindradyumnaṁ rājānamabhijānātīti ॥9॥
3.199.10: sa muhūrtaṁ dhyātvā bāṣpasampūrṇanayana udvigna-hr̥dayo vepamāno visañjñakalpaḥ prāñjalirabravīt, kimahamenaṁ na pratyabhijñāsyāmīha hyanena sahasra-kr̥tvaścitiṣu yūpā āhitāḥ ॥10॥
3.199.12: athaitat sakalaṁ kacchapenodāhr̥taṁ śrutvā tadanantaraṁ devalokād devarathaḥ prādurāsīd vācaścāśrūyantendradyumnaṁ prati prastutaste svargo yathocitaṁ sthānaṁ pratipadyasva kīrtimānasyavyagro yāhīti ॥12॥
3.199.16: ityetacchrutvā sa rājābravīt tiṣṭha tāvad yāvadimau vr̥ddhau yathāsthānaṁ pratipādayāmīti ॥16॥
3.199.17: sa māṁ prāvārakarṇaṁ colūkaṁ yathocite sthāne pratipādya tenaiva yānena saṁsthito yathocitaṁ sthānaṁ pratipede, tanmayānubhūtaṁ cirajīvinedr̥śamiti pāṇḍavānuvāca mārkaṇḍeyaḥ ॥17॥
3.199.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi indradyumnopākhyāne navanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥199॥
3.200.1: śrutvā sa rājā rājarṣerindradyumnasya tat tadā,
3.200.2: yudhiṣṭhiro mahārāja punaḥ papraccha taṁ munim,
3.200.3: yathā phalaṁ samaśnāti tathā tvaṁ kathayasva me ॥3॥
3.200.4: vr̥thā janmāni catvāri vr̥thā dānāni ṣoḍaśa,
vr̥thā janma hyaputrasya ye ca dharmabahiṣkr̥tāḥ ॥4॥
3.200.5: parapākeṣu ye’śnanti ātmārthaṁ ca pacet tu yaḥ,
paryaśnanti vr̥thā ye ca tadasatyaṁ prakīrtyate ॥5॥
3.200.6: vyarthaṁ tu patite dānaṁ brāhmaṇe taskare tathā ॥6॥
3.200.8: brahmabandhuṣu yad dattaṁ yad dattaṁ vr̥ṣalīpatau,
strījaneṣu ca yad dattaṁ vyālagrāhe tathaiva ca ॥8॥
3.200.9: paricārakeṣu yad dattaṁ vr̥thā dānāni ṣoḍaśa,
tamovr̥tastu yo dadyād bhayāt krodhāt tathaiva ca ॥9॥
3.200.10: bhuṅkte ca dānaṁ tat sarvaṁ garbhasthastu naraḥ sadā,
3.200.12: kena viprā viśeṣeṇa tārayanti taranti ca ॥12॥
3.200.13: nāvaṁ vedamayīṁ kr̥tvā tārayanti taranti ca ॥13॥
3.200.15: anantaṁ puṇyalokaṁ tu gantāsi tvaṁ na saṁśayaḥ ॥15॥
3.200.19: ye ye śrāddhe na yujyante mūkāndhabadhirādayaḥ,
3.200.20: pratigrahaśca vai deyaḥ śr̥ṇu yasya yudhiṣṭhira,
3.200.21: pradātāraṁ yathā’’tmānaṁ tārayed yaḥ sa śaktimān ॥21॥
3.200.24: prayacchanti tu ye rājan nopasarpanti te samam,
3.200.26: kapilāyāḥ pradānāt tu mucyate nātra saṁśayaḥ,
3.200.30: na tārayati dātāraṁ brāhmaṇaṁ naiva naiva tu,
3.200.31: suvarṇānāṁ śataṁ tena dattaṁ bhavati śāśvatam,
anaḍvāhaṁ tu yo dadyād balavantaṁ dhurandharam ॥31॥
3.200.32: sa nistarati durgāṇi svargalokaṁ ca gacchati,
vasundharāṁ tu yo dadyād dvijāya vidurātmane ॥32॥
3.200.33: pr̥cchanti cātra dātāraṁ vadanti puruṣā bhuvi ॥33॥
3.200.34: teṣāmeva śramārtānāṁ yo hyannaṁ kathayed budhaḥ ॥34॥
3.200.35: tasmāt tvaṁ sarvadānāni hitvānnaṁ samprayaccha ha ॥35॥
3.200.36: yathāśakti ca yo dadyādannaṁ vipreṣu saṁskr̥tam ॥36॥
3.200.37: annameva viśiṣṭaṁ hi tasmāt parataraṁ na ca ॥37॥
3.200.38: annaṁ prajāpatiścoktaḥ sa ca saṁvatsaro mataḥ,
3.200.39: tasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca,
tasmādannaṁ viśiṣṭaṁ hi sarvebhya iti viśrutam ॥39॥
3.200.42: ayācitapradātā ca samaṁ yānti trayo janāḥ ॥42॥
3.200.44: kīdr̥śaṁ kimpramāṇaṁ vā kathaṁ vā tanmahāmune,
3.200.45: kathayiṣyāmi te rājan dharmyaṁ dharmabhr̥tāṁ vara ॥45॥
3.200.47: na tatra vr̥kṣacchāyā vā pānīyaṁ ketanāni ca ॥47॥
3.200.48: viśramed yatra vai śrāntaḥ puruṣo’dhvani karśitaḥ,
3.200.50: hayādīnāṁ prakr̥ṣṭāni te’dhvānaṁ yānti vai narāḥ,
3.200.52: bhūmidāstu sukhaṁ yānti sarvaiḥ kāmaiḥ sutarpitāḥ ॥52॥
3.200.57: antarā caiva nāśnāti tasya lokā hyanāmayāḥ,
3.200.58: tatra puṣyodakā nāma nadī teṣāṁ vidhīyate,
3.200.59: ye ca duṣkr̥takarmāṇaḥ pūyaṁ teṣāṁ vidhīyate,
evaṁ nadī mahārāja sarvakāmapradā hi sā ॥59॥
3.200.63: etat te śataśaḥ proktaṁ kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥63॥
3.200.65: dharmāntaraṁ prati kathāṁ kathyamānāṁ mayā nr̥pa,
3.200.66: kapilāyāṁ tu dattāyāṁ yat phalaṁ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare,
3.200.69: yāvad vatsasya vai pādau śiraścaiva pradr̥śyate,
3.200.70: tāvat gau pr̥thivī jñeyā yāvad garbhaṁ na muñcati ॥70॥
3.200.71: yāvanti tasyā romāṇi vatsasya ca yudhiṣṭhira,
3.200.73: phalānāṁ phalamaśnāti tadā dattvā ca bhārata ॥73॥
3.200.74: caturantā bhaved dattā pr̥thivī nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥74॥
3.200.75: yo dvijaḥ śabdarahitaṁ sa kṣamastāraṇāya vai ॥75॥
3.200.76: japanti saṁhitāṁ samyak te nityaṁ tāraṇakṣamāḥ ॥76॥
3.200.77: havyaṁ kavyaṁ ca yat kiñcit sarvaṁ tacchrotriyo’rhati,
dattaṁ hi śrotriye sādhau jvalite’gnau yathā hutam ॥77॥
3.200.80: śrutvemāṁ tu kathāṁ rājan na bhavantīha mānavāḥ ॥80॥
3.200.81: kiṁ tacchaucaṁ bhaved yena vipraḥ śuddhaḥ sadā bhaved,
3.200.82: vākśaucaṁ karmaśaucaṁ ca yacca śaucaṁ jalātmakam,
tribhiḥ śaucairupeto yaḥ sa svargī nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥82॥
3.200.84: sa tayā pāvito devyā brāhmaṇo naṣṭakilbiṣaḥ,
3.200.85: ye cāsya dāruṇāḥ kecid grahāḥ sūryādayo divi,
te cāsya saumyā jāyante śivāḥ śivatarāḥ sadā ॥85॥
3.200.87: nādhyāpanād yājanād vā anyasmād vā pratigrahāt,
3.200.88: durvedā vā suvedā vā prākr̥tāḥ saṁskr̥tāstathā,
3.200.89: yathā śmaśāne dīptaujāḥ pāvako naiva duṣyati,
evaṁ vidvānavidvān vā brāhmaṇo daivataṁ mahat ॥89॥
3.200.91: yatra tiṣṭhanti vai viprāstannāma nagaraṁ nr̥pa ॥91॥
3.200.92: tat tannagaramityāhuḥ pārtha tīrthaṁ ca tad bhavet ॥92॥
3.200.93: rakṣitāraṁ ca rājānaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ ca tapasvinam,
3.200.94: sadbhiḥ sambhāṣaṇaṁ caiva praśastaṁ kīrtyate budhaiḥ ॥94॥
3.200.97: sarvāṇyetāni mithyā syuryadi bhāvo na nirmalaḥ ॥97॥
3.200.99: te tapanti mahātmāno na śarīrasya śoṣaṇam ॥99॥
3.200.100: hiṁsā sā tapasastasya nānāśitvaṁ tapaḥ smr̥tam ॥100॥
3.200.103: ajñātaṁ karma kr̥tvā ca kleśo nānyat prahīyate,
3.200.105: na jaṭādhāraṇād vāpi na tu sthaṇḍilaśayyayā ॥105॥
3.200.110: ślokena yadi vārdhena kṣīṇaṁ tasya prayojanam ॥110॥
3.200.112: nāyaṁ loko’sti na paro na sukhaṁ saṁśayātmanaḥ,
3.200.113: udvijet sa tu vedebhyo dāvāgneriva mānavaḥ ॥113॥
3.200.114: śuṣkaṁ tarkaṁ parityajya āśrayasva śrutiṁ smr̥tim,
3.200.120: iṣṭaṁ cedaṁ sadā mahyaṁ rājan gauravatastathā ॥120॥
3.200.122: vaiśyaṁ tu vāsayed yastu sarvayajñaiḥ sa iṣṭavān ॥122॥
3.200.128: yaḥ kāñcanaṁ gāśca mahīṁ ca dadyāt ॥128॥
3.200.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi dānamāhātmye dviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥200॥
3.201.1: śrutvā tu rājā rājarṣerindradyumnasya tat tathā,
3.201.9: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śr̥ṇu rājan yudhiṣṭhira,
3.201.10: yathā sa rājā ikṣvākuḥ kuvalāśvo mahīpatiḥ,
3.201.13: tasya prītaḥ sa bhagavān sākṣād darśanameyivān,
dr̥ṣṭvaiva carṣiḥ prahvastaṁ tuṣṭāva vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ ॥13॥
3.201.14: sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni jaṅgamāni tathaiva ca ॥14॥
3.201.15: brahma vedāśca vedyaṁ ca tvayā sr̥ṣṭaṁ mahādyute,
3.201.17: ūrū te parvatā deva khaṁ nābhirmadhusūdana,
3.201.20: tvayi tuṣṭe jagat svāsthyaṁ tvayi kruddhe mahad bhayam,
3.201.23: tvaṁ hi kartā vikartā ca bhūtānāmiha sarvaśaḥ ॥23॥
3.201.25: paryāpto me varo hyeṣa yadahaṁ dr̥ṣṭavān harim ॥25॥
3.201.26: puruṣaṁ śāśvataṁ divyaṁ sraṣṭāraṁ jagataḥ prabhum,
3.201.27: avaśyaṁ hi tvayā brahman matto grāhyo varo dvija,
evaṁ sa chandyamānastu vareṇa hariṇā tadā ॥27॥
3.201.29: dharme satye dame caiva buddhirbhavatu me sadā,
abhyāsaśca bhaved bhaktyā tvayi nityaṁ mameśvara ॥29॥
3.201.32: tapasyati tapo ghoraṁ śr̥ṇu yastaṁ haniṣyati,
3.201.33: tasya putraḥ śucirdāntaḥ kuvalāśva iti śrutaḥ ॥33॥
3.201.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi dhundhumāropākhyāne ekādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥201॥
3.202.2: śaśādasya tu dāyādaḥ kakutstho nāma vīryavān,
3.202.4: tasya śrāvastako jñeyaḥ śrāvastī yena nirmitā,
3.202.11: bhavatā rakṣaṇaṁ kāryaṁ tat tāvat kartumarhasi,
3.202.12: tvayā hi pr̥thivī rājan rakṣyamāṇā mahātmanā,
3.202.13: pālane hi mahān dharmaḥ prajānāmiha dr̥śyate,
na tathā dr̥śyate’raṇye mābhūt te buddhirīdr̥śī ॥13॥
3.202.14: īdr̥śo na hi rājendra dharmaḥ kvacana dr̥śyate,
prajānāṁ pālane yo vai purā rājarṣibhiḥ kr̥taḥ ॥14॥
3.202.19: taṁ nihatya mahārāja vanaṁ tvaṁ gantumarhasi,
3.202.22: taṁ vināśaya bhadraṁ te mā te buddhirato’nyathā,
3.202.26: tena rājan na śaknomi tasmin sthātuṁ sva āśrame,
3.202.27: tvaṁ hi tasya vināśāya paryāpta iti me matiḥ ॥27॥
3.202.28: viṣṇunā ca varo dattaḥ pūrvaṁ mama mahīpate ॥28॥
3.202.30: tat tejastvaṁ samādhāya rājendra bhuvi duḥsaham,
3.202.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi dhundhumāropākhyāne dvyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥202॥
3.203.2: putro mamāyaṁ bhagavan kuvalāśva iti smr̥taḥ ॥2॥
3.203.3: priyaṁ ca te sarvametat kariṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ॥3॥
3.203.7: kasya putro’tha naptā vā etadicchāmi veditum,
evaṁ mahābalo daityo na śruto me tapodhana ॥7॥
3.203.12: suṣvāpa bhagavān viṣṇurapsu yogata eva saḥ,
3.203.23: dr̥ṣṭvā tāvabravīd devaḥ svāgataṁ vāṁ mahābalau,
dadāmi vāṁ varaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ prītirhi mama jāyate ॥23॥
3.203.25: āvāṁ varaya deva tvaṁ varadau svaḥ surottama,
dātārau svo varaṁ tubhyaṁ tad bravīhyavicārayan ॥25॥
3.203.26: yuvāṁ hi vīryasampannau na vāmasti samaḥ pumān ॥26॥
3.203.28: satye dharme ca niratau viddhyāvāṁ puruṣottama ॥28॥
3.203.29: bale rūpe ca śaurye ca na śame ca samo’sti nau,
dharme tapasi dāne ca śīlasattvadameṣu ca ॥29॥
3.203.30: uktaṁ pratikuruṣva tvaṁ kālo hi duratikramaḥ ॥30॥
3.203.32: vara eṣa vr̥to deva tad viddhi surasattama ॥32॥
3.203.33: anr̥taṁ mā bhaved deva yaddhi nau saṁśrutaṁ tadā,
3.203.34: avakāśaṁ pr̥thivyāṁ vā divi vā madhusūdanaḥ ॥34॥
3.203.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi dhundhumāropākhyāne tryadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥203॥
3.204.2: tasmai brahmā dadau prīto varaṁ vavre sa ca prabhum ॥2॥
3.204.3: avadhyo’haṁ bhaveyaṁ vai vara eṣa vr̥to mayā ॥3॥
3.204.4: sa evamuktastatpādau mūrdhnā spr̥śya jagāma ha ॥4॥
3.204.6: sa tu devān sagandharvān jitvā dhundhuramarṣaṇaḥ,
babādha sarvānasakr̥d viṣṇuṁ devāṁśca vai bhr̥śam ॥6॥
3.204.7: āgamya ca sa duṣṭātmā taṁ deśaṁ bharatarṣabha ॥7॥
3.204.8: bādhate sma paraṁ śaktyā tamuttaṅkāśramaṁ vibho,
3.204.14: tasmin prayāte durdharṣe divi śabdo mahānabhūt,
3.204.16: śītaśca vāyuḥ pravavau prayāṇe tasya dhīmataḥ,
vipāṁsulāṁ mahīṁ kurvan vavarṣa ca sureśvaraḥ ॥16॥
3.204.19: sa gato nr̥patiḥ kṣipraṁ putraistaiḥ sarvato diśam ॥19॥
3.204.24: paṭṭiśaiḥ parighaiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiśca vimalaiḥ śitaiḥ ॥24॥
3.204.26: āsyād vaman pāvakaṁ sa saṁvartakasamaṁ tadā,
tān sarvān nr̥pateḥ putrānadahat svena tejasā ॥26॥
3.204.30: tasya vāri mahārāja susrāva bahu dehataḥ,
3.204.31: yogī yogena vahniṁ ca śamayāmāsa vāriṇā,
3.204.36: dadyāṁ vittaṁ dvijāgryebhyaḥ śatrūṇāṁ cāpi durjayaḥ,
sakhyaṁ ca viṣṇunā me syād bhūteṣvadroha eva ca ॥36॥
3.204.37: tathāstviti tato devaiḥ prītairuktaḥ sa pārthivaḥ ॥37॥
3.204.43: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥43॥
3.204.45: śr̥ṇuyād yaḥ sa dharmātmā putravāṁśca bhavennaraḥ,
na ca vyādhibhayaṁ kiñcit prāpnoti vigatajvaraḥ ॥45॥
3.204.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi dhundhumāropākhyāne caturadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥204॥
3.205.2: kathyamānaṁ tvayā vipra sūkṣmaṁ dharmyaṁ ca tattvataḥ ॥2॥
3.205.4: pitā mātā ca bhagavan gurureva ca sattama,
3.205.5: mānyā hi guravaḥ sarve ekapatnyastathā striyaḥ,
3.205.7: patiṁ daivatavaccāpi cintayantyaḥ sthitā hi yāḥ,
bhagavan duṣkaraṁ tvetat pratibhāti mama prabho ॥7॥
3.205.8: mātāpitrośca śuśrūṣā strīṇāṁ bhartari ca dvija,
strīṇāṁ dharmāt sughorāddhi nānyaṁ paśyāmi duṣkaram ॥8॥
3.205.9: sādhvācārāḥ striyo brahman yat kurvanti sadā’’dr̥tāḥ,
duṣkaraṁ khalu kurvanti pitaraṁ mātaraṁ ca vai ॥9॥
3.205.10: ekapatnyaśca yā nāryo yāśca satyaṁ vadantyuta,
kukṣiṇā daśa māsāṁśca garbhaṁ sandhārayanti yāḥ ॥10॥
3.205.12: prajāyate sutān nāryo duḥkhena mahatā vibho,
3.205.13: svakarma kurvanti sadā duṣkaraṁ tacca me matam ॥13॥
3.205.17: duṣkaraṁ kurute mātā vivardhayati yā prajāḥ ॥17॥
3.205.19: evaṁ kr̥ṣchreṇa mahatā putraṁ prāpya sudurlabham,
3.205.20: āśaṁsate hi putreṣu pitā mātā ca bhārata,
yaśaḥ kīrtimathaiśvaryaṁ prajā dharmaṁ tathaiva ca ॥20॥
3.205.21: tayorāśāṁ tu saphalāṁ yaḥ karoti sa dharmavit,
pitā mātā ca rājendra tuṣyato yasya nityaśaḥ ॥21॥
3.205.22: iha pretya ca tasyātha kīrtirdharmaśca śāśvataḥ,
3.205.23: yā tu bhartari śuśrūṣā tayā svargaṁ jayatyuta,
3.205.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi pativratopākhyāne pañcādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥205॥
3.206.7: ityuktvā bahuśo vidvān grāmaṁ bhaikṣyāya saṁśritaḥ,
3.206.8: praviṣṭastat kulaṁ yatra pūrvaṁ caritavāṁstu saḥ,
3.206.9: śaucaṁ tu yāvat kurute bhājanasya kuṭumbinī,
3.206.10: sā tu dr̥ṣṭvā patiṁ sādhvī brāhmaṇaṁ vyavahāya tam ॥10॥
3.206.15: bhartuścāpi hitaṁ yat tat satataṁ sānuvartate,
3.206.16: sā brāhmaṇaṁ tadā dr̥ṣṭvā saṁsthitaṁ bhaikṣyakāṅkṣiṇam,
3.206.18: kimidaṁ bhavati tvaṁ māṁ tiṣṭhetyuktvā varāṅgane,
3.206.20: kṣantumarhasi me vidvan bhartā me daivataṁ mahat,
sa cāpi kṣudhitaḥ śrāntaḥ prāptaḥ śuśrūṣito mayā ॥20॥
3.206.21: brāhmaṇā na garīyāṁso garīyāṁste patiḥ kr̥taḥ,
3.206.22: avalipte na jānīṣe vr̥ddhānāṁ na śrutaṁ tvayā ॥22॥
3.206.23: nāhaṁ balākā viprarṣe tyaja krodhaṁ tapodhana ॥23॥
3.206.24: anayā kruddhayā dr̥ṣṭyā kruddhaḥ kiṁ māṁ kariṣyasi,
3.206.25: jānāmi tejo viprāṇāṁ mahābhāgyaṁ ca dhīmatām ॥25॥
3.206.26: apeyaḥ sāgaraḥ krodhāt kr̥to hi lavaṇodakaḥ,
3.206.30: patiśuśrūṣayā dharmo yaḥ sa me rocate dvija,
daivateṣvapi sarveṣu bhartā me daivataṁ param ॥30॥
3.206.32: balākā hi tvayā dagdhā roṣāt tad viditaṁ mayā,
3.206.33: yaḥ krodhamohau tyajati taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ,
yo vadediha satyāni guruṁ santoṣayeta ca ॥33॥
3.206.34: hiṁsitaśca na hiṁseta taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ,
3.206.35: kāmakrodhau vaśau yasya taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ,
3.206.36: sarvadharmeṣu ca ratastaṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ,
3.206.37: dadyād vāpi yathāśakti taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ,
3.206.38: svādhyāyavānamatto vai taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ,
3.206.39: satyaṁ tathā vyāharatāṁ nānr̥te ramate manaḥ,
3.206.41: durjñeyaḥ śāśvato dharmaḥ sa ca satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
3.206.42: bahudhā dr̥śyate dharmaḥ sūkṣma eva dvijottama,
3.206.43: na tu tattvena bhagavan dharma vetsīti me matiḥ,
yadi vipra na jānīṣe dharma paramakaṁ dvija ॥43॥
3.206.44: dharmavyādhaṁ tataḥ pr̥ccha gatvā tu mithilāṁ purīm,
3.206.45: mithilāyāṁ vased vyādhaḥ sa te dharmān pravakṣyati,
tatra gacchasva bhadraṁ te yathākāmaṁ dvijottama ॥45॥
3.206.46: striyo hyavadhyāḥ sarveṣāṁ ye ca dharmavido janāḥ ॥46॥
3.206.47: prīto’smi tava bhadraṁ te gataḥ krodhaśca śobhane,
3.206.48: tayā visr̥ṣṭo nirgamya svameva bhavanaṁ yayau,
3.206.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi pativratopākhyāne ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥206॥
3.207.3: kr̥tātmā dharmavit tasyāṁ vyādho nivasate kila,
3.207.4: iti sañcitya manasā śraddadhānaḥ striyā vacaḥ,
3.207.10: apaśyat tatra gatvā taṁ sūnāmadhye vyavasthitam ॥10॥
3.207.12: sa tu jñātvā dvijaṁ prāptaṁ sahasā sambhramotthitaḥ,
3.207.13: abhivādaye tvāṁ bhagavan svāgataṁ te dvijottama,
ahaṁ vyādho hi bhadraṁ te kiṁ karomi praśādhi mām ॥13॥
3.207.15: śrutvā ca tasya tad vākyaṁ sa vipro bhr̥śavismitaḥ,
3.207.16: gr̥haṁ gacchāva bhagavan yadi te rocate’nagha ॥16॥
3.207.17: agratastu dvijaṁ kr̥tvā sa jagāma gr̥haṁ prati ॥17॥
3.207.18: arghyeṇa ca sa vai tena vyādhena dvijasattamaḥ ॥18॥
3.207.19: karmaitad vai na sadr̥śaṁ bhavataḥ pratibhāti me,
anutapye bhr̥śaṁ tāta tava ghoreṇa karmaṇā ॥19॥
3.207.20: vartamānasya me dharme sve manyuṁ mā kr̥thā dvija ॥20॥
3.207.22: satyaṁ vade nābhyasūye yathāśakti dadāmi ca,
3.207.25: karma śūdre kr̥ṣirvaiśye saṅgrāmaḥ kṣatriye smr̥taḥ,
brahmacaryaṁ tapo mantrāḥ satyaṁ ca brāhmaṇe sadā ॥25॥
3.207.26: vikarmāṇaśca ye kecit tān yunakti svakarmasu ॥26॥
3.207.27: bhetavyaṁ hi sadā rājñaḥ prajānāmadhipā hi te,
3.207.29: sa eṣa janako rājā durvr̥ttamapi cet sutam,
daṇḍyaṁ daṇḍe nikṣipati tathā na glāti dhārmikam ॥29॥
3.207.30: śrīśca rājyaṁ ca daṇḍaśca kṣatriyāṇāṁ dvijottama ॥30॥
3.207.32: na svayaṁ hanmi viprarṣe vikrīṇāmi sadā tvaham ॥32॥
3.207.33: na bhakṣayāmi māṁsāni r̥tugāmī tathā hyaham,
sadopavāsī ca tathā naktabhojī sadā dvija ॥33॥
3.207.35: adharmo vardhate cāpi saṅkīryante tataḥ prajāḥ ॥35॥
3.207.37: sa eṣa rājā janakaḥ prajā dharmeṇa paśyati ॥37॥
3.207.38: ye caiva māṁ praśaṁsanti ye ca nindanti mānavāḥ ॥38॥
3.207.39: ye jīvanti svadharmeṇa saṁyuñjanti ca pārthivāḥ ॥39॥
3.207.41: yathārhaṁ prati pūjā ca sarvabhūteṣu vai sadā,
3.207.42: na ca kāmānna saṁrambhānna dveṣād dharmamutsr̥jet ॥42॥
3.207.43: priye nātibhr̥śaṁ hr̥ṣyedapriye na ca sañjvaret,
na muhyedarthakr̥cchreṣu na ca dharmaṁ parityajet ॥43॥
3.207.45: na pāpe pratipāpaḥ syāt sādhureva sadā bhavet,
ātmanaiva hataḥ pāpo yaḥ pāpaṁ kartumicchati ॥45॥
3.207.47: aśraddadhānā dharmasya te naśyanti na saṁśayaḥ,
3.207.49: api ceha śriyā hīnaḥ kr̥tavidyaḥ prakāśate ॥49॥
3.207.50: na kaścid guṇasampannaḥ prakāśo bhuvi dr̥śyate ॥50॥
3.207.51: na tat kuryāṁ punariti dvitīyāt parimucyate ॥51॥
3.207.54: pāpaṁ kr̥tvā hi manyeta nāhamasmīti pūruṣaḥ,
3.207.55d1: apaśyannātmano doṣān sa pāpaḥ pretya naśyati.
3.207.57: yathā’’dityaḥ samudyan vai tamaḥ pūrvaṁ vyapohati,
3.207.59: sarvaṁ hi vidyate teṣu śiṣṭācāraḥ sudurlabhaḥ ॥59॥
3.207.61: etadicchāmi bhadraṁ te śrotuṁ dharmabhr̥tāṁ vara,
tvatto mahāmate vyādha tad bravīhi yathātatham ॥61॥
3.207.62: yajño dānaṁ tapo vedāḥ satyaṁ ca dvijasattama,
3.207.66: śiṣṭācāre manaḥ kr̥tvā pratiṣṭhāpya ca sarvaśaḥ,
yāmayaṁ labhate vr̥ttiṁ sā na śakyā hyato’nyathā ॥66॥
3.207.73: śiṣṭācāre bhavet sādhū rāgaḥ śūkleva vāsasi ॥73॥
3.207.74: ahiṁsā paramo dharmaḥ sa ca satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
satye kr̥tvā pratiṣṭhāṁ tu pravartante pravr̥ttayaḥ ॥74॥
3.207.77: ārambhonyāyayukto yaḥ sa hi dharma iti smr̥taḥ,
3.207.81: dharmaṁ dharmeṇa paśyantaḥ svarga yānti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥81॥
3.207.85: paruṣaṁ ca na bhāṣante sadā santo dvijapriyāḥ,
3.207.89: pīḍayā ca kalatrasya bhr̥tyānāṁ ca samāhitāḥ ॥89॥
3.207.94: na caiva druhyed dadyācca satyaṁ caiva sadā vadet,
3.207.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi brāhmaṇavyādhasaṁvāde saptādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥207॥
3.208.2: vidhistu balavān brahman dustaraṁ hi purā kr̥tam,
3.208.3: vidhinā hi hate pūrvaṁ nimittaṁ ghātako bhavet ॥3॥
3.208.4: yeṣāṁ hatānāṁ māṁsāni vikrīṇāmīha vai dvija ॥4॥
3.208.5: teṣāmapi bhaved dharma upayoge na bhakṣaṇe,
3.208.8: svadharma iti kr̥tvā tu na tyajāmi dvijottama,
3.208.9: svakarmanirato yastu dharmaḥ sa iti niścayaḥ ॥9॥
3.208.10: pūrvaṁ hi vihitaṁ karma dehinaṁ na vimuñcati,
3.208.11: draṣṭavyā tu bhavet prajñā krūre karmaṇi vartatā,
kathaṁ karma śubhaṁ kuryāṁ kathaṁ mucye parābhavāt ॥11॥
3.208.12: dāne ca satyavākye ca guruśuśrūṣaṇe tathā ॥12॥
3.208.13: dvijātipūjane cāhaṁ dharme ca nirataḥ sadā,
3.208.14: kr̥ṣiṁ sādhviti manyante tatra hiṁsā parā smr̥tā,
karṣanto lāṅgalaiḥ puṁso ghnanti bhūmiśayān bahūn,
3.208.15: sarvāṇyetāni jīvāni tatra kiṁ pratibhāti te ॥15॥
3.208.16: adhyākramya paśūṁścāpi ghnanti vai bhakṣayanti ca,
3.208.17: jīvā hi bahavo brahman vr̥kṣeṣu ca phaleṣu ca,
udake bahavaścāpi tatra kiṁ pratibhāti te ॥17॥
3.208.18: matsyān grasante matsyāśca tatra kiṁ pratibhāti te ॥18॥
3.208.20: padbhyāṁ ghnanti narā vipra tatra kiṁ pratibhāti te ॥20॥
3.208.22: avijñānācca hiṁsanti tatra kiṁ pratibhāti te ॥22॥
3.208.23: ke na hiṁsanti jīvān vai loke’smin dvijasattama,
bahu sañcitya iti vai nāsti kaścidahiṁsakaḥ ॥23॥
3.208.24: kurvantyeva hi hiṁsāṁ te yatnādalpatarā bhavet ॥24॥
3.208.25: mahāghorāṇi karmāṇi kr̥tvā lajjanti vai dvija ॥25॥
3.208.28: dharmayuktamadharmaṁ ca tatra kiṁ pratibhāti te ॥28॥
3.208.29: svakarmanirato yo hi sa yaśaḥ prāpnuyānmahat ॥29॥
3.208.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi pativratopākhyāne brāhmaṇavyādhasaṁvāde aṣṭādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥208॥
3.209.5: yat karotyaśubhaṁ karma śubhaṁ vā yadi sattama,
avaśyaṁ tat samāpnoti puruṣo nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥5॥
3.209.6: viṣamāṁ ca daśāṁ prāpto devān garhati vai bhr̥śam,
3.209.8: nainaṁ prajñā sunītaṁ vā trāyate naiva pauruṣam,
yo’yamicched yathā kāmaṁ taṁ taṁ kāmaṁ sa āpnuyāt ॥8॥
3.209.11: vañcanāyāṁ ca lokasya sa sukhī jīvate sadā,
3.209.12: kaścit karmāṇi kurvan hi na prāpyamadhigacchati,
3.209.14: karmajā hi manuṣyāṇāṁ rogā nāstyatra saṁśayaḥ ॥14॥
3.209.17: na śaknuvanti te bhoktuṁ paśya dharmabhr̥tāṁ vara,
3.209.19: na mriyeyurna jīryeyuḥ sarve syuḥ sārvakāmikāḥ ॥19॥
3.209.20: yatate ca yathāśakti na ca tad vartate tathā ॥20॥
3.209.22: karmaṇā prāk kr̥tānāṁ vai iha siddhiḥ pradr̥śyate ॥22॥
3.209.25: kathaṁ dharmavidāṁ śreṣṭha jīvo bhavati śāśvataḥ,
3.209.27: anyo hi nāśnāti kr̥taṁ hi karma
yat tena kiñciddhi kr̥taṁ hi karma
3.209.29: kathaṁ sambhavate yonau kathaṁ vā puṇyapāpayoḥ,
3.209.30: samāsena tu te kṣipraṁ pravakṣyāmi dvijottama ॥30॥
3.209.36: tataḥ karma samādatte punaranyaṁ navaṁ bahu,
3.209.40: prāpnoti sukr̥tām̐llokān yatra gatvā na śocati ॥40॥
3.209.41: pāpaṁ kurvan pāpavr̥ttaḥ pāpasyāntaṁ na gacchati,
tasmāt puṇyaṁ yatet kartuṁ varjayīta ca pāpakam ॥41॥
3.209.42: sukhāni dharmamarthaṁ ca svargaṁ ca labhate naraḥ ॥42॥
3.209.44: asaṅkleśena lokasya vr̥ttiṁ lipseta vai dvija ॥44॥
3.209.47: tasyaiva siñcate mūlaṁ guṇān paśyati tatra vai,
dharmātmā bhavati hyevaṁ cittaṁ cāsya prasīdati ॥47॥
3.209.48: sa mitrajanasantuṣṭa iha pretya ca nandati,
śabdaṁ sparśaṁ tathā rūpaṁ gandhāniṣṭāṁśca sattama ॥48॥
3.209.49: prabhutvaṁ labhate cāpi dharmasyaitat phalaṁ viduḥ,
dharmasya ca phalaṁ labdhvā na tr̥pyati mahādvija ॥49॥
3.209.51: virajyati yathākāmaṁ na ca dharmaṁ vimuñcati,
sarvatyāge ca yatate dr̥ṣṭvā lokaṁ kṣayātmakam ॥51॥
3.209.52: evaṁ nirvedamādatte pāpaṁ karma jahāti ca ॥52॥
3.209.53: dhārmikaścāpi bhavati mokṣaṁ ca labhate param,
tapo niḥśreyasaṁ jantostasya mūlaṁ śamo damaḥ ॥53॥
3.209.54: indriyāṇāṁ nirodhena satyena ca damena ca,
3.209.55: indriyāṇi tu yānyāhuḥ kāni tāni yatavrata,
nigrahaśca kathaṁ kāryo nigrahasya ca kiṁ phalam ॥55॥
3.209.56: kathaṁ ca phalamāpnoti teṣāṁ dharmabhr̥tāṁ vara,
etadicchāmi tattvena dharmaṁ jñātuṁ nibodha me ॥56॥
3.209.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi brāhmaṇavyādhasaṁvāde navādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥209॥
3.210.2: tat prāpya kāmaṁ bhajate krodhaṁ ca dvijasattama ॥2॥
3.210.5: na dharme jāyate buddhirvyājād dharmaṁ karoti ca ॥5॥
3.210.9: pāpaṁ cintayate caiva bravīti ca karoti ca,
3.210.10: sa tena duḥkhamāpnoti paratra ca vipadyate ॥10॥
3.210.11: pāpātmā bhavati hyevaṁ dharmalābhaṁ tu me śr̥ṇu,
3.210.13: bravīṣi sūnr̥taṁ dharmyaṁ yasya vaktā na vidyate,
3.210.14: teṣāṁ sarvātmanā kāryaṁ priyaṁ loke manīṣiṇā ॥14॥
3.210.15: yat teṣāṁ ca priyaṁ tat te vakṣyāmi dvijasattama,
namaskr̥tvā brāhmaṇebhyo bāhmīṁ vidyāṁ nibodha me ॥15॥
3.210.16: idaṁ viśvaṁ jagat sarvamajayyaṁ cāpi sarvaśaḥ,
3.210.17: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṁ ca raso gandhaśca tadguṇāḥ ॥17॥
3.210.20: indriyāṇi ca pañcātmā rajaḥ sattvaṁ tamastathā,
3.210.21: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥21॥
3.210.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi brāhmaṇamāhātmye daśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥210॥
3.211.2: ekaikasya guṇān samyak pañcānāmapi me vada ॥2॥
3.211.3: guṇottarāṇi sarvāṇi teṣāṁ vakṣyāmi te guṇān ॥3॥
3.211.5: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṁ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ,
ete guṇāḥ pañca bhūmeḥ sarvebhyo guṇavattarā ॥5॥
3.211.6: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṁ ca rasaścāpi dvijottama,
3.211.7: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṁ ca tejaso’tha guṇāstrayaḥ,
śabdaḥ sparśaśca vāyau tu śabdaścākāśa eva tu ॥7॥
3.211.8: ete pañcadaśa brahman guṇā bhūteṣu pañcasu,
3.211.9: anyonyaṁ nātivartante samyak ca bhavati dvija,
3.211.11: tatra tatra hi dr̥śyante dhātavaḥ pāñcabhautikāḥ,
3.211.12: indriyaiḥ sr̥jyate yad yat tat tad vyaktamiti smr̥tam,
3.211.14: parāvarajño yaḥ śaktaḥ sa tu bhūtāni paśyati ॥14॥
3.211.20: etanmūlaṁ hi tapasaḥ kr̥tsnasya narakasya ca ॥20॥
3.211.21: saṁniyamya tu tānyeva tataḥ siddhiṁ samāpnuyāt ॥21॥
3.211.24: yo dhīro dhārayed raśmīn sa syāt paramasārathiḥ ॥24॥
3.211.25: dhr̥tiṁ kurvīta sārathye dhr̥tyā tāni jayed dhruvam ॥25॥
3.211.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi brāhmaṇavyādhasaṁvāde ekādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥211॥
3.212.1: evaṁ tu sūkṣme kathite dharmavyādhena bhārata,
brāhmaṇaḥ sa punaḥ sūkṣmaṁ papraccha susamāhitaḥ ॥1॥
3.212.3: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi,
eṣāṁ guṇān pr̥thaktvena nibodha gadato mama ॥3॥
3.212.6: vidhitsamāno viprarṣe stabdho mānī sa rājasaḥ ॥6॥
3.212.7: akrodhano naro dhīmān dāntaścaiva sa sāttvikaḥ ॥7॥
3.212.9: vairāgyasya ca rūpaṁ tu pūrvameva pravartate,
3.212.10: na cāsya saṁśayo nāma kvacid bhavati kaścana ॥10॥
3.212.11: vaiśyatvaṁ labhate brahman kṣatriyatvaṁ tathaiva ca ॥11॥
3.212.12: guṇāste kīrtitāḥ sarve kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥12॥
3.212.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi brāhmaṇavyādhasaṁvāde dvādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥212॥
3.213.3: prāṇo mūrdhani cāgnau ca vartamāno viceṣṭate ॥3॥
3.213.4: bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca sarvaṁ prāṇe pratiṣṭhitam,
3.213.5: sa jantuḥ sarvabhūtātmā puruṣaḥ sa sanātanaḥ,
3.213.5d1: avyaktaṁ sattvasañjñaṁ ca jīvaḥ kālaḥ sa caiva hi,
3.213.5d2: jāgarti svapnakāle ca svapne svapnāyate ca saḥ,
3.213.6: evaṁ tviha sa sarvatra prāṇena paripālyate,
3.213.8: prayatne karmaṇi bale sa eṣa triṣu vartate,
3.213.11: ūṣmā cāgniriti jñeyo yo’nnaṁ pacati dehinām ॥11॥
3.213.17: yogināmeṣa mārgastu yena gacchanti tat param,
evaṁ sarveṣu vitatau prāṇāpānau hi dehiṣu ॥17॥
3.213.18: mūrtimantaṁ hi taṁ viddhi nityaṁ yogajitātmakam ॥18॥
3.213.24: cittasya hi prasādena hanti karma śubhāśubham,
3.213.25: lakṣaṇaṁ tu prasādasya yathā tr̥ptaḥ sukhaṁ svapet,
nivāte vā yathā dīpo dīpyet kuśaladīpitaḥ ॥25॥
3.213.26: pūrvarātre pare caiva yuñjānaḥ satataṁ manaḥ,
3.213.28: etat pavitraṁ lokānāṁ tapo vai saṅkramo mataḥ ॥28॥
3.213.29: nityaṁ krodhāt tapo rakṣed dharmaṁ rakṣecca matsarāt,
3.213.30: ānr̥śaṁsyaṁ paro dharmaḥ kṣamā ca paramaṁ balam,
ātmajñānaṁ paraṁ jñānaṁ satyaṁ vrataparaṁ vratam ॥30॥
3.213.31: satyasya vacanaṁ śreyaḥ satyaṁ jñānaṁ hitaṁ bhavet,
yad bhūtahitamatyantaṁ tad vai satyaṁ paraṁ matam ॥31॥
3.213.32: tyāge yasya hutaṁ sarvaṁ sa tyāgī sa ca buddhimān ॥32॥
3.213.33: taṁ vidyād brahmaṇo yogaṁ viyogaṁ yogasañjñitam ॥33॥
3.213.36: aśokaṁ sthānamāśritya niścalaṁ pretya ceha ca ॥36॥
3.213.39: parityajati yo duḥkhaṁ sukhaṁ cāpyubhayaṁ naraḥ,
3.213.40: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥40॥
3.213.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi brāhmaṇavyādhasaṁvāde trayodaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥213॥
3.214.2: na te’styaviditaṁ kiñcid dharmeṣviha hi dr̥śyate ॥2॥
3.214.3: pratyakṣaṁ mama yo dharmastaṁ ca paśya dvijottama,
3.214.4: draṣṭumarhasi dharmajña mātaraṁ pitaraṁ ca me ॥4॥
3.214.9: gatimiṣṭāṁ tapo jñānaṁ medhāṁ ca paramāṁ gataḥ,
satputreṇa tvayā putra nityaṁ kāle supūjitau ॥9॥
3.214.10: na te’nyad daivataṁ kiñcid daivateṣvapi vartate,
3.214.11: pituḥ pitāmahā ye ca tathaiva prapitāmahāḥ,
prītāste satataṁ putra damenāvāṁ ca pūjayā ॥11॥
3.214.12: manasā karmaṇā vācā śuśrūṣā naiva hīyate,
na cānyā hi tathā buddhirdr̥śyate sāmprataṁ tava ॥12॥
3.214.13: tathā tvayā kr̥taṁ sarvaṁ tadviśiṣṭaṁ ca putraka ॥13॥
3.214.15: pratipūjya ca tāṁ pūjāṁ dvijaḥ papraccha tāvubhau,
suputrābhyāṁ sabhr̥tyābhyāṁ kaccid vāṁ kuśalaṁ gr̥he ॥15॥
3.214.16: anāmayaṁ ca vāṁ kaccit sadaiveha śarīrayoḥ,
kuśalaṁ nau gr̥he vipra bhr̥tyavarge ca sarvaśaḥ,
3.214.18: pitā mātā ca bhagavannetau maddaivataṁ param,
3.214.21: etau me paramaṁ brahman pitā mātā ca daivatam,
etau puṣpaiḥ phalai ratnaistoṣayāmi sadā dvija ॥21॥
3.214.22: yajñā vedāśca catvāraḥ sarvametau mama dvija ॥22॥
3.214.23: etadarthaṁ mama prāṇā bhāryā putraḥ suhr̥jjanaḥ,
3.214.24: svayaṁ ca snāpayāmyetau tathā pādau pradhāvaye,
āhāraṁ ca prayacchāmi svayaṁ ca dvijasattama ॥24॥
3.214.26: atandritaḥ sadā vipra śuśrūṣāṁ vai karomyaham ॥26॥
3.214.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi brāhmaṇavyādhasaṁvāde caturdaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥214॥
3.215.3: mithilāyāṁ vased vyādhaḥ sa te dharmān pravakṣyati ॥3॥
3.215.4: saṁsmr̥tya vākyaṁ dharmajña guṇavānasi me mataḥ ॥4॥
3.215.5: yat tadā tvaṁ dvijaśreṣṭha tayokto māṁ prati prabho,
3.215.6: vākyaṁ ca śr̥ṇu me tāta yat te vakṣye hitaṁ dvija ॥6॥
3.215.7: tvayā vinikr̥tā mātā pitā ca dvijasattama,
3.215.9: tau prasādayituṁ gaccha mā tvāṁ dharmo’tyagādayam,
tapasvī tvaṁ mahātmā ca dharme ca nirataḥ sadā ॥9॥
3.215.13: mātāpitroḥ sakāśaṁ hi gatvā tvaṁ dvijasattama,
ataḥ paramahaṁ dharmaṁ nānyaṁ paśyāmi kañcana ॥13॥
3.215.14: ihāhamāgato diṣṭyā diṣṭyā me saṅgataṁ tvayā,
3.215.15: eko narasahasreṣu dharmavid vidyate na vā,
prīto’smi tava satyena bhadraṁ te puruṣarṣabha ॥15॥
3.215.19: durjñeyaḥ śāśvato dharmaḥ śūdrayonau hi vartate,
na tvāṁ śūdramahaṁ manye bhavitavyaṁ hi kāraṇam ॥19॥
3.215.20: kāmayā brūhi me sarvaṁ satyena prayatātmanā ॥20॥
3.215.24: etasminneva kāle tu mr̥gayāṁ nirgato nr̥paḥ ॥24॥
3.215.26: atha kṣiptaḥ śaro ghoro mayāpi dvijasattama,
3.215.28: manvānastaṁ mr̥gaṁ cāhaṁ samprāptaḥ sahasā prabho,
3.215.30: kṣantumarhasi me sarvamiti cokto mayā muniḥ ॥30॥
3.215.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi brāhmaṇavyādhasaṁvāde pañcadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥215॥
3.216.8: āśramaṁ ca mayā nīto na ca prāṇairvyayujyata,
etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ yathā mama purābhavat ॥8॥
3.216.10: evametāni puruṣā duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca,
3.216.11: duṣkaraṁ hi kr̥taṁ karma jānatā jātimātmanaḥ,
3.216.12: kañcit kālamuṣyatāṁ vai tato’si bhavitā dvijaḥ ॥12॥
3.216.13: sāmprataṁ ca mato me’si brāhmaṇo nātra saṁśayaḥ,
3.216.14: dāmbhiko duṣkr̥taḥ prāyaḥ śūdreṇa sadr̥śo bhavet,
yastu śūdro dame satye dharme ca satatotthitaḥ ॥14॥
3.216.15: taṁ brāhmaṇamahaṁ manye vr̥ttena hi bhaved dvijaḥ,
3.216.21: śocato na bhavet kiñcit kevalaṁ paritapyate,
parityajanti ye duḥkhaṁ sukhaṁ vāpyubhayaṁ narāḥ ॥21॥
3.216.23: na śocanti gatādhvānaḥ paśyantaḥ paramāṁ gatim ॥23॥
3.216.24: na viṣāde manaḥ kāryaṁ viṣādo viṣamuttamam,
3.216.25: tejasā tasya hīnasya puruṣārtho na vidyate ॥25॥
3.216.26: na hi nirvedamāgamya kiñcit prāpnoti śobhanam ॥26॥
3.216.28: bhūteṣvabhāvaṁ sañcintya ye tu buddheḥ paraṁ gatāḥ,
na śocanti kr̥taprajñāḥ paśyantaḥ paramāṁ gatim ॥28॥
3.216.29: na śocāmi ca vai vidvan kālākāṅkṣī sthito hyaham,
3.216.31: āpr̥cche tvāṁ svasti te’stu dharmastvāṁ parirakṣatu,
3.216.33: sa tu gatvā dvijaḥ sarvāṁ śuśrūṣāṁ kr̥tavāṁstadā,
3.216.34: pr̥ṣṭavānasi yaṁ tāta dharmaṁ dharmabhr̥tāṁ vara ॥34॥
3.216.37: sukhaśravyatayā vidvan muhūrta iva me gataḥ,
na hi tr̥pto’smi bhagavan śr̥ṇvāno dharmamuttamam ॥37॥
3.216.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi brāhmaṇavyādhasaṁvāde ṣoḍaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥216॥
3.217.3: agniryadā tveka eva bahutvaṁ cāsya karmasu,
3.217.4: yathā rudrācca sambhūto gaṅgāyāṁ kr̥ttikāsu ca ॥4॥
3.217.8: tathā sa bhūtvā tu tadā jagat sarvaṁ vyakāśayat ॥8॥
3.217.9: bhr̥śaṁ glānaśca tejasvī na ca kiñcit prajajñivān ॥9॥
3.217.11: agnitvaṁ vipraṇaṣṭaṁ hi tapyamānasya me tapaḥ,
3.217.15: bhavantameva jñāsyanti pāvakaṁ na tu māṁ janāḥ ॥15॥
3.217.17: māṁ ca deva kuruṣvāgne prathamaṁ putramañjasā ॥17॥
3.217.19: jñātvā prathamajaṁ taṁ tu vahnerāṅgirasaṁ sutam,
upetya devāḥ papracchuḥ kāraṇaṁ tatra bhārata ॥19॥
3.217.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirase saptadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥217॥
3.218.1: tasyābhavat subhā bhāryā prajāstasyāṁ ca me śr̥ṇu ॥1॥
3.218.8: yāṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā bhagavatīṁ janaḥ kuhukuhāyate,
3.218.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi aṅgirasopākhyāne aṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥218॥
3.219.1: agnīn sājanayat puṇyān ṣaḍekāṁ cāpi putrikām ॥1॥
3.219.7: tisraḥ kanyā bhavantyanyā yāsāṁ sa bharataḥ patiḥ,
3.219.9: bharadvājasya bhāryā tu vīrā vīrasya piṇḍadā,
3.219.10: haviṣā yo dvitīyena somena saha yujyate,
3.219.11: sarayvāṁ janayat siddhiṁ bhānuṁ bhābhiḥ samāvr̥ṇot,
3.219.12: yastu na cyavate nityaṁ yaśasā varcasā śriyā,
3.219.14: ākrośatāṁ hi bhūtānāṁ yaḥ karoti hi niṣkr̥tim,
3.219.15: tasya putraḥ svano nāma pāvakaḥ sa rujaskaraḥ ॥15॥
3.219.17: antarāgniḥ smr̥to yastu bhuktaṁ pacati dehinām,
3.219.19: pavitrā gomatī nāma nadī yasyābhavat priyā,
3.219.21: tataḥ sviṣṭaṁ bhavedājyaṁ sviṣṭakr̥t paramaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥21॥
3.219.22: kruddhasya tu raso jajñe manyutīvrā ca putrikā,
3.219.23: tridive yasya sadr̥śo nāsti rūpeṇa kaścana,
3.219.24: saṁharṣād dhārayan krodhaṁ dhanvī sragvī rathe sthitaḥ,
3.219.25: mahāvācaṁ tvajanayat samāśvāsaṁ hi yaṁ viduḥ ॥25॥
3.219.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirasopākhyāne ekonaviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥219॥
3.220.2: putraṁ labhema dharmiṣṭhaṁ yaśasā brahmaṇā samam ॥2॥
3.220.4: tvaṅnetre ca suvarṇābhe kr̥ṣṇe jaṅghe ca bhārata ॥4॥
3.220.6: janayat pāvakaṁ ghoraṁ pitr̥̄ṇāṁ sa prajāḥ sr̥jan ॥6॥
3.220.7: br̥had rathantaraṁ mūrdhno vaktrād vā tarasāharau,
3.220.8: bāhubhyāmanudāttau ca viśve bhūtāni caiva ha,
etān sr̥ṣṭvā tataḥ pañca pitr̥̄ṇāmasr̥jat sutān ॥8॥
3.220.11: etān yajñamuṣaḥ pañca devānāṁ hyasr̥jat tapaḥ ॥11॥
3.220.13: surapravīraṁ vīraṁ ca sureśaṁ ca suvarcasam,
3.220.14: trividhaṁ saṁsthitā hyete pañca pañca pr̥thak pr̥thak,
3.220.16: tadete nopasarpanti yatra cāgniḥ sthito bhavet ॥16॥
3.220.17: mantraiḥ praśamitā hyete neṣṭaṁ muṣṇanti yajñiyam ॥17॥
3.220.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirasopākhyāne viṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥220॥
3.221.2: duḥkhārtānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ śivakr̥t satataṁ śivaḥ ॥2॥
3.221.3: tapasastu phalaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sampravr̥ddhaṁ tapo mahat,
3.221.8: tapasaśca manuṁ putraṁ bhānuṁ cāpyaṅgirāḥ sr̥jat,
3.221.9: bhānorbhāryā suprajā tu br̥hadbhāsā tu sūryajā,
asr̥jetāṁ tu ṣaṭ putrān śr̥ṇū tāsāṁ prajāvidhim ॥9॥
3.221.10: tamagniṁ baladaṁ prāhuḥ prathamaṁ bhānutaḥ sutam ॥10॥
3.221.11: agniḥ sa manyumānnāma dvitīyo bhānutaḥ sutaḥ ॥11॥
3.221.12: darśe ca paurṇamāse ca yasyeha havirucyate,
3.221.17: asya lokasya sarvasya yaḥ prabhuḥ paripaṭhyate,
3.221.18: tataḥ sviṣṭaṁ bhavedājyaṁ sviṣṭakr̥t paramastu saḥ,
kanyā sā rohiṇī nāma hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutā ॥18॥
3.221.19: karmaṇāsau babhau bhāryā sa vahniḥ sa prajāpatiḥ,
3.221.21: kapilaṁ paramarṣiṁ ca yaṁ prāhuryatayaḥ sadā,
3.221.22: agraṁ yacchanti bhūtānāṁ yena bhūtāni nityadā,
3.221.28: mr̥taḥ śrūyeta yo jīvaḥ pareyuḥ paśavo yadā,
3.221.29: ārto na juhuyādagniṁ trirātraṁ yastu brāhmaṇaḥ,
3.221.30: darśaṁ ca paurṇamāsaṁ ca yasya tiṣṭhet pratiṣṭhitam,
3.221.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirasopākhyāne ekaviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥221॥
3.222.1: āpasya muditā bhāryā sahasya paramā priyā,
3.222.2: bhūtānāṁ cāpi sarveṣāṁ yaṁ prāhuḥ pāvakaṁ patim,
3.222.3: mahatāṁ caiva bhūtānāṁ sarveṣāmiha yaḥ patiḥ,
bhagavān sa mahātejā nityaṁ carati pāvakaḥ ॥3॥
3.222.4: hutaṁ vahati yo havyamasya lokasya pāvakaḥ ॥4॥
3.222.5: apāṁ garbho mahābhāgaḥ sattvabhug yo mahādbhutaḥ,
3.222.6: agniṣṭome ca niyataḥ kratuśreṣṭho bharasya tu ॥6॥
3.222.7: sa vahniḥ prathamo nityaṁ devairanviṣyate prabhuḥ,
3.222.9: devānāṁ vaha havyaṁ tvamahaṁ vīra sudurbalaḥ,
atha tvaṁ gaccha madhvakṣaṁ priyametat kuruṣva me ॥9॥
3.222.12: anunīyamāno hi bhr̥śaṁ devavākyāddhi tena saḥ,
naicchad voḍhuṁ haviḥ soḍhuṁ śarīraṁ cāpi so’tyajat ॥12॥
3.222.13: sa taccharīraṁ santyajya praviveśa dharāṁ tadā,
bhūmiṁ spr̥ṣṭāsr̥jad dhātūn pr̥thak pr̥thagatīva hi ॥13॥
3.222.14: pūyāt sa gandhaṁ tejaśca asthibhyo devadāru ca,
3.222.15: yakr̥t kr̥ṣṇāyasaṁ tasya tribhireva babhuḥ prajāḥ,
3.222.16: evaṁ tyaktvā śarīraṁ ca parame tapasi sthitaḥ ॥16॥
3.222.21: evaṁ tvajanayad dhiṣṇyān vedoktān vibudhān bahūn,
vicaran vividhān deśān bhramamāṇastu tatra vai ॥21॥
3.222.24: tamasā narmadā caiva nadī godāvarī tathā,
veṇopaveṇā bhīmā ca vaḍavā caiva bhārata ॥24॥
3.222.25: bhāratī suprayogā ca kāverī murmurā tathā,
tuṅgaveṇā kr̥ṣṇaveṇā kapilā śoṇa eva ca ॥25॥
3.222.26: etā nadyastu dhiṣṇyānāṁ mātaro yāḥ prakīrtitāḥ,
adbhutasya priyā bhāryā tasya putro vibhūrasiḥ ॥26॥
3.222.27: yāvantaḥ pāvakāḥ proktāḥ somāstāvanta eva tu,
3.222.30: adbhutasya tu māhātmyaṁ yathā vedeṣu kīrtitam ॥30॥
3.222.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirasopākhyāne’gnisamudbhave dvāviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥222॥
3.223.0d2: kumārastu yathā jāto yathā cāgneḥ suto’bhavat,
yathā rudrācca sambhūto gaṅgāyāṁ kr̥ttikāsu ca.
3.223.1: śr̥ṇu janma tu kauravya kārtikeyasya dhīmataḥ ॥1॥
3.223.5: pālayed vīryamāśritya sa jñeyaḥ puruṣo mayā ॥5॥
3.223.6: sa śailaṁ mānasaṁ gatvā dhyāyannarthamidaṁ bhr̥śam,
3.223.7: abhidhāvatu māṁ kaścit puruṣastrātu caiva ha,
patiṁ ca me pradiśatu svayaṁ vā patirastu me ॥7॥
3.223.8: purandarastu tāmāha mā bhairnāsti bhayaṁ tava,
3.223.11: kṣamaṁ te jīvato gantuṁ svapuraṁ pākaśāsana ॥11॥
3.223.14: bibheda rājan vajreṇa bhuvi tannipapāta ha,
patatā tu tadā keśī tena śr̥ṅgeṇa tāḍitaḥ ॥14॥
3.223.15: kāsi kasyāsi kiñceha kuruṣe tvaṁ śubhānane ॥15॥
3.223.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirasopākhyāne skandotpattau keśiparābhave trayoviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥223॥
3.224.1: bhaginī daityasenā me sā pūrvaṁ keśinā hr̥tā ॥1॥
3.224.2: sadaivāvāṁ bhaginyau tu sakhībhiḥ saha mānasam,
3.224.3: nityaṁ cāvāṁ prārthayate hartuṁ keśī mahāsuraḥ,
3.224.4: sā hr̥tānena bhagavan muktāhaṁ tvadbalena tu,
3.224.5: mama mātr̥ṣvaseyī tvaṁ mātā dākṣāyaṇī mama,
3.224.7: kīdr̥śaṁ tu balaṁ devi patyustava bhaviṣyati,
3.224.9: yastu sarvāṇi bhūtāni tvayā saha vijeṣyati,
sa hi me bhavitā bhartā brahmaṇyaḥ kīrtivardhanaḥ ॥9॥
3.224.12: amāvāsyāṁ pravr̥ttāyāṁ muhurte raudra eva tu,
3.224.14: havyaṁ gr̥hītvā vahniṁ ca praviśantaṁ divākaram ॥14॥
3.224.15: tathā dharmagataṁ raudraṁ somaṁ sūryagataṁ ca tam ॥15॥
3.224.16: samavāyaṁ tu taṁ raudraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā śakro’nvacintayat ॥16॥
3.224.17: etasminneva rātryante mahad yuddhaṁ tu śaṁsati ॥17॥
3.224.19: eṣa raudraśca saṅghāto mahān yuktaśca tejasā,
3.224.20: janayed yaṁ sutaṁ somaḥ so’syā devyāḥ patirbhavet,
3.224.21: eṣa cejjanayed garbhaṁ so’syā devyāḥ patirbhavet,
evaṁ sañcintya bhagavān brahmalokaṁ tadā gataḥ ॥21॥
3.224.22: uvāca cāsyā devyāstvaṁ sādhuśūraṁ patiṁ diśa ॥22॥
3.224.26: bhāgārthaṁ tapaso dhātuṁ teṣāṁ somaṁ tathādhvare ॥26॥
3.224.30: sa tatra vividhaṁ havyaṁ pratigr̥hya hutāśanaḥ,
3.224.33: sa tatra tena manasā babhūva kṣubhitendriyaḥ,
3.224.34: bhūyaḥ sañcintayāmāsa na nyāyyaṁ kṣubhito hyaham,
3.224.35: naitāḥ śakyā mayā draṣṭuṁ spraṣṭuṁ vāpyanimittataḥ,
3.224.39: svāhā taṁ dakṣaduhitā prathamaṁ kāmayat tadā,
3.224.40: sā taṁ jñātvā yathāvat tu vahniṁ vanamupāgatam ॥40॥
3.224.42: evaṁ kr̥te prītirasya kāmāvāptiśca me bhavet ॥42॥
3.224.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirasopākhyāne skandotpattau caturviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥224॥
3.225.1: tasyāḥ sā prathamaṁ rūpaṁ kr̥tvā devī janādhipa ॥1॥
3.225.4: kathaṁ māṁ tvaṁ vijānīṣe kāmārtamitarāḥ katham,
yāstvayā kīrtitāḥ sarvāḥ saptarṣīṇāṁ priyāḥ striyaḥ ॥4॥
3.225.5: asmākaṁ tvaṁ priyo nityaṁ bibhīmastu vayaṁ tava,
3.225.6: maithunāyeha samprāptā kāmaṁ prāptaṁ drutaṁ cara,
3.225.7: prītyā devī samāyuktā śukraṁ jagrāha pāṇinā ॥7॥
3.225.10: suparṇī sā tadā bhūtvā nirjagāma mahāvanāt,
3.225.12: sā tatra sahasā gatvā śailapr̥ṣṭhaṁ sudurgamam ॥12॥
3.225.13: prākṣipat kāñcane kuṇḍe śukraṁ sā tvaritā śubhā,
3.225.16: tasmin kuṇḍe pratipadi kāminyā svāhayā tadā,
tat skannaṁ tejasā tatra saṁvr̥taṁ janayat sutam ॥16॥
3.225.21: tad gr̥hītvā dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṁ nanāda balavāṁstadā ॥21॥
3.225.24: dvābhyāṁ gr̥hītvā pāṇibhyāṁ śaktiṁ cānyena pāṇinā,
3.225.25: gr̥hītvā vyanadad bhīmaṁ cikrīḍa ca mahābhujaḥ ॥25॥
3.225.29: sa paśyan vividhān bhāvāṁścakāra ninadaṁ punaḥ ॥29॥
3.225.30: tasya taṁ ninadaṁ śrutvā nyapatan bahudhā janāḥ,
3.225.31: ye tu taṁ saṁśritā devaṁ nānāvarṇāstadā janāḥ,
3.225.32: sa tūtthāya mahābāhurupasāntvya ca tān janān,
3.225.33: bibheda sa śaraiḥ śailaṁ krauñcaṁ himavataḥ sutam,
tena haṁsāśca gr̥dhrāśca meruṁ gacchanti parvatam ॥33॥
3.225.34: tasmin nipatite tvanye neduḥ śailā bhr̥śaṁ tadā ॥34॥
3.225.35: sa taṁ nādaṁ bhr̥śārtānāṁ śrutvāpi balināṁ varaḥ,
3.225.36: sā tadā vimalā śaktiḥ kṣiptā tena mahātmanā,
bibheda śikharaṁ ghoraṁ śvetasya tarasā gireḥ ॥36॥
3.225.37: sa tenābhihato dīrṇo giriḥ śveto’calaiḥ saha,
3.225.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirase kumārotpattau pañcaviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥225॥
3.226.2: strīpuṁsorviparītaṁ ca tathā dvandvāni yāni ca,
grahā dīptā diśaḥ khaṁ ca rarāsa ca mahī bhr̥śam ॥2॥
3.226.4: nivasanti vane ye tu tasmiṁścaitrarathe janāḥ,
3.226.5: saṅgamya ṣaḍbhiḥ patnībhiḥ saptarṣīṇāmiti sma ha,
3.226.6: yairdr̥ṣṭā sā tadā devī tasyā rūpeṇa gacchatī,
na tu tat svāhayā karma kr̥taṁ jānāti vai janaḥ ॥6॥
3.226.7: suparṇī tu vacaḥ śrutvā mamāyaṁ tanayastviti,
3.226.8: atha saptarṣayaḥ śrutvā jātaṁ putraṁ mahaujasam,
3.226.10: ahaṁ jāne naitadevamiti rājan punaḥ punaḥ,
3.226.12: stavaṁ divyaṁ sampracakre mahāsenasya cāpi saḥ ॥12॥
3.226.14: ṣaḍvaktrasya tu māhātmyaṁ kukkuṭasya tu sādhanam,
śaktyā devyāḥ sādhanaṁ ca tathā pāriṣadāmapi ॥14॥
3.226.16: abravīcca munīn sarvān nāparādhyanti vai striyaḥ ॥16॥
3.226.17: śrutvā tu tattvatastasmāt te patnīḥ sarvato’tyajan,
skandaṁ śrutvā tadā devā vāsavaṁ sahitā’bruvan ॥17॥
3.226.18: yadi vā na nihaṁsyenaṁ devendro’yaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥18॥
3.226.21: te’bruvan nāsti te vīryaṁ yata evaṁ prabhāṣase,
3.226.22: kāmavīryā ghnantu cainaṁ tathetyuktvā ca tā yayuḥ,
3.226.24: tāsāṁ tad vacanaṁ śrutvā pātukāmaḥ stānān prabhuḥ ॥24॥
3.226.25: tāḥ sampūjya mahāsenaḥ kāmāṁścāsāṁ pradāya saḥ,
3.226.26: sa tu sampūjitastena saha mātr̥gaṇena ha,
3.226.27: sarvāsāṁ yā tu mātr̥̄ṇāṁ nārī krodhasamudbhavā,
3.226.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirase skandotpattau ṣaḍviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥226॥
3.227.5: ugraṁ taṁ ca mahānādaṁ devānīkaṁ mahāprabham,
3.227.7: vinadan pārtha deveśo drutaṁ yāti mahābalaḥ,
3.227.9: guho’pi śabdaṁ taṁ śrutvā vyanadat sāgaro yathā ॥9॥
3.227.14: tyakto devaistataḥ skande vajraṁ śakro nyapātayat ॥14॥
3.227.15: bibheda ca mahārāja pārśvaṁ tasya mahātmanaḥ ॥15॥
3.227.18: bhayādindrastu taṁ skandaṁ prāñjaliḥ śaraṇaṁ gataḥ,
tasyābhayaṁ dadau skandaḥ saha sainyasya sattamaḥ,
3.227.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirase indraskandasamāgame saptaviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥227॥
3.228.7: kiṁ karomīti tāḥ skandaṁ samprāptāḥ samabhāṣayan,
3.228.8: prasādāt tava pūjyāśca priyametat kuruṣva naḥ,
3.228.10: kākī ca halimā caiva mālinī br̥ṁhatā tathā,
3.228.13: ṣaṣṭhaṁ chāgamayaṁ vaktraṁ skandasyaiveti viddhi tat,
3.228.14: ṣaṇṇāṁ tu pravaraṁ tasya śīrṣāṇāmiha śabdyate,
śaktiṁ yenāsr̥jad divyāṁ bhadraśākha iti sma ha ॥14॥
3.228.15: tatra yuddhaṁ mahāghoraṁ vr̥ttaṁ ṣaṣṭhyāṁ janādhipa ॥15॥
3.228.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirase kumārotpattau aṣṭāviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥228॥
3.229.4: niṣaṇṇo dr̥śyate bhūtaiḥ paurṇamāsyāṁ yathā śaśī ॥4॥
3.229.6: hiraṇyagarbha bhadraṁ te lokānāṁ śaṅkaro bhava,
3.229.9: indro dadhāti bhūtānāṁ balaṁ tejaḥ prajāḥ sukham,
tuṣṭaḥ prayacchati tathā sarvān kāmān sureśvaraḥ ॥9॥
3.229.11: asūrye ca bhavet sūryastathācandre ca candramāḥ,
3.229.12: tvaṁ ca vīra balī śreṣṭhastasmādindro bhavasva naḥ ॥12॥
3.229.14: ahaṁ te kiṅkaraḥ śakra na mamendratvamīpsitam ॥14॥
3.229.15: balaṁ tavādbhutaṁ vīra tvaṁ devānāmarīn jahi,
avajñāsyanti māṁ lokā vīryeṇa tava vismitāḥ ॥15॥
3.229.16: indratve tu sthitaṁ vīra balahīnaṁ parājitam,
3.229.17: bhedite ca tvayi vibho loko dvaidhamupeṣyati,
3.229.18: tatra tvaṁ māṁ raṇe tāta yathāśraddhaṁ vijeṣyasi ॥18॥
3.229.19: tvameva rājā bhadraṁ te trailokyasya mamaiva ca ॥19॥
3.229.20: karomi kiṁ ca te śakra śāsanaṁ tad bravīhi me,
3.229.21: yadi satyamidaṁ vākyaṁ niścayād bhāṣitaṁ tvayā,
yadi vā śāsanaṁ skanda kartumicchasi me śr̥ṇu ॥21॥
3.229.24: tatra tat kāñcanaṁ chatraṁ dhriyamāṇaṁ vyarocata ॥24॥
3.229.29: pūjyamānaṁ tu rudreṇa dr̥ṣṭvā sarve divaukasaḥ,
3.229.30: anupraviśya rudreṇa vahniṁ jāto hyayaṁ śiśuḥ,
3.229.31: rudrasya vahneḥ svāhāyāḥ ṣaṇṇāṁ strīṇāṁ ca bhārata,
3.229.34: yā ceṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṁ prabhā śāntirbalaṁ tathā,
3.229.35: viveśa kavacaṁ cāsya śarīre sahajaṁ tathā,
3.229.43: asmākaṁ tvaṁ patiriti bruvāṇāḥ sarvato diśaḥ,
3.229.45: sasmāra tāṁ devasenāṁ yā sā tena vimokṣitā,
ayaṁ tasyāḥ patirnūnaṁ vihito brahmaṇā svayam ॥45॥
3.229.47: ajāte tvayi nirdiṣṭā tava patnī svayambhuvā,
3.229.48: evamuktaḥ sa jagrāha tasyāḥ pāṇiṁ yathāvidhi ॥48॥
3.229.52: ṣaṣṭhyāṁ kr̥tārtho’bhūd yasmāt tasmāt ṣaṣṭhī mahātithiḥ ॥52॥
3.229.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirase skandopākhyāne ekonatriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥229॥
3.230.6: mātaro hi bhavatyo me suto vo’hamaninditāḥ,
3.230.7: vivakṣantaṁ tataḥ śakraṁ kiṁ kāryamiti so’bravīt,
3.230.8: abhijit spardhamānā tu rohiṇyā anujā svasā,
icchantī jyeṣṭhatāṁ devī tapastaptuṁ vanaṁ gatā ॥8॥
3.230.9: tatra mūḍho’smi bhadraṁ te nakṣatraṁ gaganāccyutam,
kālaṁ tvimaṁ paraṁ skanda brahmaṇā saha cintaya ॥9॥
3.230.11: evamukte tu śakreṇa tridivaṁ kr̥ttikā gatāḥ,
3.230.12: vinatā cābravīt skandaṁ mama tvaṁ piṇḍadaḥ sutaḥ,
3.230.13: snuṣayā pūjyamānā vai devi vatsyasi nityadā ॥13॥
3.230.14: vayaṁ sarvasya lokasya mātaraḥ kavibhiḥ stutāḥ,
3.230.15: mātaro hi bhavatyo me bhavatīnāmahaṁ sutaḥ,
3.230.16: yāstu tā mātaraḥ pūrvaṁ lokasyāsya prakalpitāḥ,
asmākaṁ tu bhavet sthānaṁ tāsāṁ caiva na tad bhavet ॥16॥
3.230.17: bhavema pūjyā lokasya na tāḥ pūjyāḥ surarṣabha,
3.230.18: vr̥ttāḥ prajā na tāḥ śakyā bhavatībhirniṣevitum,
anyāṁ vaḥ kāṁ prayacchāmi prajāṁ yāṁ manasecchatha ॥18॥
3.230.19: icchāma tāsāṁ mātr̥̄ṇāṁ prajā bhoktuṁ prayaccha naḥ,
tvayā saha pr̥thagbhūtā ye ca tāsāmatheśvarāḥ ॥19॥
3.230.20: prajā vo dadmi kaṣṭaṁ tu bhavatībhirudāhr̥tam,
parirakṣata bhadraṁ vaḥ prajāḥ sādhu namaskr̥tāḥ ॥20॥
3.230.21: parirakṣāma bhadraṁ te prajāḥ skanda yathecchasi,
tvayā no rocate skanda sahavāsaściraṁ prabho ॥21॥
3.230.22: yāvat ṣoḍaśa varṣāṇi bhavanti taruṇāḥ prajāḥ,
3.230.23: paramaṁ tena sahitāḥ sukhaṁ vatsyatha pūjitāḥ ॥23॥
3.230.24: bhoktuṁ prajāḥ sa martyānāṁ niṣpapāta mahāprabhaḥ ॥24॥
3.230.28: garbhān sā mānuṣīṇāṁ tu harate ghoradarśanā ॥28॥
3.230.29: so’pi bālān mahāghoro bādhate vai mahāgrahaḥ ॥29॥
3.230.33: gavāṁ mātā tu yā prājñaiḥ kathyate surabhirnr̥pa,
3.230.34: saramā nāma yā mātā śunāṁ devī janādhipa,
sāpi garbhān samādatte mānuṣīṇāṁ sadaiva hi ॥34॥
3.230.35: pādapānāṁ ca yā mātā karañjanilayā hi sā,
varadā sā hi saumyā ca nityaṁ bhūtānukampinī ॥35॥
3.230.36: karañje tāṁ namasyanti tasmāt putrārthino narāḥ,
3.230.38: bhuṅkte sā tatra taṁ garbhaṁ sā tu nāgaṁ prasūyate,
gandharvāṇāṁ tu yā mātā sā garbhaṁ gr̥hya gacchati ॥38॥
3.230.39: tato vilīnagarbhā sā mānuṣī bhuvi dr̥śyate,
yā janitrī tvapsarasāṁ garbhamāste pragr̥hya sā ॥39॥
3.230.40: lohitasyodadheḥ kanyā dhātrī skandasya sā smr̥tā ॥40॥
3.230.43: ye ca mātr̥gaṇāḥ proktāḥ puruṣāścaiva ye grahāḥ ॥43॥
3.230.44: sarve skandagrahā nāma jñeyā nityaṁ śarīribhiḥ,
3.230.46: ūrdhvaṁ tu ṣoḍaśād varṣād ye bhavanti grahā nr̥ṇām,
3.230.47: yaḥ paśyati naro devān jāgrad vā śayito’pi vā,
unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṁ taṁ tu devagrahaṁ viduḥ ॥47॥
3.230.48: āsīnaśca śayānaśca yaḥ paśyati naraḥ pitr̥̄n,
unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṁ sa jñeyastu pitr̥grahaḥ ॥48॥
3.230.49: avamanyati yaḥ siddhān kruddhāścāpi śapanti yam,
unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṁ jñeyaḥ siddhagrahastu saḥ ॥49॥
3.230.50: upāghrāti ca yo gandhān rasāṁścāpi pr̥thagvidhān,
unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṁ sa jñeyo rākṣaso grahaḥ ॥50॥
3.230.51: gandharvāścāpi yaṁ divyāḥ saṁviśanti naraṁ bhuvi,
unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṁ graho gāndharva eva saḥ ॥51॥
3.230.52: adhirohanti yaṁ nityaṁ piśācāḥ puruṣaṁ prati,
unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṁ grahaḥ paiśāca eva saḥ ॥52॥
3.230.53: āviśanti ca yaṁ yakṣāḥ puruṣaṁ kālaparyaye,
unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṁ jñeyo yakṣagrahastu saḥ ॥53॥
3.230.54: yasya doṣaiḥ prakupitaṁ cittaṁ muhyati dehinaḥ,
unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṁ sādhanaṁ tasya śāstrataḥ ॥54॥
3.230.55: unmādyati sa tu kṣipraṁ sāntvaṁ tasya tu sādhanam ॥55॥
3.230.57: ataḥ paraṁ dehināṁ tu grahatulyo bhavejjvaraḥ ॥57॥
3.230.58: āstikaṁ śraddadhānaṁ ca varjayanti sadā grahāḥ ॥58॥
3.230.59: na spr̥śanti grahā bhaktān narān devaṁ maheśvaram ॥59॥
3.230.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirase manuṣyagrahakathane triṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥230॥
3.231.3: dakṣasyāhaṁ priyā kanyā svāhā nāma mahābhuja,
3.231.4: na sa māṁ kāminīṁ putra samyak jānāti pāvakaḥ,
icchāmi śāśvataṁ vāsaṁ vastuṁ putra sahāgninā ॥4॥
3.231.5: havyaṁ kavyaṁ ca yatkiñcid dvijānāṁ mantrasaṁstutam,
3.231.7: evamuktā tataḥ svāhā tuṣṭā skandena pūjitā,
3.231.10: umāyonyāṁ ca rudreṇa śukraṁ siktaṁ mahātmanā,
3.231.12: tatra te vividhākārā gaṇā jñeyā manīṣibhiḥ,
tava pāriṣadā ghorā ya ete piśitāśinaḥ ॥12॥
3.231.14: arkapuṣpaistu te pañca gaṇāḥ pūjyā dhanārthibhiḥ,
3.231.17: ghaṇṭāyāḥ sapatākāyāḥ śr̥ṇu me sambhavaṁ nr̥pa ॥17॥
3.231.18: guhasya te svayaṁ datte krameṇānāyya dhīmatā ॥18॥
3.231.19: ekā tatra viśākhasya ghaṇṭā skandasya cāparā,
3.231.21: śuśubhe kāñcane śaile dīpyamānaḥ śriyā vr̥taḥ ॥21॥
3.231.22: tena vīreṇa śuśubhe sa śailaḥ śubhakānanaḥ,
3.231.26: hr̥ṣṭānāṁ tatra bhūtānāṁ śrūyate ninado mahān ॥26॥
3.231.27: prahr̥ṣṭaṁ prekṣate skandaṁ na ca glāyati darśanāt ॥27॥
3.231.28: tadā samprasthitaḥ śrīmān hr̥ṣṭo bhadravaṭaṁ haraḥ ॥28॥
3.231.29: sahasraṁ tasya siṁhānāṁ tasmin yuktaṁ rathottame ॥29॥
3.231.31: tasmin rathe paśupatiḥ sthito bhātyumayā saha ॥31॥
3.231.32: vidyutā sahitaḥ sūryaḥ sendracāpe ghane yathā,
3.231.36: gacchanti vasubhiḥ sārdhaṁ rudraiśca saha saṅgatāḥ,
3.231.38: vijayo nāma rudrasya yāti śūlaḥ svalaṅkr̥taḥ,
3.231.41: tasya dakṣiṇato bhāti daṇḍo gacchan śriyā vr̥taḥ ॥41॥
3.231.42: eṣāṁ tu pr̥ṣṭhato rudro vimale syandane sthitaḥ ॥42॥
3.231.49: sāvitryā saha sarvāstāḥ pārvatyā yānti pr̥ṣṭhataḥ,
tatra vidyāgaṇāḥ sarve ye kecit kavibhiḥ kr̥tāḥ ॥49॥
3.231.50: gr̥hītvā tu patākāṁ vai yātyagre rākṣaso grahaḥ ॥50॥
3.231.51: vyāpr̥tastu śmaśāne yo nityaṁ rudrasya vai sakhā,
3.231.52: agrataḥ pr̥ṣṭhataścaiva na hi tasya gatirdhruvā ॥52॥
3.231.56: yadanyadapi me kāryaṁ deva tad vada māciram ॥56॥
3.231.57: kāryeṣvahaṁ tvayā putra sandraṣṭavyaḥ sadaiva hi,
3.231.59: jajvāla khaṁ sanakṣatraṁ pramūḍhaṁ bhuvanaṁ bhr̥śam ॥59॥
3.231.62: tad vai ghoramasaṅkhyeyaṁ garjacca vividhā giraḥ ॥62॥
3.231.63: abhyadravad raṇe devān bhagavantaṁ ca śaṅkaram,
3.231.68: atha tad vidrutaṁ sainyaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā devaḥ purandaraḥ ॥68॥
3.231.69: bhayaṁ tyajata bhadraṁ vaḥ śūrāḥ śastrāṇi gr̥hṇata ॥69॥
3.231.70: kurudhvaṁ vikrame buddhiṁ mā vaḥ kācid vyathā bhavet,
3.231.71: abhidravata bhadraṁ vo mayā saha mahāsurān,
3.231.80: tathā hi dānavā ghorā vinighnanti divaukasaḥ,
3.231.82: dānavo mahiṣo nāma pragr̥hya vipulaṁ girim,
3.231.87: tataḥ sa mahiṣaḥ kruddhastūrṇaṁ rudrarathaṁ yayau,
3.231.88: yadā rudrarathaṁ kruddho mahiṣaḥ sahasā gataḥ,
3.231.90: sasmāra ca tadā skandaṁ mr̥tyuṁ tasya durātmanaḥ ॥90॥
3.231.91: mahiṣo’pi rathaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā raudro rudrasya cānadat,
3.231.92: ājagāma mahāsenaḥ krodhāt sūrya iva jvalan ॥92॥
3.231.94: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā daityasenā sā vyadravat sahasā raṇe ॥94॥
3.231.95: sa cāpi tāṁ prajvalitāṁ mahiṣasya vidāriṇīm,
3.231.96: sā muktābhyaharat tasya mahiṣasya śiro mahat,
3.231.98: kṣiptākṣiptā tu sā śaktirhatvā śatrūn sahasraśaḥ ॥98॥
3.231.108: etat te prathamaṁ deva khyātaṁ karma bhaviṣyati ॥108॥
3.231.111: uktāśca devā rudreṇa skandaṁ paśyata māmiva ॥111॥
3.231.113: skandasya ya idaṁ vipraḥ paṭhejjanma samāhitaḥ,
3.231.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirase skandotpattau mahiṣāsuravadhe ekatriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥231॥
3.232.9: svargaṁ kīrtiṁ dhanaṁ caiva sa labhennātra saṁśayaḥ ॥9॥
3.232.19: ataḥ paraṁ vedmi gatiṁ na te’ham ॥19॥
3.232.20: skandasya ya idaṁ vipraḥ paṭhejjanma samāhitaḥ,
śrāvayed bāhmaṇebhyo yaḥ śr̥ṇuyād vā dvijeritam ॥20॥
3.232.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mārkaṇḍeyasamāsyāparvaṇi āṅgirase kārtikeyastave dvātriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥232॥
3.233.1: draupadī satyabhāmā ca viviśāte tadā samam ॥1॥
3.233.5: kathaṁ ca vaśagāstubhyaṁ na kupyanti ca te śubhe ॥5॥
3.233.6: tava vaśyā hi satataṁ pāṇḍavāḥ priyadarśane,
mukhaprekṣāśca te sarve tattvametad bravīhi me ॥6॥
3.233.8: yena kr̥ṣṇe bhavennityaṁ mama kr̥ṣṇo vaśānugaḥ ॥8॥
3.233.11: tathā hyupetā buddhyā tvaṁ kr̥ṣṇasya mahiṣī priyā ॥11॥
3.233.13: na jātu vaśago bhartā striyāḥ syānmantrakarmaṇā ॥13॥
3.233.17: na jātu vipriyaṁ bhartuḥ striyā kāryaṁ kathañcana ॥17॥
3.233.18: vartāmyahaṁ tu yāṁ vr̥ttiṁ pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu,
tāṁ sarvāṁ śr̥ṇu me satyāṁ satyabhāme yaśasvini ॥18॥
3.233.23: devo manuṣyo gandharvo yuvā cāpi svalaṅkr̥taḥ,
dravyavānabhirūpo vā na me’nyaḥ puruṣo mataḥ ॥23॥
3.233.25: kṣetrād vanād vā grāmād vā bhartāraṁ gr̥hamāgatam,
3.233.31: yacca bhartā na pibati yacca bhartā na sevate ॥31॥
3.233.32: yacca nāśnāti me bhartā sarvaṁ tad varjayāmyaham,
3.233.33: ye ca dharmāḥ kuṭumbeṣu śvaśrvā me kathitāḥ purā ॥33॥
3.233.34: mānyānāṁ mānasatkārā ye cānye viditā mama ॥34॥
3.233.37: patyāśrayo hi me dharmo mataḥ strīṇāṁ sanātanaḥ,
sa devaḥ sā gatirnānyā tasya kā vipriyaṁ caret ॥37॥
3.233.41: nāpi parivade cāhaṁ tāṁ pr̥thāṁ pr̥thivīsamām ॥41॥
3.233.48: tāsāṁ nāma ca rūpaṁ ca bhojanācchādanāni ca,
3.233.51: yeṣāṁ saṅkhyāvidhiṁ caiva pradiśāmi śr̥ṇomi ca ॥51॥
3.233.53: sarvaṁ rājñaḥ samudayamāyaṁ ca vyayameva ca,
3.233.55: sukhaṁ sarvaṁ parityajya rātryahāni ghaṭāmi vai ॥55॥
3.233.56: ekāhaṁ vedmi kośaṁ vai patīnāṁ dharmacāriṇām ॥56॥
3.233.57: aniśāyāṁ niśāyāṁ ca sahā yā kṣutpipāsayoḥ,
3.233.59: asatstrīṇāṁ samācāraṁ nāhaṁ kuryāṁ na kāmaye ॥59॥
3.234.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi draupadīsatyabhāmāsaṁvādaparvaṇi draupadīkartavyakathane catustriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥234॥
3.235.4: kr̥ṣṇe mā bhūt tavotkaṇṭhā mā vyathā mā prajāgaraḥ,
3.235.6: bhartr̥bhiḥ saha bhoktavyā nirdvandveti śrutaṁ mayā ॥6॥
3.235.8: tāḥ kṣipraṁ hatasaṅkalpā drakṣyasi tvaṁ kurustriyaḥ ॥8॥
3.235.12: tvamivaiṣāṁ subhadrā ca prītyā sarvātmanā sthitā ॥12॥
3.235.13: duḥkhitā tena duḥkhena sukhena sukhitā tathā ॥13॥
3.235.15: bhojanācchādane caiṣāṁ nityaṁ me śvaśuraḥ sthitaḥ,
3.235.16: tulyo hi praṇayasteṣāṁ pradyumnasya ca bhāvini,
3.235.18: smayitvā tu yaduśreṣṭho draupadīṁ parisāntvya ca,
upāvartya tataḥ śīghrairhayaiḥ prāyāt puraṁ svakam ॥18॥
3.235.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi draupadīsatyabhāmāsaṁvādaparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇagamane pañcatriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥235॥
3.236.13: yamau ca kr̥ṣṇāṁ ca yudhiṣṭhiraṁ ca
3.236.23: na syāt phalaṁ tasya kutaḥ prasiddhi-
3.236.26: kathaṁ na tat syāditi tat kutaḥ syāt ॥26॥
3.236.27: kathaṁ na bhidyeta na ca sraveta
3.236.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭrakhedavākye ṣaṭtriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥236॥
3.237.2: pravrājya pāṇḍavān vīrān svena vīryeṇa bhārata,
3.237.4: yā hi sā dīpyamāneva pāṇḍavānabhajat purā,
3.237.5: apaśyāma śriyaṁ rājan dr̥śyate sā tavādya vai ॥5॥
3.237.8: śāsane’dhiṣṭhitāḥ sarve kiṁ kurma iti vādinaḥ,
3.237.12: yaiḥ sma te nādriyetājñā na ca ye śāsane sthitāḥ,
3.237.13: śrūyate hi mahārāja saro dvaitavanaṁ prati,
3.237.14: sa prayāhi mahārāja śriyā paramayā yutaḥ,
3.237.15: sthito rājye cyutān rājyācchriyā hīnāñchriyā vr̥taḥ,
3.237.17: paśyanti puruṣe dīptāṁ sā samarthā bhavatyuta ॥17॥
3.237.20: kiṁ nu tasya sukhaṁ na syādāśrame yo dhanañjayam,
3.237.21: paśyantu duḥkhitāṁ kr̥ṣṇāṁ sā ca nirvidyatāṁ punaḥ ॥21॥
3.237.22: na tathā hi sabhāmadhye tasyā bhavitumarhati,
vaimanasyaṁ yathā dr̥ṣṭvā tava bhāryāḥ svalaṅkr̥tāḥ ॥22॥
3.237.23: evamuktvā tu rājānaṁ karṇaḥ śakuninā saha,
3.237.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi karṇaśakunivākye saptatriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥237॥
3.238.2: bravīṣi yadidaṁ karṇa sarvaṁ manasi me sthitam,
na tvabhyanujñāṁ lapsyāmi gamane yatra pāṇḍavāḥ ॥2॥
3.238.5: na hi dvaitavane kiñcid vidyate’nyat prayojanam,
3.238.6: jānāsi hi yathā kṣattā dyūtakāla upasthite,
abravīd yacca māṁ tvāṁ ca saubalaṁ vacanaṁ tadā ॥6॥
3.238.8: mamāpi hi mahān harṣo yadahaṁ bhīmaphālgunau,
3.238.10: kiṁ nu syādadhikaṁ tasmād yadahaṁ drupadātmajām,
3.238.11: yuktaṁ paramayā lakṣmyā paśyetāṁ jīvitaṁ bhavet ॥11॥
3.238.12: upāyaṁ na tu paśyāmi yena gacchema tad vanam,
3.238.13: upāyaṁ paśya nipuṇaṁ yena gacchema tad vanam ॥13॥
3.238.15: mayi tatropaviṣṭe tu bhīṣme ca kurusattame,
upāyo yo bhaved dr̥ṣṭastaṁ brūyāḥ sahasaubalaḥ ॥15॥
3.238.16: vaco bhīṣmasya rājñaśca niśamya gamanaṁ prati,
3.238.17: tathetyuktvā tu te sarve jagmurāvasathān prati,
3.238.20: ucitaṁ hi sadā gantuṁ ghoṣayātrāṁ viśāmpate,
evaṁ ca tvāṁ pitā rājan samanujñātumarhati ॥20॥
3.238.24: tataḥ prahasitāḥ sarve te’nyonyasya talān daduḥ,
3.238.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāmantraṇe aṣṭātriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥238॥
3.239.1: pr̥ṣṭvā sukhamatho rājñaḥ pr̥ṣṭā rājñā ca bhārata ॥1॥
3.239.5: mr̥gayā cocitā rājannasmin kāle sutasya te,
3.239.6: mr̥gayā śobhanā tāta gavāṁ hi samavekṣaṇam,
3.239.7: te tu tatra naravyāghrāḥ samīpa iti naḥ śrutam,
ato nābhyanujānāmi gamanaṁ tatra vaḥ svayam ॥7॥
3.239.9: yajñasenasya duhitā teja eva tu kevalam ॥9॥
3.239.12: anāryaṁ paramaṁ tat syādaśakyaṁ tacca vai matam ॥12॥
3.239.14: kiṁ punaḥ sa kr̥tāstro’dya na hanyād vo mahārathaḥ ॥14॥
3.239.15: athavā madvacaḥ śrutvā tatra yattā bhaviṣyatha,
3.239.17: na svayaṁ tatra gamanaṁ rocaye tava bhārata ॥17॥
3.239.18: dharmajñaḥ pāṇḍavo jyeṣṭhaḥ pratijñātaṁ ca saṁsadi,
3.239.19: yudhiṣṭhirastu kaunteyo na naḥ kopaṁ kariṣyati ॥19॥
3.239.20: mr̥gayāṁ caiva no gantumicchā saṁvartate bhr̥śam,
smāraṇaṁ tu cikīrṣāmo na tu pāṇḍavadarśanam ॥20॥
3.239.21: na ca tatra gamiṣyāmo yatra teṣāṁ pratiśrayaḥ ॥21॥
3.239.24: duḥśāsanena ca tathā saubalena ca dhīmatā,
3.239.25: taṁ niryāntaṁ mahābāhuṁ draṣṭuṁ dvaitavanaṁ saraḥ,
paurāścānuyayuḥ sarve sahadārā vanaṁ ca tat ॥25॥
3.239.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi duryodhanaprasthāne ekonacatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥239॥
3.240.1: atha duryodhano rājā tatra tatra vane vasan,
3.240.4: dadarśa sa tadā gāvaḥ śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ,
3.240.5: bālavatsāśca yā gāvaḥ kālayāmāsa tā api ॥5॥
3.240.6: atha sa smāraṇaṁ kr̥tvā lakṣayitvā trihāyanān,
3.240.7: sa ca paurajanaḥ sarvaḥ sainikāśca sahasraśaḥ,
3.240.9: sa strīgaṇāvr̥to rājā prahr̥ṣṭaḥ pradadau vasu,
3.240.10: tataste sahitāḥ sarve tarakṣūn mahiṣān mr̥gān,
3.240.15: r̥ddhyā paramayā yukto mahendra iva vajrabhr̥t,
3.240.22: vihāraśīlaḥ krīḍārthaṁ tena tat saṁvr̥taṁ saraḥ ॥22॥
3.240.23: tena tat saṁvr̥taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā te rājaparicārakāḥ,
3.240.24: sa tu teṣāṁ vacaḥ śrutvā sainikān yuddhadurmadān,
3.240.25: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā rājñaḥ senāgrayāyinaḥ,
3.240.28: na cetayati vo rājā mandabuddhiḥ suyodhanaḥ,
3.240.30: gacchadhvaṁ tvaritāḥ sarve yatra rājā sa kauravaḥ,
3.240.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi gandharvaduryodhanasenāsaṁvāde catvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥240॥
3.241.7: yadā vācā na tiṣṭhanti dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ sarājakāḥ ॥7॥
3.241.12: rādheyastu tadā vīro nāsīt tatra parāṅmukhaḥ,
3.241.20: tataḥ saṁnyapatan sarve gandharvāḥ kauravaiḥ saha ॥20॥
3.241.24: ekaiko hi tadā yodho dhārtarāṣṭrasya bhārata,
3.241.25: prādravanta raṇe bhītā ye ca rājañjigīṣavaḥ ॥25॥
3.241.28: sarva eva tu gandharvāḥ śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ,
3.241.31: anye chatraṁ varūthaṁ ca bandhuraṁ ca tathāpare,
3.241.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi karṇaparābhave ekacatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥241॥
3.242.2: tān dr̥ṣṭvā dravataḥ sarvān dhārtarāṣṭrān parāṅmukhān,
3.242.4: acintya śaravarṣaṁ tu gandharvāstasya taṁ ratham,
3.242.7: tasmin gr̥hīte rājendra sthitaṁ duḥśāsanaṁ rathe,
3.242.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi duryodhanādiharaṇe dvicatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥242॥
3.243.2: prasaktāni ca vairāṇi kuladharmo na naśyati ॥2॥
3.243.3: yadā tu kaścijjñātīnāṁ bāhyaḥ pothayate kulam,
3.243.3d1: paraiḥ paribhave prāpte vayaṁ pañcottaraṁ śatam,
parasparavirodhe tu vayaṁ pañca śataṁ tu te.
3.243.5: strīṇāṁ bāhyābhimarśācca hataṁ bhavati naḥ kulam ॥5॥
3.243.6: śaraṇaṁ ca prapannānāṁ trāṇārthaṁ ca kulasya ca,
3.243.7: arjunaśca yamau caiva tvaṁ ca vīrāparājitaḥ,
3.243.11d2: durbuddhirhi kr̥tā vīra bhr̥śaṁ daivena rakṣitāḥ.
3.243.11d3: kālakūṭaṁ viṣaṁ tīkṣṇaṁ bhojane mama bhārata,
uptvā gaṅgāṁ latāpāśairbaddhvā ca prākṣipat prabho.
3.243.11d4: dyūtakāle hi kaunteya vr̥jināni kr̥tāni vai,
3.243.11d5: purā kr̥tānāṁ pāpānāṁ phalaṁ bhuṅkte suyodhanaḥ.
3.243.11d7: upakārī tu gandharvo mā rājan vimanā bhava.
3.243.11d11: bhrātaraṁ te mahābāho baddhvā nayati māmayam,
3.243.13: varapradānaṁ rājyaṁ ca putrajanma ca pāṇḍavāḥ,
śatrośca mokṣaṇaṁ kleśāt trīṇi caikaṁ ca tatsamam ॥13॥
3.243.15: svayameva pradhāveyaṁ yadi na syād vr̥kodara,
vitato me kraturvīra na hi me’tra vicāraṇā ॥15॥
3.243.16: sāmnaiva tu yathā bhīma mokṣayethāḥ suyodhanam,
3.243.18: athāsau mr̥duyuddhena na muñced bhīma kauravān,
3.243.19: etāvaddhi mayā śakyaṁ sandeṣṭuṁ vai vr̥kodara,
vaitāne karmaṇi tate vartamāne ca bhārata ॥19॥
3.243.21: yadi sāmnā na mokṣyanti gandharvā dhr̥tarāṣṭrajān,
3.243.22: arjunasya tu tāṁ śrutvā pratijñāṁ satyavādinaḥ,
kauravāṇāṁ tadā rājan punaḥ pratyāgataṁ manaḥ ॥22॥
3.243.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi duryodhanamocanānujñāyāṁ tricatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥243॥
3.244.3: te daṁśitā rathaiḥ sarve dhvajinaḥ saśarāsanāḥ ॥3॥
3.244.14: ekasyaiva vayaṁ tāta kuryāma vacanaṁ bhuvi,
3.244.17: na tad gandharvarājasya yuktaṁ karma jugupsitam,
3.244.19: yadā sāmnā na muñcadhvaṁ gandharvā dhr̥tarāṣṭrajān,
3.244.20: sasarja niśitān bāṇān khacarān khacarān prati ॥20॥
3.244.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi pāṇḍavagandharvayuddhe catuścatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥244॥
3.245.3: yathā karṇasya ca ratho dhārtarāṣṭrasya cobhayoḥ,
3.245.8: tathā bhīmo maheṣvāsaḥ saṁyuge balināṁ varaḥ,
3.245.12: te baddhāḥ śarajālena śakuntā iva pañjare,
3.245.17: āgneyaṁ cāpi saumyaṁ ca sasarja kurunandanaḥ ॥17॥
3.245.22: sa gadāṁ bahudhā dr̥ṣṭvā kuttāṁ bāṇaistarasvinā,
3.245.29: dr̥ṣṭvā tu pāṇḍavāḥ sarve saṁhr̥tāstraṁ dhanañjayam ॥29॥
3.245.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi gandharvaparābhave pañcacatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥245॥
3.246.2: kiṁ te vyavasitaṁ vīra kauravāṇāṁ vinigrahe,
3.246.7: sa ca priyaḥ sakhā tubhyaṁ śiṣyaśca tava pāṇḍavaḥ,
3.246.11: jānāti dharmarājo hi śrutvā kuru yathecchasi ॥11॥
3.246.12: abhigamya ca tat sarvaṁ śaśaṁsustasya ceṣṭitam ॥12॥
3.246.13: mokṣayāmāsa tān sarvān gandharvān praśaśaṁsa ca ॥13॥
3.246.15: kulaṁ na paribhūtaṁ me mokṣaṇe’sya durātmanaḥ ॥15॥
3.246.19: kr̥tvā ca duṣkaraṁ karma prītiyuktāśca pāṇḍavāḥ ॥19॥
3.246.22: mā sma tāta punaḥ kārṣīrīdr̥śaṁ sāhasaṁ kvacit,
3.246.23: gr̥hān vraja yathākāmaṁ vaimanasyaṁ ca mā kr̥thāḥ ॥23॥
3.246.27: tathā dvaitavane tasmin vijahāra mudā yutaḥ ॥27॥
3.246.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi duryodhanamokṣaṇe ṣaṭcatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥246॥
3.247.10: diṣṭyā jīvasi gāndhāre diṣṭyā naḥ saṅgamaḥ punaḥ,
3.247.13: idaṁ tvatyadbhutaṁ manye yad yuṣmāniha bhārata ॥13॥
3.247.15: naitasya kartā loke’smin pumān bhārata vidyate,
yat kr̥taṁ te mahārāja saha bhrātr̥bhirāhave ॥15॥
