3.247.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate varnaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi karṇaduryodhanasaṁvāde saptacatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥247॥
3.248.3: tadā no na samaṁ yuddhamabhavat khecaraiḥ saha ॥3॥
3.248.4: parājayaṁ ca prāptāḥ smo raṇe bandhanameva ca,
3.248.7: taṁ mokṣayata bhadraṁ vaḥ sahadāraṁ narādhipam ॥7॥
3.248.10: yadā cāsmān na mumucurgandharvāḥ sāntvitā api ॥10॥
3.248.12: atha sarve raṇaṁ muktvā prayātāḥ khecarāḥ divam,
3.248.14: samāvr̥tā diśo dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍavena śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
3.248.16: te sametya tathānyonyaṁ sannāhān vipramucya ca,
3.248.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi duryodhanavākye aṣṭacatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥248॥
3.249.3: uvāca yat karṇa vayaṁ mantrayanto vinirgatāḥ ॥3॥
3.249.7: ye me nirākr̥tā nityaṁ ripuryeṣāmahaṁ sadā ॥7॥
3.249.8: prāptaḥ syāṁ yadyahaṁ vīra vadhaṁ tasmin mahāraṇe ॥8॥
3.249.9: bhaved yaśaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ me khyātaṁ gandharvato vadhāt ॥9॥
3.249.10: yat tvadya me vyavasitaṁ tacchr̥ṇudhvaṁ nararṣabhāḥ ॥10॥
3.249.11: iha prāyamupāsiṣye yūyaṁ vrajata vai gr̥hān,
bhrātaraścaiva me sarve yāntvadya svapuraṁ prati ॥11॥
3.249.16: kiṁ māṁ vakṣyanti kiṁ cāpi prativakṣyāmi tānaham ॥16॥
3.249.17: ripūṇāṁ śirasi sthitvā tathā vikramya corasi,
3.249.18: tiṣṭhanti na ciraṁ bhadre yathāhaṁ madagarvitaḥ ॥18॥
3.249.19: aho nārhamidaṁ karma kaṣṭaṁ duścaritaṁ kr̥tam,
svayaṁ durbuddhinā mohād yena prāpto’smi saṁśayam ॥19॥
3.249.20: tasmāt prāyamupāsiṣye na hi śakṣyāmi jīvitum,
3.249.23: pratīccha tvaṁ mayā dattamabhiṣekaṁ nr̥po bhava,
3.249.24: bhrātr̥̄n pālaya visrabdhaṁ maruto vr̥trahā yathā,
3.249.25: bandhūnāṁ suhr̥dāṁ caiva bhavethāstvaṁ gatiḥ sadā ॥25॥
3.249.28: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā dīno duḥśāsano’bravīt,
3.249.33: na cāhaṁ tvadr̥te rājan praśāseyaṁ vasundharām,
punaḥ punaḥ prasīdeti vākyaṁ cedamuvāca ha ॥33॥
3.249.34: tvameva naḥ kule rājā bhaviṣyasi śataṁ samāḥ,
evamuktvā sa rājānaṁ susvaraṁ praruroda ha ॥34॥
3.249.37: yadā ca śocataḥ śoko vyasanaṁ nāpakarṣati ॥37॥
3.249.38: sāmarthyaṁ kiṁ tataḥ śoke śocamānau prapaśyathaḥ,
dhr̥tiṁ gr̥hṇīta mā śatrūn śocantau nandayiṣyathaḥ ॥38॥
3.249.39: kartavyaṁ hi kr̥taṁ rājan pāṇḍavaistava mokṣaṇam,
3.249.41: uttiṣṭha vraja bhadraṁ te samāśvāsaya sodarān ॥41॥
3.249.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi duryodhanaprāyopaveśe ekonapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥249॥
3.250.1: kimatra citraṁ yad vīra mokṣitaḥ pāṇḍavairasi ॥1॥
3.250.3: ajñātairyadi vā jñātaiḥ kartavyaṁ nr̥pateḥ priyam,
3.250.4: nigr̥hyante ca yuddheṣu mokṣyante caiva sainikaiḥ,
senājīvāśca ye rājñāṁ viṣaye santi mānavāḥ ॥4॥
3.250.6: na caitat sādhu yad rājan pāṇḍavāstvāṁ nr̥pottamam ॥6॥
3.250.9: sattvasthān pāṇḍavān paśya na te prāyamupāviśan,
uttiṣṭha rājan bhadraṁ te na ciraṁ kartumarhasi ॥9॥
3.250.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi duryodhanaprāyopaveśe karṇavākye pañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥250॥
3.251.2: samyaguktaṁ hi karṇena tacchrutaṁ kaurava tvayā,
mayā hr̥tāṁ śriyaṁ sphītāṁ tāṁ mohādapahāya kim ॥2॥
3.251.4: yaḥ samutpatitaṁ harṣaṁ dainyaṁ vā na niyacchati,
3.251.5: vyasanād viṣayākrāntaṁ na bhajanti nr̥paṁ prajāḥ ॥5॥
3.251.6: satkr̥tasya hi te śoko viparīte kathaṁ bhavet,
mā kr̥taṁ śobhanaṁ pārthaiḥ śokamālamabya nāśaya ॥6॥
3.251.8: prasīda mā tyajātmānaṁ tuṣṭaśca sukr̥taṁ smara,
3.251.9: saubhrātraṁ pāṇḍavaiḥ kr̥tvā samavasthāpya caiva tān ॥9॥
3.251.15: naiva bhogaiśca me kāryaṁ mā vihanyata gacchata,
3.251.16: gacchadhvaṁ nagaraṁ sarve pūjyāśca guravo mama,
3.251.21: atha taṁ niścayaṁ tasya buddhvā daiteyadānavāḥ ॥21॥
3.251.22: te svapakṣakṣayaṁ taṁ tu jñātvā duryodhanasya vai ॥22॥
3.251.26: kr̥tyā samutthitā rājan kiṁ karomīti cābravīt ॥26॥
3.251.28: tatheti ca pratiśrutya sā kr̥tyā prayayau tadā,
3.251.29: tamānītaṁ nr̥paṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rātrau saṅgatya dānavāḥ ॥29॥
3.251.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi duryodhanaprāyopaveśe ekapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥251॥
3.252.1: śūraiḥ parivr̥to nityaṁ tathaiva ca mahātmabhiḥ ॥1॥
3.252.5: śrūyatāṁ tu prabho tattvaṁ divyatāṁ cātmano nr̥pa,
3.252.8: devyā ca rājaśārdūla divyastvaṁ hi na mānuṣaḥ ॥8॥
3.252.10: tadalaṁ te viṣādena bhayaṁ tava na vidyate,
sāhāyyārthaṁ ca te vīrāḥ sambhūtā bhuvi dānavāḥ ॥10॥
3.252.11: yairāviṣṭā ghr̥ṇāṁ tyaktvā yotsyante tava vairibhiḥ ॥11॥
3.252.12: naiva putrān na ca bhrātr̥̄n na pitr̥̄n ca bāndhavān,
naiva śiṣyān na ca jñātīn na bālāt sthavirān na ca ॥12॥
3.252.20: tad vairaṁ saṁsmaran vīra yotsyate keśavārjunau ॥20॥
3.252.21: sa te vikramaśauṭīro raṇe pārthaṁ vijeṣyati,
3.252.23: niyuktā rākṣasāścaiva ye te saṁśaptakā iti ॥23॥
3.252.24: prakhyātāste’rjunaṁ vīraṁ haniṣyanti ca mā śucaḥ,
asapatnā tvayā hīyaṁ bhoktavyā vasudhā nr̥pa ॥24॥
3.252.25: vinaṣṭe tvayi cāsmākaṁ pakṣo hīyeta kaurava ॥25॥
3.252.26: gaccha vīra na te buddhiranyā kāryā kathañcana,
3.252.28: sthirāṁ kr̥tvā buddhimasya priyāṇyuktvā ca bhārata,
3.252.30: pratinikṣipya taṁ vīraṁ kr̥tyā samabhipūjya ca,
3.252.35: arjunasya vadhe krūrāṁ karoti sma tadā matim,
3.252.39: na mr̥to jayate śatrūñjīvan bhadrāṇi paśyati,
mr̥tasya bhadrāṇi kutaḥ kauraveya kuto jayaḥ ॥39॥
3.252.40: na kālo’dya viṣādasya bhayasya maraṇasya vā,
3.252.41: uttiṣṭha rājan kiṁ śeṣe kasmācchocasi śatruhan,
śatrūn pratāpya vīryeṇa sa kathaṁ mr̥tyumicchasi ॥41॥
3.252.45: daityānāṁ tad vacaḥ śrutvā hr̥di kr̥tvā sthirāṁ matim,
3.252.50: karṇena sārdhaṁ rājendra saubalena ca devinā,
3.252.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi duryodhanapurapraveśe dvipañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥252॥
3.253.3: evaṁ gateṣu pārtheṣu visr̥ṣṭe ca suyodhane,
3.253.4: uktaṁ tāta yathā pūrvaṁ gacchataste tapovanam ॥4॥
3.253.5: gamanaṁ me na rucitaṁ tava tatra kr̥taṁ ca te,
tataḥ prāptaṁ tvayā vīra grahaṇaṁ śatrubhirbalāt ॥5॥
3.253.9: na cāpi pādabhāk karṇaḥ pāṇḍavānāṁ nr̥pottama,
dhanurvede ca śaurye ca dharme vā dharmavatsala ॥9॥
3.253.13: lajjayā vrīḍito rājan jagāma svaṁ niveśanam ॥13॥
3.253.15: kathaṁ ca sukr̥taṁ tat syānmantrayāmo’dya yaddhitam ॥15॥
3.253.16: duryodhana nibodhedaṁ yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi kaurava,
3.253.17: vigarhate ca māṁ nityaṁ tvatsamīpe nareśvara ॥17॥
3.253.18: so’haṁ bhīṣmavacastad vai na mr̥ṣyāmīha bhārata,
3.253.19: pāṇḍavānāṁ yaśo rājaṁstava nindāṁ ca bhārata,
3.253.21: tāmahaṁ te vijeṣyāmi eka eva na saṁśayaḥ,
3.253.22: anindyaṁ nindate yo hi apraśaṁsyaṁ praśaṁsati,
sa paśyatu balaṁ me’dya ātmānaṁ tu vigarhatu ॥22॥
3.253.23: anujānīhi māṁ rājan dhruvo hi vijayastava,
3.253.24: tacchrutvā tu vaco rājan karṇasya bharatarṣabha,
3.253.25: hiteṣu vartase nityaṁ saphalaṁ janma cādya me ॥25॥
3.253.26: tadā nirgaccha bhadraṁ te hyanuśādhi ca māmiti ॥26॥
3.253.28: śubhe tithau muhūrte ca pūjyamāno dvijātibhiḥ ॥28॥
3.253.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi karṇadigvijaye tripañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥253॥
3.254.1: tataḥ karṇo maheṣvāso balena mahatā vr̥taḥ,
3.254.2: yuddhena mahatā cainaṁ cakre vīraṁ vaśānugam,
suvarṇaṁ rajataṁ cāpi ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥2॥
3.254.4: athottarāṁ diśaṁ gatvā vaśe cakre narādhipān ॥4॥
3.254.6: prayayau ca diśaḥ sarvān nr̥patīn vaśamānayat,
3.254.10: mohanaṁ pattanaṁ caiva tripurīṁ kosalāṁ tathā ॥10॥
3.254.12: sa yuddhaṁ tumulaṁ kr̥tvā rukmī provāca sūtajam ॥12॥
3.254.13: prīto’smi tava rājendra vikrameṇa balena ca,
na te vighnaṁ kariṣyāmi pratijñāṁ samapālayam ॥13॥
3.254.14: sametya rukmiṇā karṇaḥ pāṇḍyaṁśailaṁ ca so’gamat ॥14॥
3.254.15: sa keralaṁ raṇe caiva nīlaṁ cāpi mahīpatim,
3.254.17: āvantyāṁśca vaśe kr̥tvā sāmnā ca bharatarṣabha,
3.254.22: evaṁ sa pr̥thivīṁ sarvāṁ vaśe kr̥tvā mahārathaḥ,
3.254.25: yanna bhīṣmānna ca droṇānna kr̥pānna ca bāhlikāt,
prāptavānasmi bhadraṁ te tvattaḥ prāptaṁ mayā hi tat ॥25॥
3.254.26: bahunā ca kimuktena śr̥ṇu karṇa vaco mama,
3.254.27: na hi te pāṇḍavāḥ sarve kalāmarhanti ṣoḍaśīm,
3.254.28: sa bhavān dhr̥tarāṣṭraṁ taṁ gāndhārīṁ ca yaśasvinīm,
paśya karṇa maheṣvāsa aditiṁ vajrabhr̥d yathā ॥28॥
3.254.31: evaṁ vijitya rājendra karṇaḥ śastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
3.254.33: kālena nātidīrgheṇa vaśe kr̥tvā tu pārthivān,
3.254.36: tadā prabhr̥ti rājā ca śakuniścāpi saubalaḥ,
jānate nirjitān pārthān karṇena yudhi bhārata ॥36॥
3.254.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi karṇadigvijaye catuṣpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥254॥
3.255.1: jitvā tu pr̥thivīṁ rājan sūtaputro janādhipa,
3.255.2: duryodhana nibodhedaṁ yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi kaurava,
3.255.4: na kiñcid durlabhaṁ tasya yasya tvaṁ puruṣarṣabha ॥4॥
3.255.5: abhiprāyastu me kaścit taṁ vai śr̥ṇu yathātatham ॥5॥
3.255.6: mama spr̥hā samutpannā tāṁ sampādaya sūtaja ॥6॥
3.255.12: āhara tvaṁ mama kr̥te yathānyāyaṁ yathākramam ॥12॥
3.255.13: na sa śakyaḥ kratuśreṣṭho jīvamāne yudhiṣṭhire ॥13॥
3.255.13d1: brāhmaṇaiḥ sahito rājan ye tatrāsan samāgatāḥ,
3.255.14: dīrghāyurjīvati ca te dhr̥tarāṣṭraḥ pitā nr̥pa ॥14॥
3.255.16: tena tvaṁ yaja rājendra śr̥ṇu cedaṁ vaco mama,
3.255.17: te karān samprayacchantu suvarṇaṁ ca kr̥tākr̥tam,
3.255.18: yajñavāṭasya te bhūmiḥ kr̥ṣyatāṁ tena bhārata,
3.255.19: eṣa te vaiṣṇavo nāma yajñaḥ satpuruṣocitaḥ ॥19॥
3.255.21: asmākaṁ rocate caiva śreyaśca tava bhārata,
nirvighnaśca bhavatyeṣa saphalā syāt spr̥hā tava ॥21॥
3.255.23: rocate me vacaḥ kr̥tsnaṁ brāhmaṇānāṁ na saṁśayaḥ,
rocate yadi yuṣmākaṁ tasmāt prabrūta mā ciram ॥23॥
3.255.25: yathoktaṁ ca nr̥paśreṣṭha kr̥taṁ sarvaṁ yathākramam ॥25॥
3.255.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi duryodhanayajñasamārambhe pañcapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥255॥
3.256.2: sajjaṁ kratuvaraṁ rājan prāptakālaṁ ca bhārata,
sauvarṇaṁ ca kr̥taṁ sarvaṁ lāṅgalaṁ ca mahādhanam ॥2॥
3.256.5: bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kr̥pa, karṇo gāndhārī ca yaśasvinī ॥5॥
3.256.6: pārthivānāṁ ca rājendra brāhmaṇānāṁ tathaiva ca ॥6॥
3.256.7: tatra kañcit prayātaṁ tu dūtaṁ duḥśāsano’bravīt ॥7॥
3.256.11: ahaṁ tu preṣito rājan kauraveṇa mahātmanā,
3.256.14: samayaḥ paripālyo no yāvad varṣaṁ trayodaśam ॥14॥
3.256.22: yathā sukhī janaḥ sarvaḥ kṣattaḥ syādannasaṁyutaḥ,
tuṣyet tu yajñasadane tathā kṣipraṁ vidhīyatām ॥22॥
3.256.25: sāntvayitvā ca rājendro dattvā ca vividhaṁ vasu ॥25॥
3.256.26: visr̥jya ca nr̥pān sarvān bhrātr̥bhiḥ parivāritaḥ ॥26॥
3.256.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi duryodhanayajñe ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥256॥
3.257.3: yudhiṣṭhirasya yajñena na samo hyeṣa te kratuḥ ॥3॥
3.257.6: kratumenaṁ samāhr̥tya pūtāḥ sarve divaṁ gatāḥ,
etā vācaḥ śubhāḥ śr̥ṇvan suhr̥dāṁ bharatarṣabha ॥6॥
3.257.7: praviveśa puraṁ hr̥ṣṭaḥ svaveśma ca narādhipaḥ,
3.257.10: hateṣu yudhi pārtheṣu rājasūye tathā tvayā ॥10॥
3.257.15: kadā tu taṁ kratuvaraṁ rājasūyaṁ mahādhanam,
3.257.16: tamabravīt tadā karṇaḥ śr̥ṇu me rājakuñjara,
pādau na dhāvaye tāvad yāvanna nihato’rjunaḥ ॥16॥
3.257.17: nāstīti naiva vakṣyāmi yācito yena kenacit ॥17॥
3.257.20: praviveśa gr̥haṁ śrīmān yathā caitrarathaṁ prabhuḥ,
3.257.26d1: satataṁ prīyamāṇo vai devinā saubalena ca,
3.257.28: bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ ca priyaṁ rājan sa cakāra parantapaḥ,
3.257.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi ghoṣayātrāparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhiracintāyāṁ saptapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥257॥
3.258.2: tataḥ śayānaṁ kaunteyaṁ rātrau dvaitavane mr̥gāḥ,
3.258.3: brūta yad vaktukāmāḥ stha ke bhavantaḥ kimiṣyate ॥3॥
3.258.9: yathā bhavanto bruvate kariṣyāmi ca tat tathā ॥9॥
3.258.10: abravīt sahitān bhrātr̥̄n dayāpanno mr̥gān prati ॥10॥
3.258.11: tantubhūtāḥ sma bhadraṁ te dayā naḥ kriyatāmiti ॥11॥
3.258.15: brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitā rājan ye ca tatra sahoṣitāḥ,
3.258.17: tad vanaṁ bharataśreṣṭhāḥ svargaṁ sukr̥tino yathā ॥17॥
3.258.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi mr̥gasvapnodbhavaparvaṇi kāmyakapraveśe aṣṭapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥258॥
3.259.4: na suṣvāpa sukhaṁ rājā hr̥di śalyairivārpitaiḥ,
3.259.6: arjunoṁ yamajau cobhau draupadī ca yaśasvinī,
sa ca bhīmo mahātejāḥ sarveṣāmuttamo balī ॥6॥
3.259.11: tānavekṣya kr̥śān pautrān vane vanyena jīvataḥ ॥11॥
3.259.14: na hyanantaṁ sukhaṁ kaścit prāpnoti puruṣarṣabha,
3.259.15: udayāstamanajño hi na hr̥ṣyati na śocati,
3.259.16: tapaso hi paraṁ nāsti tapasā vindate mahat ॥16॥
3.259.19: kr̥cchrāṁ yonimanuprāptā na sukhaṁ vindate janāḥ ॥19॥
3.259.20: iha yat kriyate karma tat paratropayujyate,
3.259.21: kāle prāpte ca hr̥ṣṭātmā rājan vigatamatsaraḥ ॥21॥
3.259.23: dāntaḥ śamaparaḥ śaśvat parikleśaṁ na vindati,
na ca tapyati dāntātmā dr̥ṣṭvā paragatāṁ śriyam ॥23॥
3.259.24: saṁvibhaktā ca dātā ca bhogavān sukhavān naraḥ,
3.259.27: kiṁsvid bahuguṇaṁ pretya kiṁ vā duṣkaramucyate ॥27॥
3.259.28: arthe ca mahatī tr̥ṣṇā sa ca duḥkhena labhyate ॥28॥
3.259.29: parityajya priyān prāṇām dhanārthaṁ hi mahāmate,
3.259.31: na duṣkarataraṁ dānāt tasmād dānaṁ mataṁ mama ॥31॥
3.259.32: pātre kāle ca deśe ca sādhubhyaḥ pratipādayet ॥32॥
3.259.33: kriyate na sa kartāraṁ trāyate mahato bhayāt ॥33॥
3.259.34: pātre dānaṁ svalpamapi kāle dattaṁ yudhiṣṭhira,
3.259.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi vrīhidrauṇikaparvaṇi dānaduṣkaratvakathane ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥259॥
3.260.1: kasmai dattaśca bhagavan vidhinā kena cāttha me ॥1॥
3.260.2: pratyakṣadharmā bhagavān yasya tuṣṭo hi karmabhiḥ,
3.260.5: saputradāro hi muniḥ pakṣāhāro babhūva ha,
3.260.6: darśaṁ ca paurṇamāsaṁ ca kurvan vigatamatsaraḥ,
3.260.8: sa parvakālaṁ kr̥tvā tu munivr̥ttyā samanvitaḥ,
3.260.11: taṁ tu śuśrāva dharmiṣṭhaṁ mudgalaṁ saṁśitavratam,
3.260.12: vikacaḥ paruṣā vāco vyāharan vividhā muniḥ ॥12॥
3.260.16: bubhuje kr̥tsnamunmattaḥ prādāt tasmai ca mudgalaḥ ॥16॥
3.260.20: na krodho na ca mātsaryaṁ nāvamāno na sambhramaḥ,
3.260.22: na cāsya manasā kañcid vikāraṁ dadr̥śe muniḥ,
śuddhasattvasya śuddhaṁ sa dadr̥śe nirmalaṁ manaḥ ॥22॥
3.260.23: tamuvāca tataḥ prītaḥ sa munirmudgalaṁ tataḥ,
3.260.28: dayā satyaṁ ca dharmaśca tvayi sarvaṁ pratiṣṭhitam,
3.260.29: aho dānaṁ vighuṣṭaṁ te sumahat svargavāsibhiḥ,
3.260.34: ke guṇāstatra vasatāṁ kiṁ tapaḥ kaśca niścayaḥ,
svarge tatra sukhaṁ kiṁ ca doṣo vā devadūtaka ॥34॥
3.260.35: mitratāṁ ca puraskr̥tya pr̥cchāmi tvāmahaṁ vibho ॥35॥
3.260.36: yadatra tathyaṁ pathyaṁ ca tad bravīhyavicārayan,
śrutvā tathā kariṣyāmi vyavasāyaṁ girā tava ॥36॥
3.260.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi vrīhidrauṇikaparvaṇi mudgalopākhyāne ṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥260॥
3.261.6: devāḥ sādhyāstathā viśve tathaiva ca maharṣayaḥ,
3.261.9: na kṣutpipāse na glānirna śītoṣṇe bhayaṁ tathā ॥9॥
3.261.11: na śoko na jarā tatra nāyāsaparidevane ॥11॥
3.261.14: na saṁsvedo na daurgandhyaṁ purīṣaṁ mūtrameva ca,
teṣāṁ na ca rajo vastraṁ bādhate tatra vai mune ॥14॥
3.261.18: yatra yāntyr̥ṣayo brahman pūtāḥ svaiḥ karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ ॥18॥
3.261.19: teṣāṁ lokāt paratare yān yajantīha devatāḥ ॥19॥
3.261.23: jarā mr̥tyuḥ kutasteṣāṁ harṣaḥ prītiḥ sukhaṁ na ca,
na duḥkhaṁ na sukhaṁ cāpi rāgadveṣau kuto mune ॥23॥
3.261.24: devānāmapi maudgalya kāṅkṣitā sā gatiḥ parā,
3.261.27: guṇāḥ svargasya proktāste doṣānapi nibodha me ॥27॥
3.261.28: kr̥tasya karmaṇastatra bhujyate yat phalaṁ divi,
na cānyat kriyate karma mūlacchedena bhujyate ॥28॥
3.261.29: so’tra doṣo mama matastasyānte patanaṁ ca yat,
3.261.30: yad bhavatyavare sthāne sthitānāṁ tat suduṣkaram ॥30॥
3.261.33: ayaṁ tvanyo guṇaḥ śreṣṭhaścyutānāṁ svargato mune,
3.261.34: na cet sambudhyate tatra gacchatyadhamatāṁ tataḥ ॥34॥
3.261.35: iha yat kriyate karma tat paratropabhujyate,
3.261.36: nirdoṣa eva yastvanyo lokaṁ taṁ pravadasva me ॥36॥
3.261.37: brahmaṇaḥ sadanādūrdhvaṁ tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṁ padam,
śuddhaṁ sanātanaṁ jyotiḥ paraṁ brahmeti yad viduḥ ॥37॥
3.261.38: na tatra vipra gacchanti puruṣā viṣayātmakāḥ,
3.261.40: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ yanmāṁ pr̥cchasi mudgala,
tavānukampayā sādho sādhu gacchāma mā ciram ॥40॥
3.261.41: etacchrutvā tu maudgalyo vākyaṁ vimamr̥śe dhiyā,
3.261.42: mahādoṣeṇa me kāryaṁ na svargeṇa sukhena vā ॥42॥
3.261.44: yatra gatvā na śocanti na vyathanti calanti vā,
3.261.45: ityuktvā sa munirvākyaṁ devadūtaṁ visr̥jya tam,
3.261.48: tasmāt tvamapi kaunteya na śokaṁ kartumarhasi,
3.261.50: varṣāt trayodaśādūrdhvaṁ vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥50॥
3.261.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi vrīhidrauṇikaparvaṇi mudgaladevadūtasaṁvāde ekaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥261॥
3.262.5: śrutvā teṣāṁ tathā vr̥ttiṁ nagare vasatāmiva,
3.262.10: ahāni katicit tatra tasthau sa munisattamaḥ,
3.262.12: ityuktvā gacchati snātuṁ pratyāgacchati vai cirāt,
3.262.13: kadācicca niśīthe sa utthāya nikr̥tau sthitaḥ ॥13॥
3.262.14: pūrvavat kārayitvānnaṁ na bhuṅkte garhayan sma saḥ,
vartamāne tathā tasmin yadā duryodhano nr̥paḥ ॥14॥
3.262.15: vikr̥tiṁ naiti na krodhaṁ tadā tuṣṭo’bhavanmuniḥ,
3.262.16: varaṁ varaya bhadraṁ te yat te manasi vartate,
mayi prīte tu yad dharmyaṁ nālabhyaṁ vidyate tava ॥16॥
3.262.19: śiṣyaiḥ saha mama brahman yathā jāto’tithirbhavān ॥19॥
3.262.21: yadā ca rājaputrī sā sukumārī yaśasvinī ॥21॥
3.262.22: viśrāntā ca svayaṁ bhuktvā sukhāsīnā bhaved yadā ॥22॥
3.262.23: tadā tvaṁ tatra gacchethā yadyanugrāhyatā mayi,
3.262.25: kareṇa ca karaṁ gr̥hya karṇasya mudito bhr̥śam,
3.262.26: diṣṭyā kāmaḥ susaṁvr̥tto diṣṭyā kaurava vardhase,
diṣṭyā te śatravo magnā dustare vyasanārṇave ॥26॥
3.262.27: svaireva te mahāpāpairgatā vai dustaraṁ tamaḥ ॥27॥
3.262.28: hasantaḥ prītamanaso jagmuḥ svaṁ svaṁ niketanam ॥28॥
3.262.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi draupadīharaṇaparvaṇi durvāsaüpākhyāne dviṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥262॥
3.263.1: bhuktvā cāvasthitāṁ kr̥ṣṇāṁ jñātvā tasmin vane muniḥ ॥1॥
3.263.2: dr̥ṣṭvā’’yāntaṁ tamatithiṁ sa ca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥2॥
3.263.5: jagāma ca muniḥ so’pi snātuṁ śiṣyaiḥ sahānaghaḥ,
3.263.10: ākūtīnāṁ ca cittīnāṁ pravartaka natāsmi te ॥10॥
3.263.15: tvayā nāthena deveśa sarvāpadbhyo bhayaṁ na hi ॥15॥
3.263.18: pārśvasthāṁ śayane tyaktvā rukmiṇīṁ keśavaḥ prabhuḥ,
3.263.19: tatastaṁ draupadī dr̥ṣṭvā praṇamya parayā mudā,
3.263.20: śīghraṁ bhojaya māṁ kr̥ṣṇe paścāt sarvaṁ kariṣyasi ॥20॥
3.263.23: śīghraṁ gaccha mama sthālīmānīya tvaṁ pradarśaya ॥23॥
3.263.24: sthālyāḥ kaṇṭhe’tha saṁlagnaṁ śākānnaṁ vīkṣya keśavaḥ ॥24॥
3.263.27: ākārituṁ tu tān sarvān bhojanārthaṁ nr̥pottama ॥27॥
3.263.28: snātuṁ gatān devanadyāṁ durvāsaḥ prabhr̥tīn munīn,
3.263.30: rājñā hi kārayitvānnaṁ vayaṁ snātuṁ samāgatāḥ ॥30॥
3.263.36: ityuktāste dvijāḥ sarve muninā guruṇā tadā,
pāṇḍavebhyo bhr̥śaṁ bhītā dudruvuste diśo daśa ॥36॥
3.263.40: kathaṁ ca nistare māsmāt kr̥cchrād daivopasāditāt ॥40॥
3.263.41: uvāca vacanaṁ śrīmān kr̥ṣṇaḥ pratyakṣatāṁ gataḥ ॥41॥
3.263.44: dharmanityāstu ye kecinna te sīdanti karhicit,
āpr̥cche vo gamiṣyāmi niyataṁ bhadramastu vaḥ ॥44॥
3.263.47: svasti sādhaya bhadraṁ te ityājñāto yayau purīm,
3.263.48: iti te’bhihitaṁ rājan yat pr̥ṣṭo’hamiha tvayā ॥48॥
3.263.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi draupadīharaṇaparvaṇi durvāsaüpākhyāne triṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥263॥
3.264.10: apsarā devakanyā vā māyā vā devanirmitā,
3.264.12: kasya tveṣānavadyāṅgī yadi vāpi na mānuṣī ॥12॥
3.264.14: gaccha jānīhi saumyemāṁ kasya vātra kuto’pi vā,
3.264.16: gaccha jānīhi ko nvasyā nātha ityeva koṭika ॥16॥
3.264.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi draupadīharaṇaparvaṇi jayadrathāgamane catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥264॥
3.265.2: devī nu yakṣī yadi dānavī vā
3.265.4: na hyeva naḥ pr̥cchasi ye vayaṁ sma
3.265.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi draupadīharaṇaparvaṇi koṭikāsyapraśne pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥265॥
3.266.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi draupadīharaṇaparvaṇi draupadīvākye ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥266॥
3.267.1: yaduktaṁ kr̥ṣṇayā sārdhaṁ tat sarvaṁ pratyavedayat ॥1॥
3.267.2: yadā vācaṁ vyāharantyāmasyāṁ me ramate manaḥ ॥2॥
3.267.3: etāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā striyo me’nyā yathā śākhāmr̥gastriyaḥ ॥3॥
3.267.5: tāṁ samācakṣva kalyāṇīṁ yadi syācchaibya mānuṣī,
eṣā vai draupadī kr̥ṣṇā rājaputrī yaśasvinī ॥5॥
3.267.6: sarveṣāṁ caiva pārthānāṁ priyā bahumatā satī ॥6॥
3.267.8: sa praviśyāśramaṁ puṇyaṁ siṁhagoṣṭhaṁ vr̥ko yathā ॥8॥
3.267.10: api te kuśalaṁ rājan rāṣṭre kośe bale tathā ॥10॥
3.267.16: śriyā vihīnā rāṣṭrācca vinaṣṭāḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ,
3.267.17: bhāryā me bhava suśroṇi tyajainān sukhamāpnuhi,
3.267.20d1: naivaṁ vada mahābāho nyāyyaṁ tvaṁ na ca budhyase.
3.267.20d3: mama bhrātā ca nyāyyena tvayā rakṣyā mahāratha,
dharmiṣṭhānāṁ kule jāto na dharmaṁ tvamavekṣase.
3.267.20d4: rājñāṁ dharmaṁ na jānīṣe striyo ratnāni caiva hi,
3.267.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi draupadīharaṇaparvaṇi jayadrathadraupadīsaṁvāde saptaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥267॥
3.268.4: ahaṁ tu manye tava nāsti kaści-
3.268.9: yathā ca veṇuḥ kadalī nalo vā
3.268.27: kṣudraṁ kr̥tvā phalaṁ pāpaṁ tvaṁ prāpsyasi na saṁśayaḥ,
3.269.4: rmano hi me dūyati dahyate ca,
3.269.15: mā tvaṁ śucastāṁ prati bhīru viddhi
3.269.27: dr̥ṣṭvā priyāṁ tasya rathe sthitāṁ ca ॥27॥
3.269.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi draupadīharaṇaparvaṇi pārthāgamane ekonasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥269॥
3.270.1: tato ghorataraḥ śabdo vane samabhavat tadā,
3.270.5: na me vyathā vidyate tvadbhayaṁ vā
3.270.13: yo vai na kāmānna bhayānna lobhāt
tyajed dharmaṁ na nr̥śaṁsaṁ ca kuryāt,
3.270.17: buddhyā samo yasya naro na vidyate
3.270.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi draupadīharaṇaparvaṇi draupadīvākye saptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥270॥
3.271.1: iti sma saindhavo rājā codayāmāsa tān nr̥pān ॥1॥
3.271.2: tato ghoratamaḥ śabdo raṇe samabhavat tadā,
3.271.8: pārthaḥ pañca śatān śūrān parvatīyān mahārathān,
3.271.23: sa tat karma mahat kr̥tvā śūro mādravatīsutaḥ,
3.271.25: na bubodha hataṁ sūtaṁ sa rājā bāhuśālinā,
3.271.26: vimukhaṁ hatasūtaṁ taṁ bhīmaḥ praharatāṁ varaḥ,
3.271.33: sa tasmin saṅkule sainye draupadīmavatārya tām,
3.271.36: savyasācī tu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā palāyantaṁ jayadratham,
3.271.38: tamevānviṣa bhadraṁ te kiṁ te yodhairnipātitaiḥ,
anāmiṣamidaṁ karma kathaṁ vā manyate bhavān ॥38॥
3.271.41: yamābhyāṁ saha rājendra dhaumyena ca mahātmanā,
3.271.42: na hi me mokṣyate jīvan mūḍhaḥ saindhavako nr̥paḥ,
3.271.43: na hantavyo mahābāho durātmāpi sa saindhavaḥ,
3.271.45: kartavyaṁ cet priyaṁ mahyaṁ vadhyaḥ sa puruṣādhamaḥ,
3.271.46: bhāryābhihartā vairī yo yaśca rājyaharo ripuḥ,
3.271.50: te sma taṁ muditā dr̥ṣṭvā punaḥ pratyāgataṁ nr̥pam,
jitvā tān sindhusauvīrān draupadīṁ cāhr̥tāṁ punaḥ ॥50॥
3.271.51: sa taiḥ parivr̥to rājā tatraivopaviveśa ha,
3.271.56: saindhavastu hatān dr̥ṣṭvā tathāśvān svān suduḥkhitaḥ,
3.271.58: anena vīryeṇa kathaṁ striyaṁ prārthayase balāt ॥58॥
3.271.59: rājaputra nivartasva na te yuktaṁ palāyanam,
3.271.60: tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti taṁ bhīmaḥ sahasābhyadravad balī,
3.271.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi draupadīharaṇaparvaṇi jayadrathapalāyane ekasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥271॥
3.272.3: samudyamya ca taṁ bhīmo niṣpipeṣa mahītale,
śiro gr̥hītvā rājānaṁ tāḍayāmāsa caiva ha ॥3॥
3.272.5: tasya jānū dadau bhīmo jaghne cainamaratninā,
3.272.6: duḥśalāyāḥ kr̥te rājā yat tadāheti kaurava ॥6॥
3.272.8: kiṁ nu śakyaṁ mayā kartuṁ yad rājā satataṁ ghr̥ṇī,
tvaṁ ca bāliśayā buddhyā sadaivāsmān prabādhase ॥8॥
3.272.10: jīvituṁ cecchase mūḍha hetuṁ me gadataḥ śr̥ṇu ॥10॥
3.272.11: dāso’smīti tathā vācyaṁ saṁsatsu ca sabhāsu ca,
evaṁ te jīvitaṁ dadyāmeṣa yuddhajito vidhiḥ ॥11॥
3.272.13: tata enaṁ viceṣṭantaṁ baddhvā pārtho vr̥kodaraḥ,
3.272.15: taṁ rājā prāhasad dr̥ṣṭvā mucyatāmiti cābravīt ॥15॥
3.272.17: tamuvāca tato jyeṣṭho bhrātā sapraṇayaṁ vacaḥ,
3.272.21: adāso gaccha mukto’si maivaṁ kārṣīḥ punaḥ kvacit,
strīkāmaṁ vā dhigastu tvāṁ kṣudraḥ kṣudrasahāyavān ॥21॥
3.272.22: evaṁvidhaṁ hi kaḥ kuryāt tvadanyaḥ puruṣādhamaḥ,
3.272.22d1: karma dharmaviruddhaṁ vai lokaduṣṭaṁ ca karma te,
3.272.23: dharme te vardhatāṁ buddhirmā cādharme manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥23॥
3.272.27: varaṁ cāsmai dadau devaḥ sa jagrāha ca tacchr̥ṇu,
samastān sarathān pañca jayeyaṁ yudhi pāṇḍavān ॥27॥
3.272.40: naiśena tamasā vyāptāṁ svāṁ rātriṁ kurute vibhuḥ ॥40॥
3.272.42: ayanaṁ tena caivāste tena nārāyaṇaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥42॥
3.272.45: śūnyaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā jagat kr̥tsnaṁ mānasānātmanaḥ samān,
3.272.51: jale nimagnāṁ gāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā coddhartuṁ manasecchati,
kiṁ nu rūpamahaṁ kr̥tvā salilāduddhare mahīm ॥51॥
3.272.52: evaṁ sañcintya manasā dr̥ṣṭvā divyena cakṣuṣā,
3.272.55: bhūtvā yajñavarāho vai apaḥ samprāviśat prabhuḥ,
3.272.57: daityendrasya sabhāṁ gatvā pāṇiṁ saṁspr̥śya pāṇinā,
3.272.64: yajñavāṭaṁ gataḥ śrīmān dānavendrasya vai tadā ॥64॥
3.272.66: prīto’smi darśane vipra brūhi tvaṁ kiṁ dadāni te,
3.272.69: dadau śakrāya ca mahīṁ viṣṇurdevaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥69॥
3.272.70: eṣa te vāmano nāma prādurbhāvaḥ prakīrtitaḥ,
tena devāḥ prādurāsan vaiṣṇavaṁ cocyate jagat ॥70॥
3.272.72: sa evaṁ bhagavān viṣṇuḥ kr̥ṣṇeti parikīrtyate,
3.272.73: yaṁ devaṁ viduṣo gānti tasya karmāṇi saindhava,
3.272.76: na śakyate tena jetuṁ tridaśairapi duḥsahaḥ,
kaḥ punarmānuṣo bhāvo raṇe pārthaṁ vijeṣyati ॥76॥
3.272.77: tamekaṁ varjayitvā tu sarvaṁ yaudhiṣṭhiraṁ balam,
caturaḥ pāṇḍavān rājan dinaikaṁ jeṣyase ripūn ॥77॥
3.272.81: pāṇḍavāśca vane tasmin nyavasan kāmyake tathā ॥81॥
3.273.4: saṁśayaṁ paripr̥cchāmi chindhi me hr̥di saṁsthitam ॥4॥
3.273.6: manye kālaśca bhagavān daivaṁ ca vidhinirmitam,
bhavitavyaṁ ca bhūtānāṁ yasya nāsti vyatikramaḥ ॥6॥
3.273.8: na hi pāpaṁ kr̥taṁ kiñcit karma vā ninditaṁ kvacit,
3.273.10: pratyāhr̥tā tathā smābhirhatvā tat saindhavaṁ balam ॥10॥
3.273.12: bhavatā dr̥ṣṭapūrvo vā śrutapūrvo’pi vā bhavet ॥12॥
3.273.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirapraśne trisaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥273॥
3.274.1: rakṣasā jānakī tasya hr̥tā bhāryā balīyasā ॥1॥
3.274.3: baddhvā setuṁ samudrasya dagdhvā laṅkāṁ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥3॥
3.274.4: kasmin rāmaḥ kule jātaḥ kiṁvīryaḥ kimparākramaḥ,
rāvaṇaḥ kasya putro vā kiṁ vairaṁ tasya tena ha ॥4॥
3.274.8: rāmasya mātā kausalyā kaikeyī bharatasya tu,
3.274.9: yāṁ cakāra svayaṁ tvaṣṭā rāmasya mahiṣīṁ priyām ॥9॥
3.274.10: etad rāmasya te janma sītāyāśca prakīrtitam,
3.274.12: tasya vaiśravaṇo nāma gavi putro’bhavat prabhuḥ ॥12॥
3.274.14: sa jajñe viśravā nāma tasyātmārdhena vai dvijaḥ,
3.274.16: īśānena tathā sakhyaṁ putraṁ ca nalakūbaram,
3.274.17: vimānaṁ puṣpakaṁ nāma kāmagaṁ ca dadau prabhuḥ,
3.274.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi rāmarāvaṇayorjanmakathane catuḥsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥274॥
3.275.2: bubudhe taṁ tu sakrodhaṁ pitaraṁ rākṣaseśvaraḥ,
3.275.5: puṣpotkaṭā ca rākā ca mālinī ca viśāmpate,
3.275.6: sa tāsāṁ bhagavāṁstuṣṭo mahātmā pradadau varān,
3.275.8: rākāyāṁ mithunaṁ jajñe kharaḥ śūrpaṇakhā tathā ॥8॥
3.275.19: kharaḥ śūrpaṇakhā caiva teṣāṁ vai tapyatāṁ tapaḥ,
3.275.21: tato brahmā svayaṁ gatvā tapasastān nyavārayat,
3.275.22: prīto’smi vo nivartadhvaṁ varān vr̥ṇuta putrakāḥ,
3.275.23: yad yadagnau hutaṁ sarvaṁ śiraste mahadīpsayā,
tathaiva tāni te dehe bhaviṣyanti yathepsayā ॥23॥
3.275.24: vairūpyaṁ ca na te dehe kāmarūpadharastathā,
bhaviṣyasi raṇe’rīṇāṁ vijetā na ca saṁśayaḥ ॥24॥
3.275.26: ya ete kīrtitāḥ sarve na tebhyo’sti bhayaṁ tava,
r̥te manuṣyād bhadraṁ te tathā tad vihitaṁ mayā ॥26॥
3.275.28: sa vavre mahatīṁ nidrāṁ tamasā grastacetanaḥ ॥28॥
3.275.29: varaṁ vr̥ṣṇīṣva putra tvaṁ prīto’smīti punaḥ punaḥ ॥29॥
3.275.30: aśikṣitaṁ ca bhagavan brahmāstraṁ pratibhātu me ॥30॥
3.275.34: śaśāpa taṁ vaiśravaṇo na tvāmetad vahiṣyati ॥34॥
3.275.35: yastu tvāṁ samare hantā tamevaitad vahiṣyati,
avamanya guruṁ māṁ ca kṣipraṁ tvaṁ na bhaviṣyasi ॥35॥
3.275.37: tasmai sa bhagavāṁstuṣṭo bhrātā bhrātre dhaneśvaraḥ,
3.275.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi rāvaṇādivaraprāptau pañcasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥275॥
3.276.3: tato nastrātu bhagavan nānyastrātā hi vidyate ॥3॥
3.276.4: na sa devāsuraiḥ śakyo yuddhe jetuṁ vibhāvaso,
3.276.5: viṣṇuḥ praharatāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ sa tat karma kariṣyati ॥5॥
3.276.9: teṣāṁ samakṣaṁ gandharvīṁ dundubhīṁ nāma nāmataḥ,
3.276.10: mantharā mānuṣe loke kubjā samabhavat tadā ॥10॥
3.276.12: te’nvavartan pitr̥̄n sarve yaśasā ca balena ca,
3.276.15: mantharāṁ bodhayāmāsa yad yat kāryaṁ yathā yathā ॥15॥
3.276.16: sā tadvacaḥ samājñāya tathā cakre manojavā,
3.276.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi vānarādyutpattau ṣaṭsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥276॥
3.277.1: uktaṁ bhagavatā janma rāmādīnāṁ pr̥thak pr̥thak,
3.277.2: samprasthitau vane brahman maithilī ca yaśasvinī ॥2॥
3.277.4: krameṇa cāsya te putrā vyavardhanta mahaujasaḥ,
3.277.6: jyeṣṭho rāmo’bhavat teṣāṁ ramayāmāsa hi prajāḥ,
3.277.7: tataḥ sa rājā matimān matvā’’tmānaṁ vayo’dhikam,
3.277.8: prāptakālaṁ ca te sarve menire mantrisattamāḥ ॥8॥
3.277.15: adya puṣyo niśi brahman puṇyaṁ yogamupaiṣyati,
3.277.17: adya kaikeyi daurbhāgyaṁ rājñā te khyāpitaṁ mahat,
3.277.18: kuto hi tava saubhāgyaṁ yasyāḥ putro na rājyabhāk ॥18॥
3.277.22: varaṁ dadāni te hanta tad gr̥hāṇa yadicchasi,
avadhyo vadhyatāṁ ko’dya vadhyaḥ ko’dya vimucyatām ॥22॥
3.277.23: dhanaṁ dadāni kasyādya hriyatāṁ kasya vā punaḥ,
3.277.24: yaste’bhilaṣitaḥ kāmo brūhi kalyāṇi mā ciram ॥24॥
3.277.27: sa tad rājā vacaḥ śrutvā vipriyaṁ dāruṇodayam,
duḥkhārto bharataśreṣṭha na kiñcid vyājahāra ha ॥27॥
3.277.28: vanaṁ pratasthe dharmātmā rājā satyo bhavatviti ॥28॥
3.277.29: sītā ca bhāryā bhadraṁ te vaidehī janakātmajā ॥29॥
3.277.30: tato vanaṁ gate rāme rājā daśarathastadā,
3.277.31: rāmaṁ tu gatamājñāya rājānaṁ ca tathāgatam,
3.277.33: tāmuvāca sa dharmātmā nr̥śaṁsaṁ bata te kr̥tam,
3.277.34: ayaśaḥ pātayitvā me mūrdhni tvaṁ kulapāṁsane,
sakāmā bhava me mātarityuktvā praruroda ha ॥34॥
3.277.36: kausalyāṁ ca sumitrāṁ ca kaikeyīṁ ca suduḥkhitaḥ,
agre prasthāpya yānaiḥ sa śatrughnasahito yayau ॥36॥
3.277.38d1: gaccha tāta prajā rakṣyāḥ satyaṁ rakṣāmyahaṁ pituḥ,
3.277.44: dūṣaṇaṁ ca kharaṁ caiva nihatya sumahābalau,
cakre kṣemaṁ punardhīmān dharmāraṇyaṁ sa rāghavaḥ ॥44॥
3.277.45: hateṣu teṣu rakṣaḥsu tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā punaḥ,
3.277.47: tāṁ tathā vikr̥tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ,
3.277.50: siṁhaṁ kesariṇaṁ kaśca daṁṣṭrāyāṁ spr̥śya tiṣṭhati ॥50॥
3.277.53: sa niścitya tataḥ kr̥tyaṁ svasāramupasāntvya ca,
3.277.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi rāmavanābhigamane saptasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥277॥
3.278.3: na te prakr̥timān varṇaḥ kaccit kṣemaṁ pure tava,
kaccit prakr̥tayaḥ sarvā bhajante tvāṁ yathā purā ॥3॥
3.278.4: kr̥tamityeva tad viddhi yadyapi syāt suduṣkaram ॥4॥
3.278.6: alaṁ te rāmamāsādya vīryajño hyasmi tasya vai ॥6॥
3.278.7: bāṇavegaṁ hi kastasya śaktaḥ soṛhaṁ mahātmanaḥ,
pravrajyāyāṁ hi me hetuḥ sa eva puruṣarṣabhaḥ ॥7॥
3.278.11: kiṁ te sāhyaṁ mayā kāryaṁ kariṣyāmyavaśo’pi tat,
3.278.12: dhruvaṁ sītā samālakṣya tvāṁ rāmaṁ codayiṣyati ॥12॥
3.278.13: apakrānte ca kākutsthe sītā vaśyā bhaviṣyati,
3.278.23: śuśrāva tasya vaidehī tatastāṁ karuṇāṁ giram ॥23॥
3.278.24: alaṁ te śaṅkayā bhīru ko rāmaṁ prahariṣyati ॥24॥
3.278.25: muhūrtād drakṣyase rāmaṁ bhartāraṁ tvaṁ śucismite,
3.278.26: sā taṁ paruṣamārabdhā vaktuṁ sādhvī pativratā ॥26॥
3.278.27: naiṣa kāmo bhavenmūḍha yaṁ tvaṁ prārthayase hr̥dā,
3.278.28: pateyaṁ giriśr̥ṅgād vā viśeyaṁ vā hutāśanam,
rāmaṁ bhartāramutsr̥jya na tvahaṁ tvāṁ kathañcana ॥28॥
3.278.30: pidhāya karṇau sadvr̥ttaḥ prasthito yena rāghavaḥ,
sa rāmasya padaṁ gr̥hya prasasāra dhanurdharaḥ ॥30॥
3.278.35: mama laṅkāpurī nāmnā ramyā pāre mahodadheḥ ॥35॥
3.278.36: tatra tvaṁ naranārīṣu śobhiṣyasi mayā saha,
bhāryā me bhava suśroṇi tāpasaṁ tyaja rāghavam ॥36॥
3.278.40: kathaṁ hi pītvā mādhvīkaṁ pītvā ca madhumādhavīm,
3.278.41: iti sā taṁ samābhāṣya praviveśāśramaṁ tataḥ,
3.278.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi mārīcavadhe sītāharaṇe ca aṣṭasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥278॥
3.279.2: sa dadarśa tadā sītāṁ rāvaṇāṅkagatāṁ snuṣām,
3.279.4: na hi me mokṣyase jīvan yadi notsr̥jase vadhūm,
3.279.8: saro vā sarito vāpi tatra muñcati bhūṣaṇam ॥8॥
3.279.13: evaṁ hr̥tāyāṁ vaidehyāṁ rāmo hatvā mahāmr̥gam,
nivr̥tto dadr̥śe dhīmān bhrātaraṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ tathā ॥13॥
3.279.14: iti taṁ bhrātaraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā prāpto’sīti vyagarhayat ॥14॥
3.279.16: api jīvati vaidehī neti paśyāmi lakṣmaṇa ॥16॥
3.279.17: tasya tat sarvamācakhyau sītāyā lakṣmaṇo vacaḥ,
3.279.18: sa dadarśa tadā gr̥dhraṁ nihataṁ parvatopamam ॥18॥
3.279.20: gr̥dhrarājo’smi bhadraṁ vāṁ sakhā daśarathasya vai ॥20॥
3.279.21: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā saṅgr̥hya dhanuṣī śubhe,
3.279.22: tayoḥ śaśaṁsa gr̥dhrastu sītārthe rāvaṇād vadham ॥22॥
3.279.23: apr̥cchad rāghavo gr̥dhraṁ rāvaṇaḥ kāṁ diśaṁ gataḥ,
3.279.27: vane mahati tasmiṁstu rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha,
3.279.28: śabdaṁ ca ghoraṁ sattvānāṁ dāvāgneriva vardhataḥ,
3.279.30: yadr̥cchayātha tad rakṣaḥ kare jagrāha lakṣmaṇam,
3.279.33: nāhaṁ tvāṁ saha vaidehyā sametaṁ kosalāgatam,
3.279.35: evaṁ bahuvidhaṁ dhīmān vilalāpa sa lakṣmaṇaḥ,
3.279.36: mā viṣīda naravyāghra naiṣa kaścinmayi sthite,
chindhyasya dakṣiṇaṁ bāhuṁ chinnaḥ savyo mayā bhujaḥ ॥36॥
3.279.37: ityevaṁ vadatā tasya bhujo rāmeṇa pātitaḥ,
3.279.39: punarjaghāna pārśve vai tad rakṣo lakṣmaṇo bhr̥śam,
3.279.40: dadr̥śe divamāsthāya divi sūrya iva jvalan ॥40॥
3.279.41: papraccha rāmastaṁ vāgmī kastvaṁ prabrūhi pr̥cchataḥ,
3.279.46: tena tvaṁ saha saṅgamya duḥkhamūlaṁ nivedaya,
3.279.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi kabandhahanane ekonāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥279॥
3.280.2: sevyamāno vane tasmin jagāma manasā priyām ॥2॥
3.280.6: mayi śiṣye ca bhr̥tye ca sahāye ca samāśvasa ॥6॥
3.280.12: vānarāṇāṁ tu yat sītā hriyamāṇā vyapāsr̥jat ॥12॥
3.280.14: pratijajñe ca kākutsthaḥ samare vālino vadham,
3.280.15: ityuktvā samayaṁ kr̥tvā viśvāsya ca parasparam,
3.280.16: nāsya tanmamr̥ṣe vālī tārā taṁ pratyaṣedhayat ॥16॥
3.280.17: manye cāśrayavān prāpto na tvaṁ niṣkrāntumarhasi ॥17॥
3.280.18: provāca vacanaṁ vāgmī tāṁ vānarapatiḥ patiḥ ॥18॥
3.280.27: asakr̥t tvaṁ mayā pūrvaṁ nirjito jīvitapriyaḥ,
mukto jñātiriti jñātvā kā tvarā maraṇe punaḥ ॥27॥
3.280.28: ityuktaḥ prāha sugrīvo bhrātaraṁ hetumad vacaḥ,
3.280.29: hr̥tarājyasya me rājan hr̥tadārasya ca tvayā,
3.280.33: sugrīvasya tadā mālāṁ hanumān kaṇṭha āsajat ॥33॥
3.280.34: sa mālayā tadā vīraḥ śuśubhe kaṇṭhasaktayā,
3.280.35: kr̥tacihnaṁ tu sugrīvaṁ rāmo dr̥ṣṭvā mahādhanuḥ,
3.280.38: garhayitvā sa kākutsthaṁ papāta bhuvi mūrcchitaḥ,
3.280.40: rāmastu caturo māsān pr̥ṣṭhe mālyavataḥ śubhe,
3.280.50: āryāḥ khādata māṁ śīghraṁ na me lobho’sti jīvite,
3.280.52: iti jānīta satyaṁ me kriyatāṁ yadanantaram ॥52॥
3.280.54: gatāsu tāsu sarvāsu trijaṭā nāma rākṣasī,
3.280.55: sīte vakṣyāmi te kiñcid viśvāsaṁ kuru me sakhi,
bhayaṁ tvaṁ tyaja vāmoru śr̥ṇu cedaṁ vaco mama ॥55॥
3.280.56: sa rāmasya hitānveṣī tvadarthe hi sa māvadat ॥56॥
3.280.57: sītā madvacanād vācyā samāśvāsya prasādya ca,
bhartā te kuśalī rāmo lakṣmaṇānugato balī ॥57॥
3.280.59: mā ca te’stu bhayaṁ bhīru rāvaṇāllokagarhitāt,
3.280.60: śapto hyeṣa purā pāpo vadhūṁ rambhāṁ parāmr̥śan,
3.280.64: mayā vināśaliṅgāni svapne dr̥ṣṭāni tasya vai ॥64॥
3.280.65: asakr̥t kharayukte tu rathe nr̥tyanniva sthitaḥ ॥65॥
3.280.69: yaśasā pr̥thivīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ pūrayiṣyati te patiḥ ॥69॥
3.280.70: lakṣmaṇaśca mayā dr̥ṣṭo didhakṣuḥ sarvato diśam ॥70॥
3.280.71: asakr̥t tvaṁ mayā dr̥ṣṭā gacchantī diśamuttarām ॥71॥
3.280.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi trijaṭākr̥tasītāsāntvane aśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥280॥
3.281.8: prasādaṁ kuru tanvaṅgi kriyatāṁ parikarma te ॥8॥
3.281.10: santi me devakanyāśca gandharvāṇāṁ ca yoṣitaḥ,
3.281.11: caturdaśa piśācānāṁ koṭyo me vacane sthitāḥ,
3.281.12: tato me triguṇā yakṣā ye madvacanakāriṇaḥ,
3.281.16: bhāryā me bhava suśroṇi yathā mandodarī tathā ॥16॥
3.281.19: uvāca vākyaṁ taṁ kṣudraṁ vaidehī patidevatā,
3.281.20: tad bhadrasukha bhadraṁ te mānasaṁ vinivartyatām ॥20॥
3.281.21: na caivopayikī bhāryā mānuṣī kr̥paṇā tava ॥21॥
3.281.22: vivaśāṁ dharṣayitvā ca kāṁ tvaṁ prītimavāpsyasi,
3.281.23: na ca pālayase dharmaṁ lokapālasamaḥ katham,
3.281.24: dhaneśvaraṁ vyapadiśan kathaṁ tviha na lajjase,
3.281.25: śirodharāṁ ca tanvaṅgī mukhaṁ pracchādya vāsasā,
tasyā rudatyā bhāvinyā dīrghā veṇī susaṁyatā ॥25॥
3.281.26: dadr̥śe svasitā snigdhā kālī vyālīva mūrdhani,
śrutvā tad rāvaṇo vākyaṁ sītayoktaṁ suniṣṭhuram ॥26॥
3.281.28: kiṁ nu śakyaṁ mayā kartuṁ yat tvamadyāpi mānuṣam ॥28॥
3.281.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi sītārāvaṇasaṁvāde ekāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥281॥
3.282.1: vasan mālyavataḥ pr̥ṣṭhe dadr̥śe vimalaṁ nabhaḥ ॥1॥
3.282.2: sa dr̥ṣṭvā vimale vyomni nirmalaṁ śaśalakṣaṇam,
3.282.8: yo māmevaṅgato mūḍho na jānīte’dya lakṣmaṇa ॥8॥
3.282.11: tamādāyaiva kākutstha tvarāvān bhava mā ciram ॥11॥
3.282.13: sakrodha iti taṁ matvā rājā pratyudyayau hariḥ ॥13॥
3.282.15: sa tat sarvamaśeṣeṇa śrutvā prahvaḥ kr̥tāñjaliḥ ॥15॥
3.282.17: nāsmi lakṣmaṇa durmedhā nākr̥tajño na nirghr̥ṇaḥ,
śrūyatāṁ yaḥ prayatno me sītāparyeṣaṇe kr̥taḥ ॥17॥
3.282.18: diśaḥ prasthāpitāḥ sarve vinītā harayo mayā,
sarveṣāṁ ca kr̥taḥ kālo māsenāgamanaṁ punaḥ ॥18॥
3.282.20: tataḥ śroṣyasi rāmeṇa sahitaḥ sumahat priyam ॥20॥
3.282.23: diśastisro vicityātha na tu ye dakṣiṇāṁ gatāḥ ॥23॥
3.282.24: vicitāṁ na tu vaidehyā darśanaṁ rāvaṇasya vā ॥24॥
3.282.27: rakṣitaṁ vālinā yat tat sphītaṁ madhuvanaṁ mahat,
tvayā ca plavagaśreṣṭha tad bhuṅkte pavanātmajaḥ ॥27॥
3.282.30: sa tad rāmāya medhāvī śaśaṁsa plavagarṣabhaḥ,
3.282.32: gatiṁ ca mukhavarṇaṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvā rāmo hanūmataḥ,
agamat pratyayaṁ bhūyo dr̥ṣṭā sīteti bhārata ॥32॥
3.282.37: priyamākhyāmi te rāma dr̥ṣṭā sā jānakī mayā ॥37॥
3.282.38: śrāntāḥ kāle vyatīte sma dr̥ṣṭavanto mahāguhām ॥38॥
3.282.41: mayasya kila daityasya tadāsīd veśma rāghava,
3.282.42: tayā dattāni bhojyāni pānāni vividhāni ca,
3.282.44: viṣaṇṇā vyathitāḥ khinnā nirāśā jīvite bhr̥śam ॥44॥
3.282.48: bhoḥ ka eṣa mama bhrāturjaṭāyoḥ kurute kathām ॥48॥
3.282.50: tato dagdhāvimau pakṣau na dagdhau tu jaṭāyuṣaḥ,
tadā me ciradr̥ṣṭaḥ sa bhrātā gr̥dhrapatiḥ priyaḥ ॥50॥
3.282.53: kaḥ sa rāmaḥ kathaṁ sītā jaṭāyuśca kathaṁ hataḥ ॥53॥
3.282.56: rāvaṇo vidito mahyaṁ laṅkā cāsya mahāpurī,
3.282.57: bhavitrī tatra vaidehī na me’styatra vicāraṇā,
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā vayamutthāya satvataḥ ॥57॥
3.282.60: tatra sītā mayā dr̥ṣṭā rāvaṇāntaḥpure satī,
3.282.64: kuśalaṁ tvābravīd rāmaḥ sīte saumitriṇā saha ॥64॥
3.282.66: pratyayaṁ kuru me devi vānaro’smi na rākṣasaḥ,
muhūrtamiva ca dhyātvā sītā māṁ pratyuvāca ha ॥66॥
3.282.68: gamyatāmiti coktvā māṁ sītā prādādimaṁ maṇim ॥68॥
3.282.71: grāhayitvāhamātmānaṁ tato dagdhvā ca tāṁ purīm,
3.282.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi hanumatpratyāgamane dvyaśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥282॥
3.283.3: koṭīśatavr̥to vāpi gajo gavaya eva ca,
3.283.6: koṭīrdaśa dvādaśa ca triṁśat pañca prakarṣati ॥6॥
3.283.24: upāyaḥ ko nu bhavatāṁ mataḥ sāgaralaṅghane,
3.283.25: samarthā laṅghane sindhorna tu tat kr̥tsnakārakam ॥25॥
3.283.26: neti rāmastu tān sarvān sāntvayan pratyabhāṣata ॥26॥
3.283.27: krāntuṁ toyanidhiṁ vīrā naiṣā vo naiṣṭhikī matiḥ ॥27॥
3.283.28: nāvo na santi senāyā bahvyastārayituṁ tathā,
3.283.29: vistīrṇaṁ caiva naḥ sainyaṁ hanyācchidreṇa vai paraḥ,
3.283.31: na ced darśayitā mārgaṁ dhakṣyāmyenamahaṁ tataḥ,
3.283.35: brūhi kiṁ te karomyatra sāhāyyaṁ puruṣarṣabha,
3.283.37: yadyevaṁ yācato mārgaṁ na pradāsyati me bhavān,
3.283.39: śr̥ṇu cedaṁ vaco rāma śrutvā kartavyamācara ॥39॥
3.283.40: yadi dāsyāmi te mārgaṁ sainyasya vrajato’’jñayā,
3.283.41: asti tvatra nalo nāma vānaraḥ śilpisammataḥ,
3.283.42: sa yat kāṣṭhaṁ tr̥ṇaṁ vāpi śilāṁ vā kṣepsyate mayi,
sarvaṁ tad dhārayiṣyāmi sa te seturbhaviṣyati ॥42॥
3.283.43: kuru setuṁ samudre tvaṁ śakto hyasi mato mama ॥43॥
3.283.46: tatrasthaṁ sa tu dharmātmā samāgacchad vibhīṣaṇaḥ,
bhrātā vai rākṣasendrasya caturbhiḥ sacivaiḥ saha ॥46॥
3.283.47: sugrīvasya tu śaṅkābhūt praṇidhiḥ syāditi sma ha ॥47॥
3.283.49: cakre ca mantrasacivaṁ suhr̥daṁ lakṣmaṇasya ca ॥49॥
3.283.53: pratipannau yadā rūpaṁ rākṣasaṁ tau niśācarau,
3.283.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi setubandhane tryaśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥283॥
3.284.10: āha tvāṁ rāghavo rājan kosalendro mahāyaśāḥ,
3.284.15: paśya me dhanuṣo vīryaṁ mānuṣasya niśācara ॥15॥
3.284.16: mucyatāṁ jānakī sītā na me mokṣyasi karhicit,
3.284.17: iti tasya bruvāṇasya dūtasya paruṣaṁ vacaḥ,
śrutvā na mamr̥ṣe rājā rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ॥17॥
3.284.38: hatā nipatitā bhūmau na muñcanti parasparam ॥38॥
3.284.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi laṅkāpraveśe caturaśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥284॥
3.285.2: parvaṇaḥ patano jambhaḥ kharaḥ krodhavaśo hariḥ,
3.285.8: sametya yuyudhe tatra tato rāmeṇa rāvaṇaḥ,
3.285.9: tuṇḍena ca nalastatra paṭuśaḥ panasena ca ॥9॥
3.285.10: viṣahyaṁ yaṁ hi yo mene sa sa tena sameyivān,
3.285.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi rāmarāvaṇadvandvayuddhe pañcāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥285॥
3.286.5: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nihataṁ saṅkhye prahastaṁ kṣaṇadācaram,
3.286.18: śrutvā tu rāvaṇastebhyaḥ prahastaṁ nihataṁ yudhi,
3.286.23: ya idaṁ dāruṇākāraṁ na jānīṣe mahābhayam,
eṣa tīrtvārṇavaṁ rāmaḥ setunā haribhiḥ saha ॥23॥
3.286.24: avamanyeha naḥ sarvān karoti kadanaṁ mahat,
mayā tvapahr̥tā bhāryā sītā nāmāsya jānakī ॥24॥
3.286.25: tāṁ netuṁ sa ihāyāto baddhvā setuṁ mahārṇave,
tena caiva prahastādirmahān naḥ svajano hataḥ ॥25॥
3.286.29: tathetyuktvā tu tau vīrau rāvaṇaṁ dūṣaṇānujau,
3.286.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi kumbhakarṇanirgamane ṣaḍaśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥286॥
3.287.6: balaṁ caṇḍabalākhyaṁ ca vajrabāhuṁ ca bānaram,
tad dr̥ṣṭvā vyathanaṁ karma kumbhakarṇasya rakṣasaḥ ॥6॥
3.287.10: bibheda śālaṁ sugrīvo na caivāvyathayat kapiḥ,
3.287.13: sa tasya dehāvaraṇaṁ bhittvā dehaṁ ca sāyakaḥ ॥13॥
3.287.20: gatāsuṁ patitaṁ bhūmau rākṣasāḥ prādravan bhayāt ॥20॥
3.287.21: tathā tān dravato yodhān dr̥ṣṭvā tau dūṣaṇānujau,
3.287.24: tau cāpi vīrau saṅkruddhāvubhau taṁ samavarṣatām ॥24॥
3.287.29: nairr̥tāstatra vadhyante prāyeṇa na tu vānarāḥ ॥29॥
3.287.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi kumbhakarṇādivadhe saptāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥287॥
3.288.1: tataḥ śrutvā hataṁ saṅkhye kumbhakarṇaṁ sahānugam,
3.288.3: tvayā hi mama satputra yaśo dīptamupārjitam,
3.288.6: kharasyāpacitiḥ saṅkhye tāṁ gaccha tvaṁ mahābhuja ॥6॥
3.288.7: pratinandaya māṁ putra purā jitveva vāsavam ॥7॥
3.288.16: prahartumaicchat taṁ cāsya prāsaṁ ciccheda lakṣmaṇaḥ,
3.288.17: tamacintya prahāraṁ sa balavān vālinaḥ sutaḥ ॥17॥
3.288.19: tato hatāśvāt praskandya rathāt sa hatasārathiḥ ॥19॥
3.288.20: antarhitaṁ viditvā taṁ bahumāyaṁ ca rākṣasam ॥20॥
3.288.25: tāṁśca tau cāpyadr̥śyaḥ sa śarairvivyādha rākṣasaḥ ॥25॥
3.288.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi indrajidyuddhe aṣṭāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥288॥
3.289.3: tau dr̥ṣṭvā patitau bhūmau śataśaḥ sāyakaiścitau,
sugrīvaḥ kapibhiḥ sārdhaṁ parivārya tataḥ sthitaḥ ॥3॥
3.289.6: viśalyau cāpi sugrīvaḥ kṣaṇenaitau cakāra ha,
3.289.11: bhavān drakṣyati yasmai ca pradāsyati naraḥ sa tu ॥11॥
3.289.15: indrajit kr̥takarmā ca pitre karma tadā’’tmanaḥ,
3.289.26: sa putraṁ nihataṁ jñātvā trāsāt sambhrāntamānasaḥ,
3.289.29: mahārājye sthito dīpte na striyaṁ hantumarhasi,
hataivaiṣā yadā strī ca bandhanasthā ca te vaśe ॥29॥
3.289.30: na caiṣā dehabhedena hatā syāditi me matiḥ,
jahi bhartāramevāsyā hate tasmin hatā bhavet ॥30॥
3.289.31: na hi te vikrame tulyaḥ sākṣādapi śatakratuḥ,
3.289.32: kruddhaṁ saṁśamayāmāsa jagr̥he ca sa tadvacaḥ ॥32॥
3.289.33: niryāṇe sa matiṁ kr̥tvā nidhāyāsiṁ kṣapācaraḥ,
3.289.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi śrīrāmopākhyānaparvaṇi indrajidvadhe ekonanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥289॥
3.290.1: tataḥ kruddho daśagrīvaḥ priye putre nipātite,
3.290.7: tān rāmo jaghnivāt sarvān divyenāstreṇa rākṣasān,
atha bhūyo’pi māyāṁ sa vyadadhād rākṣasādhipaḥ ॥7॥
3.290.8: kr̥tvā rāmasya rūpāṇi lakṣmaṇasya ca bhārata,
abhidudrāva rāmaṁ ca lakṣmaṇaṁ ca daśānanaḥ ॥8॥
3.290.15: syandanena jahi kṣipraṁ rāvaṇaṁ mā ciraṁ kr̥thāḥ,
3.290.22: tad dr̥ṣṭvā duṣkaraṁ karma rāvaṇaṁ bhayamāviśat,
3.290.24: tāṁ māyāṁ vikr̥tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ ॥24॥
3.290.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi rāvaṇavadhe navatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥290॥
3.291.1: sa hatvā rāvaṇaṁ kṣudraṁ rākṣasendraṁ suradviṣam,
babhūva hr̥ṣṭaḥ sasuhr̥d rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha ॥1॥
3.291.5: tato hatvā daśagrīvaṁ laṅkāṁ rāmo mahāyaśāḥ,
3.291.10: gaccha vaidehi muktā tvaṁ yat kāryaṁ tanmayā kr̥tam ॥10॥
3.291.11: māmāsādya patiṁ bhadre na tvaṁ rākṣasaveśmani,
jarāṁ vrajethā iti me nihato’sau niśācaraḥ ॥11॥
3.291.14: tataḥ sā sahasā bālā tacchrutvā dāruṇaṁ vacaḥ,
papāta devī vyathitā nikr̥ttā kadalī yathā ॥14॥
3.291.15: kṣaṇena sa punarnaṣṭo niḥśvāsa iva darpaṇe ॥15॥
3.291.18: śakraścāgniśca vāyuśca yamo varuṇa eva ca,
3.291.21: tata utthāya vaidehī teṣāṁ madhye yaśasvinī,
3.291.22: rājaputra na te doṣaṁ karomi viditā hi te,
gatiḥ strīṇāṁ narāṇāṁ ca śr̥ṇu cedaṁ vaco mama ॥22॥
3.291.23: sa me vimuñcatu prāṇān yadi pāpaṁ carāmyaham ॥23॥
3.291.24: vimuñcantu mama prāṇān yadi pāpaṁ carāmyaham ॥24॥
3.291.27: bho bho rāghava satyaṁ vai vāyurasmi sadāgatiḥ,
apāpā maithilī rājan saṅgaccha saha bhāryayā ॥27॥
3.291.29: rasā vai matprasūtā hi bhūtadeheṣu rāghava,
ahaṁ vai tvāṁ prabravīmi maithilī pratigr̥hyatām ॥29॥
3.291.30: sādho sadvr̥tta kākutstha śr̥ṇu cedaṁ vaco mama ॥30॥
3.291.31: yakṣāṇāṁ dānavānāṁ ca maharṣīṇāṁ ca pātitaḥ ॥31॥
3.291.35: nātra śaṅkā tvayā kāryā pratīcchemāṁ mahādyute,
3.291.36: prīto’smi vatsa bhadraṁ te pitā daśaratho’smi te,
3.291.37: abhivādaye tvāṁ rājendra yadi tvaṁ janako mama,
3.291.40: mahendra iva paulomyā bhāryayā sa sameyivān,
tato varaṁ dadau tasmai hyavindhyāya parantapaḥ ॥40॥
3.291.43: tataste brahmaṇā prokte tatheti vacane tadā ॥43॥
3.291.44: sītā cāpi mahābhāgā varaṁ hanumate dadau ॥44॥
3.291.45: rāmakīrtyā samaṁ putra jīvitaṁ te bhaviṣyati,
3.291.47: dr̥ṣṭvā rāmaṁ tu jānakyā saṅgataṁ śakrasārathiḥ ॥47॥
3.291.51: tataḥ sītāṁ puraskr̥tya rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha ॥51॥
3.291.54: tatastīre samudrasya yatra śiśye sa pārthivaḥ ॥54॥
3.291.58: kiṣkindhāṁ tu samāsādya rāmaḥ praharatāṁ varaḥ ॥58॥
3.291.61: lakṣayitveṅgitaṁ sarvaṁ priyaṁ tasmai nivedya vai ॥61॥
3.291.69: puṣpakaṁ ca vimānaṁ tat pūjayitvā sa rāghavaḥ,
3.291.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi śrīrāmābhiṣeke ekanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥291॥
3.292.3: na hi te vr̥jinaṁ kiñcid vartate paramaṇvapi,
asmin mārge niṣīdeyuḥ sendrā api surasurāḥ ॥3॥
3.292.5: kiṁ nu tasyājitaṁ saṅkhye yasya bhrātā dhanañjayaḥ ॥5॥
3.292.6: ayaṁ ca balināṁ śreṣṭho bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ,
3.292.7: ebhiḥ sahāyaiḥ kasmāt tvaṁ viṣīdasi parantapa,
ya ime vajriṇaḥ senāṁ jayeyuḥ samarudgaṇām ॥7॥
3.292.10: ānītāṁ draupadīṁ kr̥ṣṇāṁ kr̥tvā karma suduṣkaram,
3.292.13: tasmāt sa tvaṁ kuruśreṣṭha mā śuco bharatarṣabha,
tvadvidhā hi mahātmāno na śocanti parantapa ॥13॥
3.292.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyānaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirāśvāsane dvinavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥292॥
3.293.2: dyūte durātmabhiḥ kliṣṭāḥ kr̥ṣṇayā tāritā vayam,
3.293.3: asti sīmantinī kācid dr̥ṣṭapūrvāpi vā śrutā,
3.293.9: ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe tadā kāle babhūva mitabhojanaḥ ॥9॥
3.293.11: rūpiṇī tu tadā rājan darśayāmāsa taṁ nr̥pam,
uvāca cainaṁ varadā vacanaṁ pārthivaṁ tadā ॥11॥
3.293.11d1: sā tamaśvapatiṁ rājan sāvitrī niyame sthitam.
3.293.12: sarvātmanā ca bhaktyā ca tuṣṭāsmi tava pārthiva ॥12॥
3.293.14: putrā me bahavo devi bhaveyuḥ kulabhāvanāḥ ॥14॥
3.293.15: tuṣṭāsi yadi me devi varametaṁ vr̥ṇomyaham,
3.293.18: uttaraṁ ca na te kiñcid vyāhartavyaṁ kathañcana,
3.293.19: sa tatheti pratijñāya sāvitryā vacanaṁ nr̥paḥ,
3.293.20: svarājye cāvasad vīraḥ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥20॥
3.293.21: kasmiṁścit tu gate kāle sa rājā niyatavrataḥ,
3.293.23: prāpte kāle tu suṣuve kanyāṁ rājīvalocanām,
3.293.24: sāvitryā prītayā dattā sāvitryā hutayā hyapi,
3.293.25: kālena cāpi sā kanyā yauvanasthā babhūva ha ॥25॥
3.293.30: sābhivādya pituḥ pādau śeṣāḥ pūrvaṁ nivedya ca,
3.293.31: yauvanasthāṁ tu tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā svāṁ sutāṁ devarūpiṇīm,
3.293.32: putri pradānakālaste na ca kaścid vr̥ṇoti mām,
3.293.33: prārthitaḥ puruṣo yaśca sa nivedyastvayā mama,
3.293.34: tathā tvamapi kalyāṇi gadato me vacaḥ śr̥ṇu ॥34॥
3.293.36: idaṁ me vacanaṁ śrutvā bharturanveṣaṇe tvara,
devatānāṁ yathā vācyo na bhaveyaṁ tathā kuru ॥36॥
3.293.41: kurvatī dvijamukhyānāṁ taṁ taṁ deśaṁ jagāma ha ॥41॥
3.293.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi pativratāmāhātmyaparvaṇi sāvitryupākhyāne trinavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥293॥
3.294.3: nāradena sahāsīnaṁ sā dr̥ṣṭvā pitaraṁ śubhā,
3.294.4: kva gatābhūt suteyaṁ te kutaścaivāgatā nr̥pa,
kimarthaṁ yuvatīṁ bhartre na caināṁ samprayacchasi ॥4॥
3.294.5: etasyāḥ śr̥ṇu devarṣe bhartāraṁ yo’nayā vr̥taḥ ॥5॥
3.294.6: sā brūhi vistareṇeti pitrā sañcoditā śubhā,
3.294.7: dyumatsena iti khyātaḥ paścāccāndho babhūva ha ॥7॥
3.294.9: sa bālavatsayā sārdhaṁ bhāryayā prasthito vanam,
3.294.10: tasya putraḥ pure jātaḥ saṁvr̥ddhaśca tapovane,
3.294.11: aho bata mahat pāpaṁ sāvitryā nr̥pate kr̥tam,
3.294.12: satyaṁ vadatyasya pitā satyaṁ mātā prabhāṣate,
3.294.14: apīdānīṁ sa tejasvī buddhimān vā nr̥pātmajaḥ,
3.294.19: sa dāntaḥ sa mr̥duḥ śūraḥ sa satyaḥ saṁyatendriyaḥ,
sa maitraḥ so’nasūyaśca sa hrīmān dyutimāṁśca saḥ ॥19॥
3.294.21: doṣānapyasya me brūhi yadi santīha kecana ॥21॥
3.294.22: eka evāsya doṣo hi guṇānākramya tiṣṭhati,
sa ca doṣaḥ prayatnena na śakyamativartitum ॥22॥
3.294.24: ehi sāvitri gacchasva anyaṁ varaya śobhane,
tasya doṣo mahāneko guṇānākramya ca sthitaḥ ॥24॥
3.294.27: sakr̥d vr̥to mayā bhartā na dvitīyaṁ vr̥ṇomyaham ॥27॥
3.294.28: kriyate karmaṇā paścāt pramāṇaṁ me manastataḥ ॥28॥
3.294.30: nānyasmin puruṣe santi ye satyavati vai guṇāḥ,
3.294.31: avicālyaṁ taduktaṁ yat tathyaṁ bhagavatā vacaḥ,
3.294.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi pativratāmāhātmyaparvaṇi sāvitryupākhyāne caturnavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥294॥
3.295.1: samāninye ca tat sarvaṁ bhāṇḍaṁ vaivāhikaṁ nr̥paḥ ॥1॥
3.295.2: samāhūya dine puṇye prayayau saha kanyayā ॥2॥
3.295.3: medhyāraṇyaṁ sa gatvā ca dyumatsenāśramaṁ nr̥paḥ,
3.295.4: kauśyāṁ br̥syāṁ samāsīnaṁ cakṣurhīnaṁ nr̥paṁ tadā ॥4॥
3.295.5: sa rājā tasya rājarṣeḥ kr̥tvā pūjāṁ yathārhataḥ,
3.295.6: tasyārghyamāsanaṁ caiva gāṁ cāvedya sa dharmavit,
3.295.8: sāvitrī nāma rājarṣe kanyeyaṁ mama śobhanā,
tāṁ svadharmeṇa dharmajña snuṣārthe tvaṁ gr̥hāṇa me ॥8॥
3.295.11: āśāṁ nārhasi me hantuṁ sauhr̥dāt praṇatasya ca,
3.295.12: anurūpo hi yuktaśca tvaṁ mamāhaṁ tavāpi ca,
snuṣāṁ pratīccha me kanyāṁ bhāryāṁ satyavataḥ sataḥ ॥12॥
3.295.14: sa nirvartatu me’dyaiva kāṅkṣito hyasi me’tithiḥ ॥14॥
3.295.16: yayau svameva bhavanaṁ yuktaḥ paramayā mudā ॥16॥
3.295.17: mumude sā ca taṁ labdhvā bhartāraṁ manasepsitam ॥17॥
3.295.22: evaṁ tatrāśrame teṣāṁ tadā nivasatāṁ satām,
3.295.23: nāradena yaduktaṁ tad vākyaṁ manasi vartate ॥23॥
3.295.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi pativratāmāhātmyaparvaṇi sāvitryupākhyāne pañcanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥295॥
3.296.1: prāptaḥ sa kālo martavyaṁ yatra satyavatā nr̥pa ॥1॥
3.296.2: yad vākyaṁ nāradenoktaṁ vartate hr̥di nityaśaḥ ॥2॥
3.296.4: taṁ śrutvā niyamaṁ tasyā bhr̥śaṁ duḥkhānvito nr̥paḥ,
3.296.7: vrataṁ bhindhīti vaktuṁ tvāṁ nāsmi śaktaḥ kathañcana,
3.296.10: adya tad divasaṁ ceti hutvā dīptaṁ hutāśanam,
3.296.11: tataḥ sarvān dvijān vr̥ddhān śvaśrūṁ śvaśurameva ca,
3.296.13: manasā tā giraḥ sarvā pratyagr̥hṇāt tapasvinām ॥13॥
3.296.14: taṁ kālaṁ taṁ muhūrtaṁ ca pratīkṣantī nr̥pātmajā,
3.296.16: vrataṁ yathopadiṣṭaṁ tu tathā tat pāritaṁ tvayā,
3.296.17: eṣa me hr̥di saṅkalpaḥ samayaśca kr̥to mayā ॥17॥
3.296.19: saha tvayā gamiṣyāmi na hi tvāṁ hātumutsahe ॥19॥
3.296.20: vanaṁ na gatapūrvaṁ te duḥkhaḥ panthāśca bhāvini,
3.296.21: gamane ca kr̥totsāhāṁ pratiṣeddhuṁ na mārhasi ॥21॥
3.296.22: yadi te gamanotsāhaḥ kariṣyāmi tava priyam,
mama tvāmantraya gurūn na māṁ doṣaḥ spr̥śedayam ॥22॥
3.296.23: ayaṁ gacchati me bhartā phalāhāro mahāvanam ॥23॥
3.296.24: anena saha nirgantuṁ na me’dya virahaḥ kṣamaḥ ॥24॥
3.296.25: na nivāryo nivāryaḥ syādanyathā prasthito vanam ॥25॥
3.296.26: vanaṁ kusumitaṁ draṣṭuṁ paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥26॥
3.296.27: yataḥ prabhr̥ti sāvitrī pitrā dattā snuṣā mama,
3.296.32: mr̥tameva hi bhartāraṁ kāle munivacaḥ smaran ॥32॥
3.296.33: dvidheva hr̥dayaṁ kr̥tvā taṁ ca kālamavekṣatī ॥33॥
3.296.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi pativratāmāhātmyaparvaṇi sāvitryupākhyāne ṣaṇṇavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥296॥
3.297.2: tasya pāṭayataḥ kāṣṭhaṁ svedo vai samajāyata,
vyāyāmena ca tenāsya jajñe śirasi vedanā ॥2॥
3.297.4: aṅgāni caiva sāvitri hr̥dayaṁ dūyatīva ca,
3.297.5: tat svaptumicche kalyāṇi na sthātuṁ śaktirasti me ॥5॥
3.297.7: taṁ muhūrtaṁ kṣaṇaṁ velāṁ divasaṁ ca yuyoja ha ॥7॥
3.297.9: sthitaṁ satyavataḥ pārśve nirīkṣantaṁ tameva ca ॥9॥
3.297.10: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sahasotthāya bharturnyasya śanaiḥ śiraḥ,
3.297.11: kāmayā brūhi deveśa kastvaṁ kiṁ cikīrṣasi ॥11॥
3.297.12: atastvāmabhibhāṣāmi viddhi māṁ tvaṁ śubhe yamam ॥12॥
3.297.13: ayaṁ te satyavān bhartā kṣīṇāyuḥ pārthivātmajaḥ,
3.297.14: netuṁ kila bhavān kasmādāgato’si svayaṁ prabho ॥14॥
3.297.17: tataḥ satyavataḥ kāyāt pāśabaddhaṁ vaśaṁ gatam,
3.297.19: yamastu taṁ tato baddhvā prayāto dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ,
3.297.20: kr̥taṁ bhartustvayā’’nr̥ṇyaṁ yāvad gamyaṁ gataṁ tvayā ॥20॥
3.297.21: yatra me nīyate bhartā svayaṁ vā yatra gacchati,
mayā ca tatra gantavyameṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥21॥
3.297.22: tapasā gurubhaktyā ca bhartuḥ snehād vratena ca,
tava caiva prasādena na me pratihatā gatiḥ ॥22॥
3.297.23: mitratāṁ ca puraskr̥tya kiñcid vakṣyāmi tacchr̥ṇu ॥23॥
3.297.24: dharmaṁ ca vāsaṁ ca pariśramaṁ ca,
3.297.25: mā vai dvitīyaṁ mā tr̥tīyaṁ ca vāñche
3.297.28: nivarta gacchasva na te śramo bhavet ॥28॥
3.297.29: yato hi bhartā mama sā gatirdhruvā,
yataḥ patiṁ neṣyasi tatra me gatiḥ
3.297.32: jahyāt svadharmaṁ na ca me gururyathā
3.297.33: nivarta gacchasva na te śramo bhavet ॥33॥
3.297.35: anugrahaśca dānaṁ ca satāṁ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥35॥
3.297.42: ātmanyapi na viśvāsastathā bhavati satsu yaḥ,
3.297.43: tasmāt satsu viśeṣeṇa viśvāsaṁ kurute janaḥ ॥43॥
3.297.44: śubhe na tādr̥k tvadr̥te śrutaṁ mayā,
3.297.47: santo na sīdanti na ca vyathanti,
3.297.54: tvayaiva datto hriyate ca me patiḥ,
3.297.55: tathetyuktvā tu taṁ pāśa muktvā vaivasvato yamaḥ,
3.297.56: eṣa bhadre mayā mukto bhartā te kulanandini,
3.297.57: iṣṭvā yajñaiśca dharmeṇa khyātiṁ loke gamiṣyati ॥57॥
3.297.58: te cāpi sarve rājānaḥ kṣatriyāḥ putrapautriṇaḥ ॥58॥
3.297.59: pituśca te putraśataṁ bhavitā tava mātari ॥59॥
3.297.61: evaṁ tasyai varaṁ dattvā dharmarājaḥ pratāpavān,
3.297.62: sāvitryapi yame yāte bhartāraṁ pratilabhya ca,
jagāma tatra yatrāsyā bhartuḥ śāvaṁ kalevaram ॥62॥
3.297.64: proṣyāgata iva premṇā punaḥ punarudīkṣya vai ॥64॥
3.297.65: kva cāsau puruṣaḥ śyāmo yo’sau māṁ sañcakarṣa ha ॥65॥
3.297.66: gataḥ sa bhagavān devaḥ prajāsaṁyamano yamaḥ ॥66॥
3.297.67: yadi śakyaṁ samuttiṣṭha vigāḍhāṁ paśya śarvarīm ॥67॥
3.297.69: tataḥ pāṭayataḥ kāṣṭhaṁ śiraso me rujābhavat ॥69॥
3.297.70: tavotsaṅge prasupto’smi iti sarvaṁ smare śubhe ॥70॥
3.297.71: tato’paśyaṁ tamo ghoraṁ puruṣaṁ ca mahaujasam ॥71॥
3.297.72: tad yadi tvaṁ vijānāsi kiṁ tad brūhi sumadhyame,
svapno me yadi vā dr̥ṣṭo yadi vā satyameva tat ॥72॥
3.297.74: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṁ te pitarau paśya suvrata,
3.297.76: etā ghoraṁ śivā nādān diśaṁ dakṣiṇapaścimām,
3.297.77: na vijñāsyasi panthānaṁ gantuṁ caiva na śakṣyasi ॥77॥
3.297.78: asminnadya vane dagdhe śuṣkavr̥kṣaḥ sthito jvalan,
3.297.80: yadi notsahase gantuṁ sarujaṁ tvāṁ hi lakṣaye,
na ca jñāsyasi panthānaṁ tamasā saṁvr̥te vane ॥80॥
3.297.81: śvaḥ prabhāte vane dr̥śye yāsyāvo’numate tava,
3.297.83: na kadācid vikālaṁ hi gatapūrvo mayā’’śramaḥ,
anāgatāyāṁ sandhyāyāṁ mātā me praruṇaddhi mām ॥83॥
3.297.84: divāpi mayi niṣkrānte santapyete gurū mama,
3.297.85: mātrā pitrā ca subhr̥śaṁ duḥkhitābhyāmahaṁ purā,
3.297.86: tayoradr̥śye mayi ca mahad duḥkhaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥86॥
3.297.88: tvayā hīnau na jīvāva muhūrtamapi putraka,
yāvad dhariṣyase putra tāvannau jīvitaṁ dhruvam ॥88॥
3.297.96: tayoḥ priyaṁ me kartavyamiti jānāmi cāpyaham,
3.297.97: ucchritya bāhū duḥkhārtaḥ susvaraṁ praruroda ha,
3.297.98: yadi me’sti tapastaptaṁ yadi dattaṁ hutaṁ yadi ॥98॥
3.297.100: tena satyena tāvadya dhriyetāṁ śvaśurau mama,
kāmaye darśanaṁ pitroryāhi sāvitri mā ciram ॥100॥
3.297.100d1: api nāma gurū tau hi paśyeyaṁ prīyamāṇakau,
3.297.101: purā mātuḥ piturvāpi yadi paśyāmi vipriyam,
3.297.102: yadi dharme ca te buddhirmāṁ cejjīvantamicchasi,
3.297.103: sāvitrī tata utthāya keśān saṁyamya bhāvinī,
3.297.107: vāme skandhe tu vāmorūrbharturbāhuṁ niveśya ca,
3.297.109: āgatau svaḥ pathā yena phalānyavacitāni ca,
yathāgataṁ śubhe gaccha panthānaṁ mā vicāraya ॥109॥
3.297.110: tasyottareṇa yaḥ panthāstena gaccha tvarasva ca ॥110॥
3.297.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi pativratāmāhātmyaparvaṇi sāvitryupākhyāne saptanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥297॥
3.298.1: labdhacakṣuḥ prasannāyāṁ dr̥ṣṭyāṁ sarvaṁ dadarśa ha ॥1॥
3.298.2: sa sarvānāśramān gatvā śaibyayā saha bhāryayā,
3.298.3: tāvāśramān nadīścaiva vanāni ca sarāṁsi ca,
3.298.4: śrutvā śabdaṁ tu yaṁ kañcidunmukhau sutaśaṅkayā,
3.298.9: punaruktvā ca karuṇāṁ vācaṁ tau śokakarśitau,
hā putra hā sādhvi vadhūḥ kvāsi kvāsītyarodatām,
3.298.10: yathāsya bhāryā sāvitrī tapasā ca damena ca,
ācāreṇa ca saṁyuktā tathā jīvati satyavān ॥10॥
3.298.11: vedāḥ sāṅgā mayādhītāstapo me sañcitaṁ mahat,
3.298.14: upādhyāyasya me vaktrād yathā vākyaṁ viniḥsr̥tam,
naiva jātu bhavenmithyā tathā jīvati satyavān ॥14॥
3.298.16: yathāsya bhāryā sāvitrī tapasā ca damena ca,
ācāreṇa ca saṁyuktā tathā jīvati satyavān ॥16॥
3.298.17: yathā dr̥ṣṭiḥ pravr̥ttā te sāvitryāśca yathā vratam,
3.298.18: yathā vadanti śāntāyāṁ diśi vai mr̥gapakṣiṇaḥ,
pārthivī ca pravr̥ttiste tathā jīvati satyavān ॥18॥
3.298.21: tato muhūrtāt sāvitrī bhartrā satyavatā saha,
3.298.22: putreṇa saṅgataṁ tvāṁ tu cakṣuṣmantaṁ nirīkṣya ca,
sarve vayaṁ vai pr̥cchāmo vr̥ddhiṁ vai pr̥thivīpate ॥22॥
3.298.25: tato’gniṁ tatra sañjvālya dvijāste sarva eva hi,
3.298.26: śaibyā ca satyavāṁścaiva sāvitrī caikataḥ sthitāḥ,
3.298.27: tato rājñā sahāsīnāḥ sarve te vanavāsinaḥ,
3.298.28: prāgeva nāgataṁ kasmāt sabhāryeṇa tvayā vibho,
3.298.29: santāpitaḥ pitā mātā vayaṁ caiva nr̥pātmaja,
3.298.31: tāvat kālaṁ na ca mayā suptapūrvaṁ kadācana ॥31॥
3.298.33: nāsya tvaṁ kāraṇaṁ vetsi sāvitrī vaktumarhati ॥33॥
3.298.34: śrotumicchāmi sāvitri tvaṁ hi vettha parāvaram,
tvāṁ hi jānāmi sāvitri sāvitrīmiva tejasā ॥34॥
3.298.35: tvamatra hetuṁ jānīṣe tasmāt satyaṁ nirūcyatām,
rahasyaṁ yadi te nāsti kiñcidatra vadasva naḥ ॥35॥
3.298.36: evametad yathā vettha saṅkalpo nānyathā hi vaḥ,
na hi kiñcid rahasyaṁ me śrūyatāṁ tathyameva yat ॥36॥
3.298.37: sa cādya divasaḥ prāptastato nainaṁ jahāmyaham ॥37॥
3.298.39: astauṣaṁ tamahaṁ devaṁ satyena vacasā vibhum,
pañca vai tena me dattā varāḥ śr̥ṇuta tān mama ॥39॥
3.298.40: cakṣuṣī ca svarājyaṁ ca dvau varau śvaśurasya me,
labdhaṁ pituḥ putraśataṁ putrāṇāṁ cātmanaḥ śatam ॥40॥
3.298.41: bharturhi jīvitārthaṁ tu mayā cīrṇaṁ tvidaṁ vratam ॥41॥
3.298.42: etat sarvaṁ mayā’’khyātaṁ kāraṇaṁ vistareṇa vaḥ,
3.298.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi pativratāmāhātmyaparvaṇi sāvitryupākhyāne aṣṭanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥298॥
3.299.4: taṁ mantriṇā hataṁ śrutvā sasahāyaṁ sabāndhavam,
3.299.5: aikamatyaṁ ca sarvasya janasyātha nr̥paṁ prati,
3.299.6: prāptānīmāni yānāni caturaṅgaṁ ca te balam ॥6॥
3.299.7: prayāhi rājan bhadraṁ te ghuṣṭaste nagare jayaḥ,
3.299.8: cakṣuṣmantaṁ ca taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rājānaṁ vapuṣānvitam,
3.299.10: śaibyā ca saha sāvitryā svāstīrṇena suvarcasā,
3.299.14: evamātmā pitā mātā śvaśrūḥ śvaśura eva ca,
bhartuḥ kulaṁ ca sāvitryā sarvaṁ kr̥cchrāt samuddhr̥tam ॥14॥
3.299.16: viśoko vijvaro rājan kāmyake nyavasat tadā ॥16॥
3.299.17: sa sukhī sarvasiddhārtho na duḥkhaṁ prāpnuyānnaraḥ ॥17॥
3.299.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi pativratāmāhātmyaparvaṇi sāvitryupākhyāne navanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥299॥
3.300.1: yat tat tadā mahad bahmam̐llomaśo vākyamabravīt,
3.300.2: yaccāpi te bhayaṁ tīvraṁ na ca kīrtayase kvacit,
3.300.3: kiṁ nu tajjapatāṁ śreṣṭha karṇaṁ prati mahad bhayam,
āsīnna ca sa dharmātmā kathayāmāsa kasyacit ॥3॥
3.300.10: karṇa madvacanaṁ tāta śr̥ṇu satyabhr̥tāṁ vara,
3.300.12: viditaṁ tena śīlaṁ te sarvasya jagatastathā,
yathā tvaṁ bhikṣitaḥ sadbhirdadāsyeva na yācase ॥12॥
3.300.13: tvaṁ hi tāta dadāsyeva brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayācitam,
3.300.14: tvāṁ tu caivaṁvidhaṁ jñātvā svayaṁ vai pākaśāsanaḥ,
3.300.15: tasmai prayācamānāya na deye kuṇḍale tvayā,
anuneyaḥ paraṁ śaktyā śreya etaddhi te param ॥15॥
3.300.18: yadi dāsyasi karṇa tvaṁ sahaje kuṇḍale śubhe,
3.300.20: tasmād rakṣyaṁ tvayā karṇa jīvitaṁ cet priyaṁ tava ॥20॥
3.300.21: ko māmevaṁ bhavān prāha darśayan sauhr̥daṁ param,
kāmayā bhagavan brūhi ko bhavān dvijaveṣadhr̥k ॥21॥
3.300.22: ahaṁ tāta sahasrāṁśuḥ sauhr̥dāt tvāṁ nidarśaye,
kuruṣvaitad vaco me tvametacchreyaḥ paraṁ hi te ॥22॥
3.300.23: śreya eva mamātyantaṁ yasya me gopatiḥ prabhuḥ,
pravaktādya hitānveṣī śr̥ṇu cedaṁ vaco mama ॥23॥
3.300.24: na nivāryo vratādasmādahaṁ yadyasmi te priyaḥ ॥24॥
3.300.25: vrataṁ vai mama loko’yaṁ vetti kr̥tsnaṁ vibhāvaso,
3.300.27: na me kīrtiḥ praṇaśyeta triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā ॥27॥
3.300.28: madvidhasya yaśasyaṁ hi na yuktaṁ prāṇarakṣaṇam,
yuktaṁ hi yaśasā yuktaṁ maraṇaṁ lokasammatam ॥28॥
3.300.31: vr̥ṇomi kīrtiṁ loke hi jīvitenāpi bhānuman,
3.300.33: ayaṁ purāṇaḥ śloko hi svayaṁ gīto vibhāvaso,
3.300.35: so’haṁ śarīraje dattvā kīrtiṁ prāpsyāmi śāśvatīm,
dattvā ca vidhivad dānaṁ brāhmaṇebhyo yathāvidhi ॥35॥
3.300.36: hutvā śarīraṁ saṅgrāme kr̥tvā karma suduṣkaram,
vijitya ca parānājau yaśaḥ prāpsyāmi kevalam ॥36॥
3.300.38: jīvitenāpi me rakṣyā kīrtistad viddhi me vracam ॥38॥
3.300.39: brāhmaṇacchadmine deva loke gantā parāṁ gatim ॥39॥
3.300.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi kuṇḍalāharaṇaparvaṇi sūryakarṇasaṁvāde triśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥300॥
3.301.2: iṣyate yaśasaḥ prāptiḥ kīrtiśca tridive sthirā ॥2॥
3.301.3: sā te prāṇān samādāya gamiṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ॥3॥
3.301.4: jīvatāṁ kurute kāryaṁ pitā mātā sutāstathā,
3.301.6: mr̥tasya kīrtyā kiṁ kāryaṁ bhasmībhūtasya dehinaḥ,
mr̥taḥ kīrtiṁ na jānīte jīvan kīrtiṁ samaśnute ॥6॥
3.301.7: ahaṁ tu tvāṁ bravīmyetad bhakto’sīti hitepsayā ॥7॥
3.301.8: bhaktimanto hi me rakṣyā ityetenāpi hetunā,
mamāpi bhaktirutpannā sa tvaṁ kuru vaco mama ॥8॥
3.301.10: devaguhyaṁ tvayā jñātuṁ na śakyaṁ puruṣarṣabha,
tasmānnākhyāmi te guhyaṁ kāle vetsyati tad bhavān ॥10॥
3.301.11: punaruktaṁ ca vakṣyāmi tvaṁ rādheya nibodha tat,
māsmai te kuṇḍale dadyā bhikṣite vajrapāṇinā ॥11॥
3.301.13: kīrtiśca jīvataḥ sādhvī puruṣasyeti viddhi tat,
3.301.16: tvaṁ hi nityaṁ naravyāghra spardhase savyasācinā,
savyasācī tvayā ceha yudhi śūraḥ sameṣyati ॥16॥
3.301.17: na tu tvāmarjunaḥ śaktaḥ kuṇḍalābhyāṁ samanvitam,
vijetuṁ yudhi yadyasya svayamindraḥ sakhā bhavet ॥17॥
3.301.18: tasmānna deye śakrāya tvayaite kuṇḍale śubhe,
3.301.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi kuṇḍalāharaṇaparvaṇi sūryakarṇasaṁvāde ekādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥301॥
3.302.1: bhagavantamahaṁ bhakto yathā māṁ vettha gopate,
3.302.2: na me dārā na me putrā na cātmā suhr̥do na ca,
tatheṣṭā vai sadā bhaktyā yathā tvaṁ gopate mama ॥2॥
3.302.3: iṣṭānāṁ ca mahātmāno bhaktānāṁ ca na saṁśayaḥ,
kurvanti bhaktimiṣṭāṁ ca jānīṣe tvaṁ ca bhāskara ॥3॥
3.302.4: iṣṭo bhaktaśca me karṇo na cānyad daivataṁ divi,
jānīta iti vai kr̥tvā bhagavānāha maddhitam ॥4॥
3.302.5: bhūyaśca śirasā yāce prasādya ca punaḥ punaḥ,
iti bravīmi tigmāṁśo tvaṁ tu me kṣantumarhasi ॥5॥
3.302.7: yacca māmāttha deva tvaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ phālgunaṁ prati ॥7॥
3.302.8: vyetu santāpajaṁ duḥkhaṁ tava bhāskara mānasam,
3.302.11: yadi tāta dadāsyete vajriṇe kuṇḍale śubhe,
3.302.12: niyamena pradadyāṁ te kuṇḍale vai śatakrato,
3.302.13: prārthayāno raṇe vatsa kuṇḍale te jihīrṣati ॥13॥
3.302.15: dāsyāmi te sahasrākṣa kuṇḍale varma cottamam ॥15॥
3.302.16: ityeva niyamena tvaṁ dadyāḥ śakrāya kuṇḍale,
tayā tvaṁ karṇa saṅgrāme haniṣyasi raṇe ripūn ॥16॥
3.302.17: nāhatvā hi mahābāho śatrūneti karaṁ punaḥ,
3.302.18: tataḥ sūryāya japyānte karṇaḥ svapnaṁ nyavedayat ॥18॥
3.302.18d2: cakāra niścayaṁ rājan śaktyarthaṁ vadatāṁ varaḥ,
3.302.18d3: śaktyā tasmai pradāsyāmi kuṇḍale varma caiva ha,
3.302.20: uvāca taṁ tathetyeva karṇaṁ sūryaḥ smayanniva ॥20॥
3.302.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi kuṇḍalāharaṇaparvaṇi sūryakarṇasaṁvāde dvyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥302॥
3.303.1: kiṁ tad guhyaṁ na cākhyātaṁ karṇāyehoṣṇaraśminā,
kīdr̥śe kuṇḍale te ca kavacaṁ caiva kīdr̥śam ॥1॥
3.303.2: kutaśca kavacaṁ tasya kuṇḍale caiva sattama,
3.303.3: ayaṁ rājan bravīmyetat tasya guhyaṁ vibhāvasoḥ,
yādr̥śe kuṇḍale te ca kavacaṁ caiva yādr̥śam ॥3॥
3.303.6: bhikṣāmicchāmi vai bhoktuṁ tava gehe vimatsara ॥6॥
3.303.7: na me vyalīkaṁ kartavyaṁ tvayā vā tava cānugaiḥ,
evaṁ vatsyāmi te gehe yadi te rocate’nagha ॥7॥
3.303.8: śayyāsane ca me rājan nāparādhyeta kaścana ॥8॥
3.303.10: mama kanyā mahāprājña pr̥thā nāma yaśasvinī,
3.303.11: upasthāsyati sā tvāṁ vai pūjayānavamanya ca,
3.303.13: mama gehe mayā cāsya tathetyevaṁ pratiśrutam ॥13॥
3.303.16: brāhmaṇo hi paraṁ tejo brāhmaṇo hi paraṁ tapaḥ,
3.303.19: jānāmi praṇidhānaṁ te bālyāt prabhr̥ti nandinī,
3.303.20: mayi caiva yathāvat tvaṁ sarvamāvr̥tya vartase ॥20॥
3.303.21: na hyatuṣṭo jano’stīha pure cāntaḥpure ca te,
3.303.22: sandeṣṭavyāṁ tu manye tvāṁ dvijātiṁ kopanaṁ prati,
pr̥the bāleti kr̥tvā vai sutā cāsi mameti ca ॥22॥
3.303.23: vr̥ṣṇīnāṁ ca kule jātā śūrasya dayitā sutā,
dattā prītimatā mahyaṁ pitrā bālā purā svayam ॥23॥
3.303.25: tādr̥śe hi kule jātā kule caiva vivardhitā,
3.303.27: pr̥the rājakule janma rūpaṁ cāpi tavādbhutam,
tena tenāsi sampannā samupetā ca bhāvinī ॥27॥
3.303.28: sā tvaṁ darpaṁ parityajya dambhaṁ mānaṁ ca bhāvini,
ārādhya varadaṁ vipraṁ śreyasā yokṣyase pr̥the ॥28॥
3.303.29: kopite ca dvijaśreṣṭhe kr̥tsnaṁ dahyeta me kulam ॥29॥
3.303.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi kuṇḍalāharaṇaparvaṇi pr̥thopadeśe tryadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥303॥
3.304.1: yathāpratijñaṁ rājendra na ca mithyā bravīmyaham ॥1॥
3.304.2: eṣa caiva svabhāvo me pūjayeyaṁ dvijāniti,
tava caiva priyaṁ kāryaṁ śreyaśca paramaṁ mama ॥2॥
3.304.3: yadyardharātre bhagavān na me kopaṁ kariṣyati ॥3॥
3.304.4: lābho mamaiṣa rājendra yad vai pūjayatī dvijān,
ādeśe tava tiṣṭhantī hita kuryāṁ narottama ॥4॥
3.304.5: visrabdho bhava rājendra na vyalīkaṁ dvijottamaḥ,
vasan prāpsyati te gehe satyametad bravīmi te ॥5॥
3.304.6: yat priyaṁ ca dvijasyāsya hitaṁ caiva tavānagha,
yatiṣyāmi tathā rājan vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥6॥
3.304.8: na matkr̥te vyathāṁ rājan prāpsyasi dvijasattamāt ॥8॥
3.304.9: bhavanti cavano yadvat sukanyāyāḥ kr̥te purā ॥9॥
3.304.10: yathā tvayā narendredaṁ bhāṣitaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ prati ॥10॥
3.304.11: evaṁ bruvantīṁ bahuśaḥ pariṣvajya samarthya ca,
iti ceti ca kartavyaṁ rājā sarvamathādiśat ॥11॥
3.304.13: evamuktvā tu tāṁ kanyāṁ kuntibhojo mahāyaśāḥ,
3.304.14: iyaṁ brahman mama sutā bālā sukhavivardhitā,
aparādhyeta yatra kiñcinna kāryaṁ hr̥di tat tvayā ॥14॥
3.304.18: āhārādi ca sarvaṁ tat tathaiva pratyavedayat ॥18॥
3.304.19: nikṣipya rājaputrī tu tandrīṁ mānaṁ tathaiva ca,
3.304.20: tatra sā brāhmaṇaṁ gatvā pr̥thā śaucaparā satī,
3.304.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi kuṇḍalāharaṇaparvaṇi pr̥thādvijaparicaryāyāṁ caturadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥304॥
3.305.1: sā tu kanyā mahārāja brāhmaṇaṁ saṁśitavratam,
3.305.2: tata āyāti rājendra sāyaṁ rātrāvatho punaḥ ॥2॥
3.305.4: divase divase tasya vardhate na tu hīyate ॥4॥
3.305.5: brāhmaṇasya pr̥thā rājan na cakārāpriyaṁ tadā ॥5॥
3.305.6: vyaste kāle punaścaiti na caiti bahuśo dvijaḥ,
3.305.7: kr̥tameva ca tat sarvaṁ yathā tasmai nyavedayat,
3.305.10: tāṁ prabhāte ca sāyaṁ ca pitā papraccha bhārata,
api tuṣyati te putri brāhmaṇaḥ paricaryayā ॥10॥
3.305.12: tataḥ saṁvatsare pūrṇo yadāsau japatāṁ varaḥ,
nāpaśyad duṣkr̥taṁ kiñcit pr̥thāyāḥ sauhr̥de rataḥ ॥12॥
3.305.13: tataḥ prītamanā bhūtvā sa enāṁ brāhmaṇo’bravīt,
prīto’smi paramaṁ bhadre paricāreṇa te śubhe ॥13॥
3.305.15: kr̥tāni mama sarvāṇi yasyā me vedavittama,
tvaṁ prasannaḥ pitā caiva kr̥taṁ vipra varairmama ॥15॥
3.305.16: yadi necchasi mattastvaṁ varaṁ bhadre śucismite,
3.305.17: tena tena vaśe bhadre sthātavyaṁ te bhaviṣyati ॥17॥
3.305.18: akāmo vā sakāmo vā sa sameṣyati te vaśe,
3.305.21: taṁ pradāya tu rājendra kuntibhojamuvāca ha,
3.305.23: sa tu rājā dvijaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tatraivāntarhitaṁ tadā,
3.305.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi kuṇḍalāharaṇaparvaṇi pr̥thāyā mantraprāptau pañcādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥305॥
3.306.2: ayaṁ vai kīdr̥śastena mama datto mahātmanā,
3.306.5: na cātapyata rūpeṇa bhānoḥ sandhyāgatasya sā ॥5॥
3.306.11: kiṁ karomi vaśo rājñi brūhi kartā tadasmi te ॥11॥
3.306.13: gamiṣye’haṁ yathā māṁ tvaṁ bravīṣi tanumadhyame,
na tu devaṁ samāhūya nyāyyaṁ preṣayituṁ vr̥thā ॥13॥
3.306.16: atha gacchāmyahaṁ bhadre tvayā saṅgamya susmite,
yadi tvaṁ vacanaṁ nādya kariṣyasi mama priyam ॥16॥
3.306.17: śapiṣye tvāmahaṁ kruddho brāhmaṇaṁ pitaraṁ ca te,
tvatkr̥te tān pradhakṣyāmi sarvānapi na saṁśayaḥ ॥17॥
3.306.18: pitaraṁ caiva te mūḍhaṁ yo na vetti tavānayam,
tasya ca brāhmaṇasyādya yo’sau mantramadāt tava ॥18॥
3.306.19: ete hi vibudhāḥ sarve purandaramukhā divi ॥19॥
3.306.20: tvayā pralabdhaṁ paśyanti smayanta iva bhāvini,
paśya cainān suragaṇān divyaṁ cakṣuridaṁ hi te,
pūrvameva mayā dattaṁ dr̥ṣṭavatyasi yena mām ॥20॥
3.306.22: gaccha tvaṁ vai gopate svaṁ vimānaṁ
3.306.24: bālyād bāloti tat kr̥tvā kṣantumarhasi me vibho ॥24॥
3.306.26: na cāpi gantuṁ yuktaṁ hi mayā mithyākr̥tena vai,
3.306.27: sarveṣāṁ vibudhānāṁ ca vaktavyaḥ syāṁ tathā śubhe ॥27॥
3.306.28: sā tvaṁ mayā samāgaccha lapsyase mādr̥śaṁ sutam,
3.306.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi kuṇḍalāharaṇaparvaṇi sūryāhvāne ṣaḍadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥306॥
3.307.1: sā tu kanyā bahuvidhaṁ bruvantī madhuraṁ vacaḥ,
3.307.2: na śaśāka yadā bālā pratyākhyātuṁ tamonudam,
bhītā śāpāt tato rājan dadhyau dīrghamathāntaram ॥2॥
3.307.3: anāgasaḥ pituḥ śāpo brāhmaṇasya tathaiva ca,
mannimittaḥ kathaṁ na syāt kruddhādasmād vibhāvasoḥ ॥3॥
3.307.5: sāhamadya bhr̥śaṁ bhītā gr̥hītā ca kare bhr̥śam,
kathaṁ tvakāryaṁ kuryāṁ vai pradānaṁ hyātmanaḥ svayam ॥5॥
3.307.6: sā vai śāpaparitrastā bahu cintayatī hr̥dā,
3.307.8: pitā me dhriyate deva mātā cānye ca bāndhavāḥ,
3.307.9: tvayā tu saṅgamo deva yadi syād vidhivarjitaḥ,
3.307.10: athavā dharmametaṁ tvaṁ manyase tapatāṁ vara,
3.307.11: ātmapradānaṁ dudharṣa tava kr̥tvā satī tvaham,
3.307.12: na te pitā na te mātā guravo vā śucismite,
prabhavanti varārohe bhadraṁ te śr̥ṇu me vacaḥ ॥12॥
3.307.15: svabhāva eṣa lokānāṁ vikāro’nya iti smr̥taḥ ॥15॥
3.307.16: sā mayā saha saṅgamya punaḥ kanyā bhaviṣyasi,
3.307.17: yadi putro mama bhavet tvattaḥ sarvatamonuda,
3.307.19: mama putrasya yaṁ vai tvaṁ matta utpādayiṣyasi ॥19॥
3.307.20: astu me saṅgamo deva yathoktaṁ bhagavaṁstvayā,
3.307.21: adityā kuṇḍale rājñi datte me mattakāśini,
te’sya dāsyāmi vai bhīru varma caivedamuttamam ॥21॥
3.307.22: yadi putro bhavedevaṁ yathā vadasi gopate ॥22॥
3.307.24: tataḥ sā vihvalevāsīt kanyā sūryasya tejasā,
papāta cātha sā devī śayane mūḍhacetanā ॥24॥
3.307.26: tataḥ sā vrīḍitā bālā tadā sūryamathābravīt,
3.307.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi kuṇḍalāharaṇaparvaṇi sūryakuntīsamāgame saptādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥307॥
3.308.2: sā bāndhavabhayād bālā garbhaṁ taṁ vinigūhatī,
dhārayāmāsa suśroṇī na caināṁ bubudhe janaḥ ॥2॥
3.308.3: na hi tāṁ veda nāryanyā kācid dhātreyikāmr̥te,
3.308.4: tataḥ kālena sā garbhaṁ suṣuve varavarṇinī,
3.308.6: jātamātraṁ ca taṁ garbhaṁ dhātryā sammantrya bhāvinī,
3.308.9: uvāca rudatī kuntī yāni vākyāni tacchr̥ṇu ॥9॥
3.308.11: śivāste santu panthāno mā ca te paripanthinaḥ,
3.308.12: pātu tvāṁ varuṇo rājā salile salileśvaraḥ,
3.308.13: pitā tvāṁ pātu sarvatra tapanastapatāṁ varaḥ,
yena datto’si me putra divyena vidhinā kila ॥13॥
3.308.14: ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve ca devatāḥ,
3.308.15: rakṣantu tvāṁ surāḥ sarve sameṣu viṣameṣu ca,
3.308.17: dhanyā sā pramadā yā tvāṁ putratve kalpayiṣyati,
yasyāstvaṁ tr̥ṣitaḥ putra stanaṁ pāsyasi devaja ॥17॥
3.308.18: ko nu svapnastayā dr̥ṣṭo yā tvāmādityavarcasam,
3.308.20: dhanyā drakṣyanti putra tvāṁ bhūmau saṁsarpamāṇakam,
3.308.22: evaṁ bahuvidhaṁ rājan vilapya karuṇaṁ pr̥thā,
3.308.25: mañjūṣā tvaśvanadyāḥ sā yayau carmaṇvatīṁ nadīm,
carmaṇvatyāśca yamunāṁ tato gaṅgāṁ jagāma ha ॥25॥
3.308.27: dhārayāmāsa taṁ garbhaṁ daivaṁ ca vidhinirmitam ॥27॥
3.308.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi kuṇḍalāharaṇaparvaṇi karṇaparityāge aṣṭādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥308॥
3.309.1: etasminneva kāle tu dhr̥tarāṣṭrasya vai sakhā,
3.309.2: rādhā nāma mahābhāgā na sā putramavindata ॥2॥
3.309.5: sā tu kautūhalāt prāptāṁ grāhayāmāsa bhāvinī,
3.309.10: ityuktvā taṁ dadau putraṁ rādhāyai sa mahīpate ॥10॥
3.309.12: pupoṣa cainaṁ vidhivad vavr̥dhe sa ca vīryavān,
3.309.14: vasuṣeṇa iti khyāto vr̥ṣa ityeva ca prabhuḥ ॥14॥
3.309.15: sūtasya vavr̥dhe’ṅgeṣu śreṣṭhaḥ putraḥ sa vīryavān,
3.309.20: arjunasya ca karṇena yato dr̥ṣṭo babhūva saḥ ॥20॥
3.309.21: yaḥ sūryasambhavaḥ karṇaḥ kuntyāṁ sūtakule tathā ॥21॥
3.309.22: taṁ tu kuṇḍalinaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā varmaṇā ca samanvitam,
3.309.23: yadā ca karṇo rājendra bhānumantaṁ divākaram,
stauti madhyandine prāpte prāñjaliḥ salile sthitaḥ ॥23॥
3.309.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi kuṇḍalāharaṇaparvaṇi rādhākarṇaprāptau navādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥309॥
3.310.4: yadetat sahajaṁ varma kuṇḍale ca tavānagha,
etadutkr̥tya me dehi yadi satyavrato bhavān ॥4॥
3.310.5: eṣa me sarvalābhānāṁ lābhaḥ paramako mataḥ ॥5॥
3.310.6: tat te vipra pradāsyāmi na tu varma sakuṇḍalam ॥6॥
3.310.8: na cānyaṁ sa dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ kāmayāmāsa vai varam ॥8॥
3.310.9: yadā nānyaṁ pravr̥ṇute varaṁ vai dvijasattamaḥ,
3.310.9d1: vināsya sahajaṁ varma kuṇḍale ca viśāmpate,
3.310.10: sahajaṁ varma me vipra kuṇḍale cāmr̥todbhave,
3.310.13: yadānyaṁ na varaṁ vavre bhagavān pākaśāsanaḥ,
3.310.14: na tu nyāyyaṁ mayā dātuṁ tava śakra vr̥thā varam ॥14॥
3.310.15: tvaṁ hi deveśvaraḥ sākṣāt tvayā deyo varo mama,
3.310.16: yadi dāsyāmi te deva kuṇḍale kavacaṁ tathā,
3.310.17: tasmād vinimayaṁ kr̥tvā kuṇḍale varma cottamam,
harasva śakra kāmaṁ me na dadyāmahamanyathā ॥17॥
3.310.19: kāmamastu tathā tāta tava karṇa yathecchasi,
varjayitvā tu me vajraṁ pravr̥ṇīṣva yathecchasi ॥19॥
3.310.21: varmaṇā kuṇḍalābhyāṁ ca śaktiṁ me dehi vāsava,
3.310.23: kuṇḍale me prayacchasva varma caiva śarīrajam,
gr̥hāṇa karṇa śaktiṁ tvamanena samayena ca ॥23॥
3.310.24: amoghā hanti śataśaḥ śatrūn mama karacyutā,
3.310.26: garjantaṁ pratapantaṁ ca yato mama bhayaṁ bhavet ॥26॥
3.310.27: ekaṁ haniṣyasi ripuṁ garjantaṁ balinaṁ raṇe,
tvaṁ tu yaṁ prārthayasyekaṁ rakṣyate sa mahātmanā ॥27॥
3.310.29: amoghāṁ dehi me śaktiṁ yathā hanyāṁ pratāpinam ॥29॥
3.310.30: utkr̥tya tu pradāsyāmi kuṇḍale kavacaṁ ca te,
nikr̥tteṣu tu gātreṣu na me bībhatsatā bhavet ॥30॥
3.310.31: na te bībhatsatā karṇa bhaviṣyati kathañcana,
3.310.32: tādr̥śenaiva varṇena tvaṁ karṇa bhavitā punaḥ ॥32॥
3.310.34: yathā māmāttha śakra tvaṁ satyametad bravīmi te ॥34॥
3.310.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi kuṇḍalāharaṇaparvaṇi kavacakuṇḍaladāne daśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥310॥
3.311.7: vane kleśaṁ sukhodarkaṁ tat pravakṣyāmi te śr̥ṇu ॥7॥
3.311.10: hriyamāṇaṁ tu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sa vipraḥ kurusattama,
3.311.14: tasya gatvā padaṁ rājannāsādya ca mahāmr̥gam,
3.311.18: apaśyanto mr̥gaṁ śāntā duḥkhaṁ prāptā manasvinaḥ ॥18॥
3.311.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi āraṇeyaparvaṇi mr̥gānveṣaṇe ekādaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥311॥
3.312.1: nāpadāmasti maryādā na nimittaṁ na kāraṇam,
3.312.2: na mayā nihatastatra tena prāptāḥ sma saṁśayam ॥2॥
3.312.3: atitīvrā mayā kṣāntāstena prāptāḥ sma saṁśayam ॥3॥
3.312.4: sa mayā na hatastatra tena prāptāḥ sma saṁśayam ॥4॥
3.312.5: āruhya vr̥kṣaṁ mādreya nirīkṣasva diśo daśa ॥5॥
3.312.6: ete hi bhrātaraḥ śrāntāstava tāta pipāsitāḥ ॥6॥
3.312.9: gaccha saumya tataḥ śīghraṁ tūṇauḥ pānīyamānaya ॥9॥
3.312.11: sa dr̥ṣṭvā vimala toyaṁ sārasaiḥ parivāritam,
3.312.12: praśnānuktvā tu mādreya tataḥ piba harasva ca ॥12॥
3.312.13: anādr̥tya tu tad vākyaṁ nakulaḥ supipāsitaḥ,
apibacchītalaṁ toyaṁ pītvā ca nipapāta ha ॥13॥
3.312.15: bhrātā hi cirayāto naḥ sahadeva tavāgrajaḥ,
3.312.16: dadarśa ca hataṁ bhūmau bhrātaraṁ nakulaṁ tadā ॥16॥
3.312.18: praśnānuktvā yathākāmaṁ pibasva ca harasva ca ॥18॥
3.312.19: anādr̥tya tu tad vākyaṁ sahadevaḥ pipāsitaḥ,
apibacchītalaṁ toyaṁ pītvā ca nipapāta ha ॥19॥
3.312.21: tau caivānaya bhadraṁ te pānīyaṁ ca tvamānaya,
3.312.23: tau dadarśa hatau tatra bhrātarau śvetavāhanaḥ ॥23॥
3.312.25: nāpaśyat tatra kiñcit sa bhūtamasmin mahāvane,
3.312.27: tataḥ pāsyasi pānīyaṁ hariṣyasi ca bhārata ॥27॥
3.312.29: pravavarṣa diśaḥ kr̥tsnāḥ śabdavedhaṁ ca darśayan ॥29॥
3.312.31: kiṁ vighātena te pārtha praśnānuktvā tataḥ piba ॥31॥
3.312.32: anuktvā ca piban praśnān pītvaiva na bhaviṣyasi,
3.312.33: avajñāyaiva tāṁ vācaṁ pītvaiva nipapāta ha,
3.312.35: tāṁścaivānaya bhadraṁ te pānīyaṁ ca tvamānaya,
3.312.36: tān dr̥ṣṭvā duḥkhito bhīmastr̥ṣayā ca prapīḍitaḥ ॥36॥
3.312.37: sa cintayāmāsa tadā yoddhavyaṁ dhruvamadya vai ॥37॥
3.312.39: praśnānuktvā tu kaunteya tataḥ piba harasva ca ॥39॥
3.312.40: anuktvaiva tu tān praśnān pītvaiva nipapāta ha ॥40॥
3.312.44: dadarśa tat saraḥ śrīmān viśvakarmakr̥taṁ yathā ॥44॥
3.312.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi āraṇeyaparvaṇi nakulādipatane dvādaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥312॥
3.313.5: vyarthaṁ tadadya me sarvaṁ tvayi vīra nipātite ॥5॥
3.313.7: bhavatāṁ divyavācastu tā bhavantu kathaṁ mr̥ṣā,
3.313.9: nāsya jetā raṇe kaścidajetā naiṣa kasyacit ॥9॥
3.313.10: ayaṁ mamāśāṁ saṁhatya śete bhūmau dhanañjayaḥ ॥10॥
3.313.11: āśritya yaṁ vayaṁ nātha duḥkhānyetāni sehima,
raṇe pramattau vīrau ca sadā śatrunibarhaṇau ॥11॥
3.313.14: akr̥tvā sadr̥śaṁ karma kiṁ śedhvaṁ puruṣarṣabhāḥ ॥14॥
3.313.16: sukhaṁ prasuptān prasvinnaḥ khinnaḥ kaṣṭāṁ daśāṁ gataḥ ॥16॥
3.313.21: bhūtaṁ mahadidaṁ manye bhrātaro yena me hatāḥ ॥21॥
3.313.22: ekāgraṁ cintayiṣyāmi pītvā vetsyāmi vā jalam,
3.313.30: praśnānuktvā tu kaunteya tataḥ piba harasva ca ॥30॥
3.313.31: rudrāṇāṁ vā vasūnāṁ vā marutāṁ vā pradhānabhāk,
pr̥cchāmi ko bhavān devo naitacchakuninā kr̥tam ॥31॥
3.313.32: himavān pāriyātraśca vindhyo malaya eva ca,
3.313.33: atīva te mahat karma kr̥taṁ ca balināṁ vara,
yān na devā na gandharvā nāsurāśca na rākṣasāḥ ॥33॥
3.313.34: na te jānāmi yat kāryaṁ nābhijānāmi kāṅkṣitam ॥34॥
3.313.36: yakṣo’hamasmi bhadraṁ te nāsmi pakṣī jalecaraḥ ॥36॥
3.313.40: ime te bhrātaro rājan vāryamāṇā mayāsakr̥t ॥40॥
3.313.41: balāt toyaṁ jihīrṣantastato vai mr̥ditā mayā,
3.313.42: praśnānuktvā tu kaunteya tataḥ piba harasva ca ॥42॥
3.313.43: na cāhaṁ kāmaye yakṣa tava pūrvaparigraham,
kāmaṁ naitat praśaṁsanti santo hi puruṣāḥ sadā ॥43॥
3.313.44: yathāprajñaṁ tu te praśnān prativakṣyāmi pr̥ccha mām ॥44॥
3.313.46: dharmaścāstaṁ nayati ca satye ca pratitiṣṭhati ॥46॥
3.313.47: kenasvid dvitīyavān bhavati rājan kena ca buddhimān ॥47॥
3.313.48: śrutena śrotriyo bhavati tapasā vindate mahat,
3.313.49: kiṁ brāhmaṇānāṁ devatvaṁ kaśca dharmaḥ satāmiva,
3.313.50: svādhyāya eṣāṁ devatvaṁ tapa eṣāṁ satāmiva,
3.313.51: kiṁ kṣatriyāṇāṁ devatvaṁ kaśca dharmaḥ satāmiva,
3.313.53: kimekaṁ yajñiyaṁ sāma kimekaṁ yajñiyaṁ yajuḥ,
kā caiṣāṁ vr̥ṇute yajñaṁ kāṁ yajño nātivartate ॥53॥
3.313.54: prāṇo vai yajñiyaṁ sāma mano vai yajñiyaṁ yajuḥ,
r̥gekā vr̥ṇute yajñaṁ tāṁ yajño nātivartate ॥54॥
3.313.58: na nirvapati pañcānāmucchvasan na sa jīvati ॥58॥
3.313.59: kiṁsvid gurutaraṁ bhūmeḥ kiṁsviduccataraṁ ca khāt,
3.313.61: kiṁsvit suptaṁ na nimiṣati kiṁsvijjātaṁ na copati,
3.313.62: matsyaḥ supto na nimiṣatyaṇḍaṁ jātaṁ na copati,
aśmano hr̥dayaṁ nāsti nadī vegena vardhate ॥62॥
3.313.63: kiṁsvit pravasato mitraṁ kiṁsvinmitraṁ gr̥he sataḥ,
āturasya ca kiṁ mitraṁ kiṁsvinmitraṁ mariṣyataḥ ॥63॥
3.313.64: sārthaḥ pravasato mitraṁ bhāryā mitraṁ gr̥he sataḥ,
3.313.65: amr̥taṁ kiṁsvid rājendra kiṁsvit sarvamidaṁ jagat ॥65॥
3.313.67: kiṁsvideko vicarate jātaḥ ko jāyate punaḥ,
3.313.68: sūrya eko vicarate candramā jāyate punaḥ,
3.313.72: putra ātmā manuṣyasya bhāryā daivakr̥taḥ sakhā,
3.313.73: lābhānāmuttamaṁ kiṁ syāt sukhānāṁ syāt kimuttamam ॥73॥
3.313.75: kaśca dharmaḥ paro loke kaśca dharmaḥ sadāphalaḥ,
kiṁ nayamya na śocanti kaiśca sandhirna jīryate ॥75॥
3.313.76: mano yamya na śocanti sandhiḥ sadbhirna jīryate ॥76॥
3.313.79: kimarthaṁ caiva bhr̥tyeṣu kimarthaṁ caiva rājasu ॥79॥
3.313.80: bhr̥tyeṣu bharaṇārthaṁ vai bhayārthaṁ caiva rājasu ॥80॥
3.313.81: kena tyajati mitrāṇi kena svargaṁ na gacchati ॥81॥
3.313.82: lobhāt tyajati mitrāṇi saṅgāt svargaṁ na gacchati ॥82॥
3.313.83: mr̥taḥ kathaṁ syāt puruṣaḥ kathaṁ rāṣṭraṁ mr̥taṁ bhavet,
śrāddhaṁ mr̥taṁ kathaṁ vā syāt kathaṁ yajño mr̥to bhavet ॥83॥
3.313.85: kā dik kimudakaṁ proktaṁ kimannaṁ kiṁ ca vai viṣam,
śrāddhasya kālamākhyāhi tataḥ piba harasva ca ॥85॥
3.313.86: santo dig jalamākāśaṁ gaurannaṁ prārthanā viṣam,
śrāddhasya brāhmaṇaḥ kālaḥ kathaṁ vā yakṣa manyase ॥86॥
3.313.87: tapaḥ kiṁ lakṣaṇaṁ proktaṁ ko damaśca prakīrtitaḥ,
kṣamā ca kā parā proktā kā ca hrīḥ parikīrtitā ॥87॥
3.313.89: kiṁ jñānaṁ procyate rājan kaḥ śamaśca prakīrtitaḥ,
dayā ca kā parā proktā kiṁ cārjavamudāhr̥tam ॥89॥
3.313.93: ko mohaḥ procyate rājan kaśca mānaḥ prakīrtitaḥ,
kimālasyaṁ ca vijñeyaṁ kaśca śokaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ॥93॥
3.313.95: kiṁ sthairyamr̥ṣibhiḥ proktaṁ kiṁ ca dhairyamudāhr̥tam,
snānaṁ ca kiṁ paraṁ proktaṁ dānaṁ ca kimihocyate ॥95॥
3.313.97: kaḥ paṇḍitaḥ pumān jñeyo nāstikaḥ kaśca ucyate,
ko mūrkhaḥ kaśca kāmaḥ syāt ko matsara iti smr̥taḥ ॥97॥
