3.313.98: dharmajñaḥ paṇḍito jñeyo nāstiko mūrkha ucyate,
3.313.99: ko’haṅkāra iti proktaḥ kaśca dambhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ,
kiṁ tad daivaṁ paraṁ proktaṁ kiṁ tat paiśunyamucyate ॥99॥
3.313.104: paścānnāstīti yo brūyāt so’kṣayaṁ narakaṁ vrajet ॥104॥
3.313.105: vedeṣu dharmaśāstreṣu mithyā yo vai dvijātiṣu,
3.313.106: paścānnāstīti yo brūyāt so’kṣayaṁ narakaṁ vrajet ॥106॥
3.313.107: rājan kulena vr̥ttena svādhyāyena śrutena vā,
3.313.108: śr̥ṇu yakṣa kulaṁ tāta na svādhyāyo na ca śrutam,
kāraṇaṁ hi dvijatve ca vr̥ttameva na saṁśayaḥ ॥108॥
3.313.109: akṣīṇavr̥tto na kṣīṇo vr̥ttatastu hato hataḥ ॥109॥
3.313.110: sarve vyasanino mūrkhā yaḥ kriyāvān sa paṇḍitaḥ ॥110॥
3.313.111: yo’gnihotraparo dāntaḥ sa brāhmaṇa iti smr̥taḥ ॥111॥
3.313.114: ko modate kimāścaryaṁ kaḥ panthāḥ kā ca vārtikā,
3.313.115: pañcame’hani ṣaṣṭhe vā śākaṁ pacati sve gr̥he,
anr̥ṇī cāpravāsī ca sa vāricara modate ॥115॥
3.313.119: vyākhyātā me tvayā praśnā yāthātathyaṁ parantapa,
puruṣaṁ tvidānīṁ vyākhyāhi yaśca sarvadhanī naraḥ ॥119॥
3.313.120: divaṁ spr̥śati bhūmiṁ ca śabdaḥ puṇyena karmaṇā,
yāvat sa śabdo bhavati tāvat puruṣa ucyate ॥120॥
3.313.121: tulye priyāpriye yasya sukhaduḥkhe tathaiva ca,
atītānāgate cobhe sa vai sarvadhanī naraḥ ॥121॥
3.313.121d1: suprasannaḥ sadā yogī sa vai sarvadhanīśvaraḥ.
3.313.122: vyākhyātaḥ puruṣo rājan yaśca sarvadhanī naraḥ,
tasmāt tvamekaṁ bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ yamicchasi sa jīvatu ॥122॥
3.313.123: śyāmo ya eṣa raktākṣo br̥hacchāla ivotthitaḥ,
3.313.128: dharma eva hato hanti dharmo rakṣati rakṣitaḥ,
tasmād dharmaṁ na tyajāmi mā no dharmo hato’vadhīt ॥128॥
3.313.129: ānr̥śaṁsyaṁ paro dharmaḥ paramārthācca me matam,
3.313.130: dharmaśīlaḥ sadā rājā iti māṁ mānavā viduḥ,
3.313.131: kuntī caiva tu mādrī ca dve bhārye tu piturmama,
ubhe saputre syātāṁ vai iti me dhīyate matiḥ ॥131॥
3.313.132: yathā kuntī tathā mādrī viśeṣo nāsti me tayoḥ,
3.313.133: tasya te’rthācca kāmācca ānr̥śaṁsyaṁ paraṁ matam,
tasmāt te bhrātaraḥ sarve jīvantu bharatarṣabha ॥133॥
3.313.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi āraṇeyaparvaṇi yakṣapraśnane trayodaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥313॥
3.314.2: pr̥cchāmi ko bhavān devo na me yakṣo mato bhavān ॥2॥
3.314.3: athavā marutāṁ śreṣṭho vajrī vā tridaśeśvaraḥ ॥3॥
3.314.4: taṁ yodhaṁ na prapaśyāmi yena sarve nipātitāḥ ॥4॥
3.314.5: sa bhavān suhr̥do’smākamathavā naḥ pitā bhavān ॥5॥
3.314.8: dvārāṇyetāni me viddhi priyo hyasi sadā mama ॥8॥
3.314.9: diṣṭyā pañcasu rakto’si diṣṭyā te ṣaṭpadī jitā,
dve pūrve madhyame dve ca dve cānte sāmparāyike ॥9॥
3.314.11: varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva rājendra dātā hyasmi tavānagha,
ye hi me puruṣā bhaktā na teṣāmasti durgatiḥ ॥11॥
3.314.12: tasyāgnayo na lupyeran prathamo’stu varo mama ॥12॥
3.314.14: anyaṁ varaya bhadraṁ te varaṁ tvamamaropama ॥14॥
3.314.17: na vo vijñāsyate kaścit triṣu lokeṣu bhārata ॥17॥
3.314.19: yad vaḥ saṅkalpitaṁ rūpaṁ manasā yasya yādr̥śam,
3.314.21: na tr̥pyāmi naraśreṣṭha prayacchan vai varāṁstathā ॥21॥
3.314.22: tvaṁ hi matprabhavo rājan viduraśca mamāṁśajaḥ ॥22॥
3.314.23: devadevo mayā dr̥ṣṭo bhavān sākṣāt sanātanaḥ,
yaṁ dadāsi varaṁ tuṣṭastaṁ grahīṣyāmyahaṁ pitaḥ ॥23॥
3.314.24: jayeyaṁ lobhamohau ca krodhaṁ cāhaṁ sadā vibho,
dāne tapasi satye ca mano me satataṁ bhavet ॥24॥
3.314.25: bhavān dharmaḥ punaścaiva yathoktaṁ te bhaviṣyati ॥25॥
3.314.27: upetya cāśramaṁ vīrāḥ sarva eva gataklamāḥ,
3.314.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi āraṇeyaparvaṇi nakulādijīvanādivaraprāptau caturdaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥314॥
3.315.2: ye tadbhaktā vasanti sma vanavāse tapasvinaḥ ॥2॥
3.315.5: uṣitāśca vane kr̥cchre vayaṁ dvādaśa vatsarān,
3.315.8: api nastad bhaved bhūyo yad vayaṁ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha,
3.315.10: atha dhaumyo’bravīd vākyaṁ mahārthaṁ nr̥patiṁ tadā ॥10॥
3.315.13: channenoṣya kr̥taṁ karma dviṣatāṁ ca vinigrahe ॥13॥
3.315.15: baleryathā hr̥taṁ rājyaṁ vikramaistacca te śrutam ॥15॥
3.315.16: vibudhānāṁ kr̥taṁ karma tacca sarvaṁ śrutaṁ tvayā ॥16॥
3.315.17: vajraṁ praviśya śakrasya yat kr̥taṁ tacca te śrutam ॥17॥
3.315.18: yat kr̥taṁ tāta deveṣu karma tatte’nagha śrutam ॥18॥
3.315.19: nirdagdhāḥ śātravāḥ sarve vasatā bhuvi sarvaśaḥ ॥19॥
3.315.20: viṣṇunā vasatā cāpi gr̥he daśarathasya vai,
3.315.22: śāstrabuddhyā svabuddhyā ca na cacāla yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥22॥
3.315.24: dharmānugatayā buddhyā na kiñcit sāhasaṁ kr̥tam ॥24॥
3.315.26: na vayaṁ tat prahāsyāmo yasmin yokṣyati no bhavān,
bhavān vidhattāṁ tat sarvaṁ kṣipraṁ jeṣyāmahe ripūn ॥26॥
3.315.29: saha dhaumyena vidvāṁsastathā pañca ca pāṇḍavāḥ,
3.315.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śatasāhasryāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ vaiyāsikyāṁ vanaparvaṇi āraṇeyaparvaṇi ajñātavāsamantraṇe pañcadaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥315॥
3.mahima.2: yaṁ yaṁ prārthayate kāmaṁ taṁ taṁ prāpnotyasaṁśayam,
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ ॥2॥
